9839.companyProfile:
动易科技成立于2024年9月，是一家聚焦具身智能与物理智能体的前沿科技企业。公司以“Robot for AI”推动软件与硬件深度耦合，自研物理智能体PhyAgents作为核心引擎，兼具智能决策与稳定运控能力。动易科技既是物理智能体赛道的领跑者，也是具身智能领域的前沿探索者与实践者。

在技术理念上，动易科技率先提出Embodied PhyStack技术架构。该理念并非追求一个包办一切的全能“大脑”，而是将通用认知、物理智能、运动控制与本体操作分层解耦、协同演进：自顶层认知到底层执行，依次为通用大模型、物理智能体PhyAgents、运动控制系统PhyCore与机器人本体PHYBOT。公司重点聚焦“训端侧模型、调实时控制、磨稳定本体、跑真实场景”，构建效率更高的协同系统，让AI在物理约束下形成“感知—决策—控制—执行—反馈”的完整闭环。

从底层技术到应用场景，动易科技构筑了全栈自研的行业壁垒。旗下M系列、C系列双足人形机器人及D系列四足机械狗，覆盖生产制造、特种作业、生活服务等多元场景。公司正以高智能水平与强泛化能力，推动机器人从数字世界走向物理世界，持续输出新一代智能生产力。
9839.companyProfileEn:
Founded in September 2024, PHYBOT is a cutting-edge technology enterprise focusing on embodied intelligence and physical agents. Guided by the philosophy of "Robot for AI", the company drives deep integration of software and hardware. With self-developed physical agent PhyAgents as its core engine, PHYBOT delivers capabilities of intelligent decision-making and stable motion control. As a pacesetter in the physical agent track, PHYBOT is also a pioneer and practitioner exploring embodied intelligence.

In terms of technical philosophy, PHYBOT first proposed the Embodied PhyStack technical architecture. Instead of pursuing an all-in-one "brain" that handles every task, this concept decouples and enables collaborative evolution of general cognition, physical intelligence, motion control and robot manipulation in layers. From top-level cognition down to low-level execution, the stack consists of general large models, physical agent PhyAgents, motion control system PhyCore and PHYBOT robot hardware. The company focuses on "training edge-side models, tuning real-time control, refining reliable robot bodies, and deploying in real-world scenarios", to build a more efficient collaborative system. It enables AI to form a complete closed loop of "perception - decision - control - execution - feedback" under physical constraints.

9775.companyProfileEn:
Founded in 2005, SOYO Technology is a distinguished National High-Tech Enterprise, recognized with "Specialized and New" and Dual-Software certifications. With over two decades of expertise in digital wireless and IP computing audio, the company operates a comprehensive 15,000-square-meter facility across Shenzhen, Guangxi, and Dongguan, integrating R&D, production, sales, and services.
SOYO masters a wide array of core technologies, including Bluetooth, UHF, VHF, 2.4G/5.8G, WiFi, alongside IP network audio, IoT, cloud computing, and AI. Key innovations feature kilometer-level high-fault-tolerance transmission, distributed multi-concurrent IP audio, and an AI audio agent supporting 50+ languages.
The company serves diverse sectors:
Education: From 2.4G teaching amplification (launched in 2009) to smart classrooms.
Conferencing: Winner of the 2026 ISLE Debut Product Award for its real-time translation audio system.
Other Fields: Tourism, digital broadcasting, emergency systems, and smart parks.
As the leader of the Guangdong Digital Wireless Audio Engineering Technology Research Center, SOYO holds nearly 100 patent applications (20+ granted) and global certifications (FCC, CE, etc.). Products are exported to 50+ countries. In 2019, SOYO became the first Chinese audio enterprise to win both CES and ISE Innovation Awards, striving to be a global leader in AI interaction platforms.

10049.companyProfileEn:
Beijing Noetix Robotics Technology Group Co., Ltd. (Noetix Robotics) is a technology company specializing in humanoid robots and embodied intelligence. Its founding team comes from leading research institutions including Tsinghua University and Zhejiang University. The company is dedicated to advancing the practical adoption and widespread application of humanoid robots through the development of high‑performance robotic products designed for diverse scenarios. Its core products include the consumer humanoid robot Bumi, priced at around RMB 10,000, the bipedal humanoid robot N Series and E Series, the biomimetic robotic head “Xiaonuo,” the wheeled robot W1, and the next‑generation biomimetic robot “X‑head 1 (Xiaoyue).”
Currently, Noetix Robotics’ products have been deployed across multiple scenarios, including research, tourism, companionship, and service. Its N&E series robots have won championships in long jump and gymnastics, as well as second place in individual robot dancing at the 2025 World Humanoid Robot Games. They also achieved second and fourth place in the 2025 Beijing Yizhuang Humanoid Robot Half Marathon. On February 16, 2026, Noetix Robotics made its debut at the CCTV Spring Festival Gala and was recognized as both the exclusive partner for biomimetic humanoid robots and the humanoid robot partner of the gala.

10986.companyProfileEn:
Lumos Robotics is a leading company driving the large-scale industrial deployment of embodied Al.
Industrial embodied Al is widely regarded as a key pathway toward AGI. At its core is an integrated capability framework that brings together real-world scenario resources, data and Al model capabilities, and hardware infrastructure. As the primary vehicle for bringing AGl into the physical world, embodied Al not only accelerates the realization of AGl but also creates a powerful synergy between technological innovation and commercial value.
To date, Lumos Robotics has built a comprehensive portfolio of embodied Al robotic systems, including Lumos LUS 2, a full-size bipedal humanoid robot; Lumos MOS 2,a heavy-duty wheeled mobile manipulation robot; Lumos NIX S3, an Al mini bipedal humanoid robot; and Lumos LUD, a quadruped robot. Powered by real-world industrial data and strong commercialization capabilities, Lumos Robotics has rapidly established a leading technological position and expanding market presence in the embodied Al industry.
Lumos Robotics has formed strategic partnerships with the leading Fortune Global500 companies and publicly listed enterprises, including Mitsubishi Electric Intelligent Manufacturing Technology (China) and COSCO Shipping.

9969.companyProfileEn:
Ensuring Technology (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd. is a technology enterprise specializing in embodied intelligence tactile infrastructure. Focusing on contact perception and tactile data during the interaction between robots and the physical world, it has built a software and hardware integrated technology system covering tactile sensors, tactile data acquisition, and a sense-compute integrated hardware and software architecture.
The company's self-developed multi-dimensional tactile technology features high density, thinness, multi-dimensional force sensing, and integration of sensing and computing. It can acquire information such as changes in normal force, tangential force, and contact force, and is applied in scenarios such as dexterous hands, humanoid robots, electronic skin, and embodied intelligence data collection.
On the data side, YuanSheng Technology further synchronizes the collection of human body movements, tactile sensations, and multi-dimensional force information, extending the scope of robot training data from vision and motion to include vision, motion, tactile sensation, and force perception. This provides a more comprehensive data foundation for fine manipulation, teleoperation, and embodied intelligence model training.

By photographing the ear, AI evaluates 22 body systems in 10 seconds and generates a personalized conditioning plan. It is also a practical unit for the Ministry of Education's 13th Five-Year Plan key project "Myopia Prevention and Control," owning multiple patents and software copyrights.

Earprint Technology—inheriting Chinese medical wisdom through technology, bringing health to every household.

Specifically designed for high-power-density AI chips, the cold-plate phase-change liquid cooling technology enables efficient direct-contact thermal management to boost heat dissipation and system energy efficiency. Featuring broad compatibility, high reliability and superior energy efficiency, our liquid cooling solutions cover scenarios ranging from legacy data center retrofits to new-build AI supercomputing centers. They help customers transcend the limits of air cooling and achieve low-carbon operation with a PUE of 1.05–1.1.

10763.companyProfile:
千觉机器人科技（上海）有限公司（以下简称“千觉”）成立于2024年5月，由上海交通大学教授、ICRA 2021全球唯一最佳论文奖得主（4056篇投稿中唯一获奖）马道林创立，是一家面向物理智能时代，专注智能机器人与真实物理世界感知和自主交互的前沿高科技企业。
千觉以“触觉点亮物理智能”为核心主张，致力于成为全球触觉智能技术引领者。公司围绕机器人在真实环境中的接触感知、精细操作和自主交互能力，提供包括多模态传感器、数据采集、AI模型和智能控制在内的触觉智能软硬件一体化解决方案。
千觉已构建覆盖硬件、数据、模型与场景落地的完整技术体系，自主研发了多模态触觉传感器、XTac 触觉数采系统与VTLA多模态基础模型（Vision-Tactile-Language-Action）。其中，VTLA模型融合视觉、触觉、语言与动作信息，旨在提升机器人对真实物理交互的感知、理解和操作能力，进一步强化公司在触觉智能领域的技术壁垒。依托“硬件-数据-模型-场景”的闭环能力，千觉推动触觉感知从底层硬件、真实交互数据到具身智能模型训练与应用部署的落地。
目前，千觉已服务300多家行业头部公司及顶尖科研机构，并与理想汽车、宁德时代、欧莱雅等企业及生态伙伴开展合作，获得高瓴创投、元禾原点、理想汽车、智元机器人等顶尖投资机构和产业方的战略投资。
未来，千觉将以“触觉点亮物理智能”为使命，持续构建面向具身智能时代的“触觉底座”。从机器人灵巧操作、工业制造到柔性物流与质检检测，千觉希望让每一次接触都成为智能进化的数据入口，让每一次交互都推动机器更深刻地理解真实世界，最终让智能机器人从“看见世界”走向“理解世界、交互世界”。
10763.companyProfileEn:
Founded in May 2024 and headquartered in Shanghai, Xense Robotics' mission is to light up physical intelligence with tactile perception. Our proprietary tri-color visual-tactile sensors simultaneously deliver 3D topography, texture, 6-axis net force, distributed force, slip and motion tracking at micrometer resolution and millinewton-level accuracy.
The product family spans fingertip (Elf), gripper (Quark N1 / W1), flat (Photon), integrated intelligent gripper (Aurora Lite), wearable data-collection hardware (XTac UMI G1) and a full-hand tactile solution (V2.0), paired with our in-house VTLA (Vision-Tactile-Language-Action) model and the TacVerse real-world dataset.
Xense is among the first companies in the industry to achieve ten-thousand-unit mass production, serving 300+ paid customers across humanoid robotics, industrial automation, consumer brands and leading research institutions.

10180.companyProfileEn:
Quanyu Intelligence focuses on the foundational large model for EEG, building a full-stack brain-computer interface (BCI) pipeline of **acquisition – EEG tokenization – decoding and modeling – industry applications**. It converts neural signals such as intent, attention, emotion and preference into AI-readable information.

At the data layer, the team has curated 120,000 hours of EEG data covering more than 80,000 subjects, including thousands of hours of self-collected native raw data. The company completed Guangdong Province’s first intellectual property registration for BCI data, underpinning neural data ownership verification, compliance governance, and alignment training on human preferences.

At the model layer, it has independently developed a 1B-parameter general foundational EEG large model, paired with the Omni-EEGBench evaluation benchmark, enabling decoding across diverse populations, scenarios and devices.

On the product side, offerings include datasets, model APIs, cloud platforms, and integrated hardware‑software solutions. Proof-of-concept demos such as brain-controlled robotic arms and brain-controlled games have been realized. In the medium-to-long term, EEG electrodes will be integrated into AI glasses to deliver imperceptible wearable mind-control interaction, serving clients in embodied intelligence, generative AI, human-computer interaction and cognitive assessment.

10771.companyProfile:
炬坤机器人 TorchKernel Robotics
让机器拥有一双灵巧的手

杭州炬坤机器人有限公司（TorchKernel Robotics）成立于 2025 年 6 月，脱胎于浙江大学机器人抓取实验室（Grasp Lab），总部位于杭州余杭。公司由国家级海外优青、浙江大学"新百人计划"研究员、博导董会旭博士领衔，核心团队来自浙大 Grasp Lab，深耕机器人抓取与操作十余年。

炬坤聚焦"具身智能的最后一厘米"——灵巧操作，自主研发以 “21 自由度五指灵巧手”为核心、融合“多模态触觉感知系统”与“具身智能操作系统”的全栈技术。

第四种技术范式
区别于主流的腱绳、直驱、连杆方案，炬坤首创"空间耦合解耦变胞机构"：以微终端实现高精度操作，网络运动互不干涉、数学拓扑优化，从原理层同时拉满灵活、精度与负载——既像人手一样灵巧，又满足工业级的可靠与可量产。

产品矩阵
-灵巧手：21 自由度五指，重复定位精度 20μm，单指负载 33N、整手负载 40kg；
-触觉：自研多模态触觉感知，赋予机器"指尖触觉"；
-电机：自研关节模组，匹配灵巧手高精度运动需要与量产制造工艺要求；
-具身小脑：具身操作大模型 + 具身小脑，构建"数据—模型—操作"飞轮。

市场化合作
炬坤机器人正面向工业精密装配、科研教育、具身智能本体厂商等场景开放合作，已与多家头部客户达成合作，加速量产与场景落地。
10771.companyProfileEn:
TorchKernel Robotics
Give machines a pair of dexterous hands

TorchKernel Robotics (Hangzhou Jukun Robotics Co., Ltd.) was founded in June 2025, spun out of the Grasp Lab at Zhejiang University, with its headquarters in Yuhang, Hangzhou. Led by Dr. Dong Huixu — a National Overseas Outstanding Young Scholar and ZJU "New Hundred Talents" professor — the core team comes from the ZJU Grasp Lab, bringing over a decade of expertise in robotic grasping and manipulation.

TorchKernel focuses on "the last centimeter of embodied intelligence" — dexterous manipulation. We develop a full-stack technology centered on a 21-DoF five-finger dexterous hand, integrated with a multimodal tactile sensing system and an embodied-intelligence operating system.

The Fourth Technical Paradigm
Unlike mainstream tendon-driven, direct-drive, or linkage solutions, TorchKernel pioneers a spatial coupled-decoupled metamorphic mechanism: micro-terminals enable high-precision operation, network motions are non-interfering, and mathematical topology optimization simultaneously maximizes dexterity, precision, and payload — as dexterous as a human hand, yet reliable and mass-producible for industrial use.

Product Matrix
-Dexterous Hand: 21-DoF, repeatability down to 20 μm, 33 N per finger, 40 kg whole-hand payload;
-Tactile: in-house multimodal tactile sensing that gives machines a "fingertip touch";
-Embodied Brain: embodied manipulation foundation model + embodied cerebellum, forming a data–model–operation flywheel.

Commercialization
Serving industrial precision assembly, research & education, and embodied-intelligence OEMs, TorchKernel has secured partnerships with multiple leading customers. The company has closed its angel round at a post-money valuation of RMB 800 million and is accelerating mass production and deployment.

10563.companyProfile:
杭州时空张量机器人科技有限公司（UniTensor）由中科摇橹船联合中国工程物理研究院、清华大学联合创立，是一家聚焦“具身之眼”与全球海外业务的空间计算智能感知企业。
公司基于“高时间分辨空间计算智能成像”架构，打造出全球首个7D空间智能传感器，将激光TOF、视觉与IMU在前端统一，实现了“先计算、后成像”。通过一条光路、一个物理信号、一台传感器，同时完成“看清+测准+对齐”，一次性采集包括X/Y/Z三维坐标、RGB色彩语义，以及高精度时间戳共7个维度信息。
公司品牌为“时空张量UniTensor”，产品品牌为“天眼Tensopt”，产品型号包括天眼·机器人版SIC-MR-30与天眼·车载版SIC-PV-200，为具身智能与智能汽车两大万亿级赛道提供全天候视觉空间感知底座，让机器看懂真实物理世界。
天眼·机器人版定位为"机器人空间感知核心入口"。感知距离0.15—30米，距离精度小于1%，点云输出3072万点/秒，25Hz全分辨率。产品可清晰采集高反光、高透明物体物理信息，在烈日强光下精准识别低矮微小物品，有效破解灵巧手准确抓取、户外强光作业、高透明高反光物体精细扫描、恶劣环境数据采集等场景难题。
天眼·车载版定位为“智能汽车前向主感知入口”。在浓雾暴雨天气下感知距离突破200米，无惧强光眩光干扰，对驾驶过程中倒置的交通锥、纸箱等CornerCase小目标的探测精度远超传统激光雷达，测距精度达到毫米级，二百米外可识别厘米级物理特征，对标激光雷达的物理极限值。
10563.companyProfileEn:
Hangzhou Unitensor Robotics Technology Co., Ltd.  was jointly founded by Zhongke Yaolu Boat, the China Academy of Engineering Physics, and Tsinghua University. It is a spatial computing intelligent perception enterprise focused on the "Embodied Eye" and global overseas business.

Based on its "high-temporal-resolution spatial computing intelligent imaging" architecture, the company has developed the world's first 7D spatial intelligence sensor, which unifies LiDAR TOF, vision, and IMU at the front end, achieving "compute first, image later." Through a single optical path, a single physical signal, and a single sensor, it simultaneously accomplishes "see clearly + measure accurately + align," collecting seven dimensions of information in one pass, including X/Y/Z three-dimensional coordinates, RGB color semantics, and high-precision timestamps.

The company brand is "UniTensor," and the product brand is "Tensopt." Product models include Tensopt·Robot Edition SIC-MR-30 and Tensopt·Automotive Edition SIC-PV-200, providing an all-weather visual spatial perception foundation for the two trillion-level tracks of embodied intelligence and intelligent vehicles, enabling machines to understand the real physical world.

10245.companyProfileEn:
LingYu Robotics is a high-precision physical-world data infrastructure provider for embodied AI. Founded by a leading team from Tsinghua University's Department of Automation, the company focuses on building an embodied AI product ecosystem that integrates hardware and software, edge-cloud collaboration, and a closed data loop.

To address the long-standing challenges in robotics — data scarcity, unstable quality, and the disconnect between simulation and reality — LingYu Robotics has built a scalable data collection system. Through sub-microsecond hardware synchronization, millimeter-level absolute positioning, and compliant force-control capabilities, it stably captures key data such as vision, force, and human operational decision-making, improving data consistency, realism, and trainability.

LingYu Robotics has established a complete closed loop covering equipment, deployment, and data delivery, serving top universities and enterprises worldwide and helping robotic data evolve from experimental validation to standardized, scalable production. Our goal is to become the data gateway to the physical world.

The company has been recognised as a National High-Tech Enterprise and a Beijing Municipality "Specialised, Refined, Distinctive and Innovative" SME. Technology and Innovation
Namaste has developed a general-purpose embodied AI brain for robotics, combining its proprietary Functional Brain Simulation Architecture with Physical AI and independently developed robotic platforms.

Its neuromorphic decision-making system emulates the parallel processing of 11 functional regions of the human brain, enabling multimodal perception and advanced understanding of the physical world using just 1% of the parameters and computing resources required by traditional large language models, according to the company. It can operate on a single consumer-grade GPU, offering efficient, low-power performance and strong generalisation capabilities.

10690.companyProfileEn:
Lumisition Robotics is a global leader in consumer‑grade Field‑AI‑powered intelligent agents. Founded by a PhD team from the Chinese University of Hong Kong, the company is committed to bringing its self‑developed wheel‑legged robots into real‑world outdoor environments and training a general‑purpose brain for unstructured terrains using real‑world outdoor datasets. Its products cater to a wide range of consumer‑grade scenarios including outdoor exploration, household cargo handling, sports companionship, commercial services, medical rehabilitation and personal mobility. The company has closed an angel‑round financing of nearly tens of millions of RMB, backed by renowned investment institutions including True Sight Ventures, Lightpoint Capital and Pine Capital. Guided by its global vision, Lumisition Robotics advances product roll‑out and ecosystem development for worldwide markets.

9739.companyProfileEn:
# COBOTICZ
### Intelligent Robotics. Human-Centered Construction.

Founded in 2022, COBOTICZ specializes in the research, development, and application of construction robotics. Seizing the transformative opportunity to modernize the traditional construction industry, the company has secured multiple rounds of investment from leading venture capital funds in the industry.

COBOTICZ focuses on two core business areas: **construction robot systems and integrated machines, as well as core hardware and technology platforms.** With multiple industry-first inventions and patented technologies, we are committed to advancing the intelligent transformation and digitalization of construction through innovation.

But our vision goes beyond automation.

**We believe robots should work for people, not replace them.** By taking on repetitive, physically demanding tasks, intelligent construction robots can help reduce workers' physical strain, improve construction quality, and enhance productivity—empowering professionals to focus on their expertise, creativity, and the work that matters most.

At COBOTICZ, we see technology as a partner in human progress. By combining robotics, intelligent systems, and practical construction expertise, we strive to transform how the world builds—making construction smarter, safer, and more efficient, while creating a better working environment for the people who build our world.

**COBOTICZ — Building a Smarter Future, Together.**

Focused on dim, high-risk and confined spaces where GNSS signals are unavailable, the Company delivers an AI-powered integrated operation and maintenance solution featuring autonomous flight agents. Its self-developed “Linglong” series has achieved pioneering on-site operational deployments in harsh environments including nuclear power plants and metro tunnels.
This aerial robot operates without manual remote control. It autonomously plans inspection routes, performs dynamic obstacle avoidance mid-flight, and simultaneously captures high-definition imagery, generates 3D realistic models, and intelligently identifies equipment defects, enabling integrated data acquisition and analysis. Equipped with a suite of sensors including vision, thickness measurement, optical fiber, LiDAR, gas sensing and partial discharge detection, the platform integrates the self-developed “Chenxing·ZhiXun” multimodal large model to form a closed-loop operation and maintenance system spanning perception, decision-making and execution.
Maintaining stable and reliable performance under extreme conditions such as GNSS-denied environments, total darkness and strong electromagnetic interference, the solution is widely applicable to complex scenarios covering nuclear power, thermal power, wind power, hydropower, substations, tunnels, bridges, utility tunnels, mine tunnels and emergency rescue. It sets a new benchmark for safe, efficient unmanned inspection.

Langyi Robotics is a National High-Tech Enterprise dedicated to delivering full-stack Spatial AI solutions for the next generation of general-purpose robots. Our core R&D team brings together deep academic credentials and world-class industry experience. Members hold master's and doctoral degrees from top universities such as Huazhong University of Science and Technology and Zhejiang University, and include former engineers from Huawei, DJI and other leading technology companies. For over a decade, our team has been deeply engaged in robot perception. Through original technical breakthroughs, we have overcome long-standing bottlenecks in general-purpose perception and interaction for robots operating across complex indoor and outdoor environments — establishing Langyi as a key player in building the "neural core" of the robot evolution.

Founded in 2019, Shanghai Tingyuan Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. provides AI robotics operational services, including channel management, digitally enabled asset management, financial services, after-sales support, supply-chain coordination and commercial applications. Its nationwide network includes over 200 channel partners and over 200 standardized after-sales service locations. Collaboration
Through a strategic equity partnership, the companies aim to link QingNSynth's technology exploration with Tingyuan's robotics and operational experience. They will explore technology integration, use-case research, solution design and application validation, alongside joint demonstrations, collaborative projects and industry partnerships.
Applications and shared vision
The companies plan to explore intelligent reception, interactive guidance, information exchange and robotic services for commercial complexes, offices, hotels and public spaces. Potential applications include interactive exhibits for technology venues, showrooms and trade fairs, plus technology demonstrations, science outreach and research with universities, research institutions and education providers. They will also explore adapting interaction technologies to robotics products and customer needs, developing joint solutions for validation.

10556.companyProfileEn:
Gotcool — The High-Density Microchannel Liquid Cooling Specialist.

Gotcool is recognized as a National High-Tech Enterprise and a Specialized, Refined, Distinctive and Innovative Enterprise in Shanghai. Founded in 2013 and headquartered in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, the company has over a decade of expertise in advanced heat transfer.

Focused on the critical cooling demands of AI computing, Gotcool specializes in high-density microchannel cold plates and end-to-end liquid cooling systems. It is the only company in China to have achieved a breakthrough in high-density single-phase liquid cooling at 300 W/cm². Its products support applications at the chip, server, rack and data center levels, delivering performance comparable to leading international brands and validated under demanding industrial conditions involving high temperatures and pressures.

Gotcool’s core technologies include multi-path microchannels, coupled thermal-fluid analysis, topology optimization and enhanced heat transfer. The company has completed single-phase liquid cooling validation at an average heat flux of 300 W/cm² and a local heat flux of 608 W/cm².

Its product portfolio spans microchannel cold plates, liquid cooling modules, coolant distribution units (CDUs) and system integration. 10670.companyProfileEn:
Droitstock is an AI creative tool and copyright data platform operated by Beijing Droitstock Technology Co., Ltd., founded in 2014. Guided by our brand proposition — **Creative Intelligence, Grounded in Rights**, Droitstock integrates creative tools, data capabilities, copyright services and management systems in synergy. We pave the way for creative realization, draw clear boundaries for content utilization, and help digital assets accrue value through continuous circulation.

公司核心技术为量子安全直接通信（QSDC）：将信息直接编码于光量子态，经光纤或自由空间信道传输。任何窃听行为都会扰动量子态，系统因此能够实时感知并定位入侵，同时阻断被窃听内容的外泄。传统密码体系的安全性依赖计算复杂度，而 QSDC 的安全性直接源于量子物理原理——既感知窃听，也阻止窃听。系统还具备通信节点位置暴露的主动预警能力，为关键任务指挥通信链路提供重要安全保障。
9722.companyProfileEn:
Founded in 2025, Beijing TGW Quantum Technology Co., Ltd. is a deep-tech company dedicated to the R&D and commercialization of quantum communication technologies, with fully self-developed core technology serving the security of critical communications.
Our core technology, Quantum Secure Direct Communication (QSDC), encodes information directly onto the quantum states of photons and transmits it over optical fiber or free-space channels. Any eavesdropping disturbs these quantum states, allowing the system to detect and localize intrusions in real time — and to block intercepted content from leaking. Unlike conventional cryptography, whose security relies on computational complexity, QSDC derives its security directly from the laws of quantum physics. It also provides proactive early warning when a communication node's position is exposed, making it a vital safeguard for mission-critical command and communication links.

11019.companyProfileEn:
Joy-Motion focuses on the R&D and manufacturing of core drive components for embodied intelligence, with a product portfolio covering four major lines: robot joint modules, frameless torque motors, highly flexible force-controlled robotic arms, and Umi grippers.
The company currently has more than 550 employees, including a core R&D team of over 100 people. It has built a 40,000+ square meter R&D, testing, and production center, and has established automated production lines with an annual capacity of 2 million joint modules and 2 million frameless torque motors.
With "stable and reliable, advanced performance" as its core commitment, Joy-Motion is dedicated to becoming the trusted power heart of the global robotics industry.
We consistently adhere to full-stack in-house development of underlying technologies, from motors, drives, reducers, and encoders to joint modules, continuously breaking through performance bottlenecks and benchmarking against top international standards. With leading, controllable, and mass-producible hardcore technologies, we help the robotics industry achieve leapfrog upgrades.
The all-new fourth-generation motors have been iteratively optimized based on the second-generation motors, with torque density increased by 30% and heat dissipation capability improved by 10%. Automated production lines ensure stable delivery, with strict quality control throughout the entire process. Relying on full-stack in-house development capabilities from core components to robot subsystems, we fully meet high-end customized needs.
Based on the full series of second-generation joint modules, we have built a complete set of mature solutions covering quadruped, wheeled, humanoid robots, and dexterous hands, while also providing terminal application products such as compliant robotic arms and Umi grippers. The fully self-developed joint modules are powerful, lightweight, and highly integrated, providing one-stop, highly reliable solutions for embodied intelligent robots.
Joy-Motion has successively passed multiple authoritative quality system certifications and is the first company in the industry to pass the IATF16949 automotive quality management system certification. Some products comply with ASIL B functional safety certification. To date, the company has completed a total of 125 patent applications, including 21 invention patents, 94 utility model patents, and 15 software copyrights.

NOLO is a national‑level high‑tech enterprise with a full‑stack technology portfolio in the field of embodied‑intelligence data infrastructure.

Its self‑developed positioning technologies, including PolarTraq® and StarTraq®, achieve sub‑millimeter‑level accuracy.
To address the core bottleneck of “scarcity of high‑quality data” in embodied intelligence, NOLO has developed a dual‑track (virtual‑physical) data system: the Ego series of wearable data‑acquisition terminals operate independently of the robot itself, enabling “collect while you work”; the Sonic 2 virtual‑physical interaction base embodies one model with dual modes, bridging physical‑robot teleoperation and simulation training, and building a data flywheel of “collection — simulation — training — validation”.

10702.companyProfileEn:
MAXPAL develops smart textile interface materials for brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) and humanoid robotics. Drawing on the metal fiber and textile manufacturing expertise of our Taiwan-based parent company, GO-GO CO., LTD., we combine 316L stainless steel fiber composite conductive textiles with a 3D X-Y textile structure to build the MAXPAL NEUROSKIN smart textile interface materials platform. The material has a resistance of ≤4 Ω and a conductive node density of 300–350 nodes/cm², making textiles a neural interface between people and technology.

For BCI applications, we offer textile electrodes and wearable interface materials for flexible body-device contact, working with partners on bioelectrical signal acquisition and electrical stimulation feedback. For humanoid robots and dexterous hands, we offer flexible conductive coverings and full-coverage conductive gloves. Designed to meet integration needs involving sensors, electronics and algorithms, these materials provide material and structural support for electronic skin, tactile interaction and protective coverings for robots.

Guided by "Start with materials. Prove with data.", we prioritize validation of electrical performance, wash durability, performance under dry, wet and saline conditions, and signal repeatability. We promote collaborative development across materials, manufacturing, textiles, electronics and software.

At CHTF, we showcase materials and application samples for BCIs and humanoid robotics. We welcome equipment manufacturers, R&D teams, research institutions and system integrators to collaborate on material supply, custom components, prototyping and joint R&D.

10746.companyProfileEn:
Timu Technology (Wuhan) Co., Ltd.Founded in August 2025, Timu Technology (Wuhan) Co., Ltd. is a startup high-tech enterprise dedicated to artificial intelligence and embodied intelligent technologies. The company's first self-developed AI hardware product, "Senlin · XiaoMu Robot," comes in two versions: the Standard Companion Edition and the Programming Edition. The Standard Edition targets young adults living alone, families with children, and elderly users. It emphasizes offline usability and privacy protection — equipped with an on-device model and local computing power, it delivers proactive reminders, emotional companionship, and casual conversation even without internet access. Facial recognition, voice data, and dialogue history are all processed locally on the device, ensuring sensitive information never leaves the user's control. The Programming Edition opens up SDK and Python interfaces for universities, training institutions, makers, and developers.
Core technologies include on-device offline multimodal perception, a proprietary proactive companionship decision engine, an editable personality system, 5-degree-of-freedom motion control, and positive psychology-based empathic dialogue. As the AI companion hardware market enters its penetration phase, the mid-range price segment is growing rapidly, yet products combining "offline availability + local privacy + secondary development capability" remain scarce. Compared to cloud-dependent companion products, XiaoMu differentiates itself through "companionship that stays online even when you're offline, data that never leaves your home, and companionship that grows with you," demonstrating significant growth potential.

Powered by self-developed vision algorithms and core flexible gripping technology, our flexible feeding & palletizing robots are compatible with a wide range of special-shaped, thin-walled, scratch-prone and soft deformable parts. Widely deployed across five core industries including 3C Electronics, Electronic Semiconductor, New Energy & Automotive, Precision Hardware Components, and Rubber & Plastics, the robots perform automatic sorting, sequencing, positioning and precision palletizing of workpieces.

Featuring fast product changeover, a single machine can adapt to multiple product specifications. It effectively replaces repetitive manual palletizing work, prevents parts from collision and damage, steadily improves production line uptime and product yield, and helps manufacturers cut costs and raise efficiency.

Centered on customers’ process requirements, we deliver one-stop flexible feeding automation solutions tailored to material characteristics and production line layout. With continuous technological and product iteration, we aim to become a reliable supplier of flexible feeding equipment in intelligent manufacturing, supporting the automation and intelligent upgrading of the manufacturing industry.

10817.companyProfileEn:
Shandong Yinglong Zhilian Additive Technology Co., Ltd. (INLONG), founded in 2012 and headquartered in Qingdao, China, is a comprehensive high-tech enterprise integrating industrial-grade additive manufacturing equipment R&D and manufacturing, high-performance material printing process development, and one-stop additive manufacturing services.
With a total investment of RMB 518 million, the company's Qingdao INLONG Additive Manufacturing Industrial Park (Phase I: approx. 20,000 m²) houses a fully in-house R&D system spanning the entire "materials – equipment – processes – software" workflow, supported by three R&D centers in Qingdao, Nanjing, and Hong Kong. Its flagship VULCAN 600 features a proprietary patented far-infrared heating system that eliminates warping, cracking, and insufficient interlayer strength, making INLONG the world's first company to apply far-infrared heating technology to 3D printing at scale. The independently developed large-format SC12060 employs high-precision closed-loop linear motors for contact-free "zero-transmission" operation, printing carbon fiber and glass fiber reinforced composites as functional end-use components.
Recognized as a National High-Tech Enterprise and a Specialized, Refined, Differentiated, and Innovative Enterprise of Shandong Province, INLONG has passed IATF 16949, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 certifications with 100+ intellectual property rights. The company operates 7×24-hour printing service centers in Beijing, Shanghai, Nanjing, Shenzhen, Chongqing, and Shijiazhuang, plus a pre-sales and after-sales technical center in Shanghai, delivering full life-cycle support through an integrated R&D, technical, and after-sales service system. INLONG serves aerospace, automotive design and manufacturing, drones, intelligent robots, and medical devices, with stable partnerships across leading industry enterprises.

Bessemer (Shanghai) Technology Co., Ltd.
Next-generation robotic drive systems, powering innovation in embodied intelligence.

Through active collaboration with research institutions and industry partners, the company continues to validate its core technologies and advance product commercialization. Bessemer strives to become an innovative and competitive supplier of core robotic drive systems for the era of embodied intelligence.
Powering an Intelligent Future Through Innovation in Robotic Actuation.

10480.companyProfileEn:
FibreSeek's core technology, Composite Fibre Co-extrusion (CFC), utilizes a dual-input, single-output architecture. During the printing process, dry continuous reinforcing fibers are impregnated with a liquid polymer matrix in real time, forming a pre-impregnated strand that is then co-extruded with a thermoplastic filament. This unique in-situ impregnation significantly reduces voids and maximizes the fiber volume ratio, allowing continuous fibers to bear loads along engineered paths. The result is parts with exceptional strength and strength-to-weight ratios that can substitute for specific engineering components.

Building on this foundation, FibreSeek has completely re-engineered the hardware, fiber path planning, slicing software, and material workflows specifically for desktop users. This approach drastically lowers both equipment costs and operational complexity, making industrial-grade continuous fiber printing highly viable for lightweight functional parts, tooling, robotics, and drone components.

在AI训练数据方面，Dataify拥有2000亿+多模态数据记录、1700亿+音视频种子资源、360+成品数据集，涵盖文本、图像、音频、视频、3D及具身智能数据，包括多语种语音、OCR、Agent操作轨迹与视频交互数据，覆盖模型训练全阶段，并针对长尾及特定场景需求提供数据定制与视频数据服务，支持视频搜索、下载与分析。
在Agent实时数据方面，平台通过数据采集API支持批量获取实时原始数据，并推出面向AI Agent的AI Web API，涵盖Search、Extract与Map。Search获取实时Google搜索结果并去重、重排；Extract提取目标URL的清洗后正文；Map发现目标站点内可获取的链接。
AI Web API为Agent提供经去重、相关性重排的海外搜索结果与清洗后的网页正文，减少Agent在检索、访问、解析及内容清洗中的重复处理，为模型理解、推理与回答提供实时数据，降低开发负担与无效Token消耗。
Dataify覆盖大模型训练、多模态生成与理解、具身智能、智能问答、RAG知识更新、舆情监测、竞品研究及行业动态追踪等场景，支撑模型研发、智能应用与业务决策。
灵匠已通过等保二级测评与ISO 9001、ISO/IEC 27001等信息安全管理体系认证，为企业持续提供高质量、可靠的数据服务。

10667.companyProfileEn:
Guangdong Shenzhou Tianji New Energy Development Co., Ltd. was founded in response to the "Full-chain Rectification Action for Electric Bicycle Safety Hazards" deployed by the State Council on April 28, 2024. As a scenario-based application enterprise for lithium-carbon supercapacitors, it was established on July 26, 2024, aiming to fundamentally eliminate the thermal runaway risk of electric bicycle batteries by using inherently safe lithium-carbon supercapacitors to replace traditional chemical batteries.

The self-developed and manufactured lithium-carbon supercapacitor falls into the category of asymmetric supercapacitors, pseudocapacitors and composite capacitors. Its positive electrode adopts lithium battery materials to greatly enhance energy density, while the negative electrode uses supercapacitor materials to guarantee high safety performance. Relying on ion adsorption and the shallow intercalation and deintercalation of lithium ions, the lithium-carbon supercapacitor delivers outstanding comprehensive properties: high safety, high energy density, high-rate charge and discharge, long service life, maintenance-free operation and reliable performance at ultra-low temperatures.

When developing the Tianji battery for electric bicycles to substitute chemical batteries with lithium-carbon supercapacitors, the superior performance of our lithium-carbon supercapacitors drew widespread attention from all sectors of society. At the request of clients, we gradually expanded the application scenarios of lithium-carbon supercapacitors and launched the Tianji Electric Energy product series.

方块海（深圳）网络科技有限公司是一家专注于互动内容与数字娱乐创新的科技企业。团队成员来自游戏行业，拥有丰富的游戏产品研发、互动体验设计与商业化经验。公司以「灵感本应无限生长」为理念，致力于探索创意与数字技术的融合，让更多灵感转化为真实、有趣、值得分享的体验。
旗下核心产品《代号BOX》是一款创新型互动短视频平台。
《代号BOX》 致力于突破传统短视频的单向观看模式，将视频中的人物、场景与物品转化为可点击、可操作、可探索的互动内容。用户可以通过简单的操作触发不同反馈、探索不同结果，亲自参与视频内容的发展，在熟悉的短视频形式中获得全新的互动体验。
平台通过标准化互动模板与模块化创作机制，降低互动内容的生产门槛，让普通创作者也能基于手机拍摄素材，轻松创作和分享互动作品。
《代号BOX》希望连接观看者、内容创作者与互动模板开发者，逐步构建开放的互动内容生态。
公司围绕互动内容平台、创作者工具与商业化服务持续布局，探索品牌互动营销、商家内容展示、创作者激励及平台分成等商业模式，为短视频、数字娱乐及 UGC 内容产业开拓新的体验形态与商业空间。
我们相信，每一个灵感都拥有惊人的可能性。希望那些转瞬即逝的好点子被保存下来，甚至分享给全世界的人，让创造成为每个人触手可及的快乐。
10877.companyProfileEn:
CubeSea (Shenzhen) Network Technology Co., Ltd. is a technology company focused on interactive content and digital entertainment. With a team from the game industry and deep experience in game development, interactive design, and commercialization, we believe inspiration is meant to grow without limits — and we turn ideas into real, fun, shareable experiences.
Our flagship product, Codename BOX, is an innovative interactive short-video platform. It breaks the one-way viewing model of traditional short videos, turning people, scenes, and objects on screen into content users can tap, control, and explore. Simple gestures trigger different responses and outcomes, letting viewers shape how each story unfolds — a brand-new interactive experience in a familiar format.
Through standardized interactive templates and a modular creation system, the platform lowers the barrier to making interactive content, so any creator can produce and share interactive works with just a phone.
Codename BOX connects viewers, creators, and template developers, building an open ecosystem for interactive content. Around the platform, creator tools, and commercialization services, we are developing business models such as interactive brand marketing, merchant showcases, creator incentives, and revenue sharing — opening new possibilities for the short-video, digital entertainment, and UGC industries.
We believe every spark of inspiration holds extraordinary potential. We want fleeting ideas to be captured and shared with the world, making creation a joy within everyone's reach.

10405.companyProfileEn:
Nitto, founded in 1918 and headquartered in Osaka, Japan, is a global functional materials company serving the electronics, semiconductor, automotive, industrial, healthcare, and environmental sectors, with an established business network in China.
Nitto’s strength lies in combining core technologies such as adhesion, coating, polymer function control, and polymer analysis and evaluation to provide material-based solutions for customers. In electronics and semiconductors, Nitto offers functional films, tapes, and process materials that support higher performance, miniaturization, and lighter designs. In automotive and industrial applications, its technologies in adhesion, protection, sealing, insulation, and vibration control help improve product reliability and manufacturing efficiency. Nitto also applies its expertise in polymers, adhesion, and membrane technologies to healthcare, water treatment, and environmental solutions.
Nitto creates value by precisely controlling material properties and interfacial functions and integrating multiple technologies with customers’ applications. As AI, semiconductors, robotics, new energy vehicles, and healthcare continue to evolve, Nitto is exploring new applications for functional materials and, through co-creation with customers and partners, expanding from materials to applications and solutions to create new market value.

10415.companyProfileEn:
Changsha Benmai Information Technology Co., Ltd. is a software-and-hardware integrated company dedicated to AI agent watches. Headquartered in Changsha, Hunan, with R&D centers in Changsha and Shenzhen, it owns the brand CosPi WatchBuddy.
Centered on "putting an AI agent on your wrist," the company independently defines and develops wrist-worn AI terminals. On a multimodal large-model foundation it has built three families of agents — productivity, health and fitness. Capture and local storage happen on the device; inference and multi-agent orchestration run in the cloud, and an open agent platform connects office IM and external service accounts such as Feishu, DingTalk and WeCom. Two models are on sale — Q6 and X9 Ultra, in 46 mm and 49 mm cases — with standalone 4G, GPS/BeiDou, a retractable rotating camera, and heart-rate and blood-oxygen monitoring. One tap of record produces meeting minutes and to-dos and syncs them to the phone.
Across the value chain, the company owns hardware selection, structural definition, system software and agent applications, responding to real-world needs with shorter iteration cycles. Our product logic is simple: get listening, seeing and remembering right first, then let the agent understand and act.
Benmai believes the next generation of personal computing won't live on a screen — it will live on you: AI as a companion that is always there, not an app you open.

In R&D, Midea Electronics is equipped with an internationally advanced digital EDA (Electronic Design Automation) platform for electronic control, and possesses leading-edge capabilities in high-complexity PCB design, consistently solving critical industry challenges. The company has earned multiple international accolades, including recognition as a National High-Tech Enterprise, the Guangdong Provincial Electronic Information Science and Technology Progress Award (First Prize), and an "Internationally Advanced" certification for its technological achievements. To date, it has filed 115 patent applications, with 45 patents granted.
The company holds certifications including IATF 16949 and has established a full-process traceable quality management system — from raw materials to finished products. With advanced process and inspection capabilities such as precision coating, ESD intelligent monitoring, and triple-point verification, the company ensures one-inspection-per-process quality control.

11082.companyProfileEn:
Mindsync Tech is headquartered in Hefei, Anhui, and was established in September 2024. The company is technologically empowered by the USTC Advanced Technology Research Institute and strategically invested and controlled by Jiangsu Leili Motor (300660), a listed leader in the micro-motor industry, together with its holding subsidiary Jiangsu DINGS Technology.
The company focuses on industrial dexterous manipulation and embodied AI solutions. In terms of product portfolio, starting with mass-produced anthropomorphic five-fingered dexterous hands, it has expanded into robotic arms, humanoid robots, and intelligent algorithms and control systems, covering three core technology routes: linkage-driven, tendon-driven, and direct-drive. In parallel, the company has developed the "Mindsync MECA" — with the Mindsync VLA Model and Mindsync Data Collection Platform forming the decision-making layer, responsible for task understanding and strategy planning; and the dexterous hand motion control system and force control algorithms forming the control layer, responsible for millisecond-level motion execution and force feedback. The two layers work in synergy to deliver a full-stack "Mechanics + Hardware + Algorithms" architecture.
To date, the company's products have been deployed in real-world industrial scenarios including chemical hazardous sampling, precision motor assembly, and intelligent power operations, with cumulative shipments exceeding 1,000 units across more than 10 industrial sectors. Mindsync Tech is one of the very few independent integrators in China with full "hand-to-brain" stack capability, serial production capacity, and integrated batch delivery capability for industrial-grade dexterous hands.

Ionic Wind 是来自瑞士、依托苏黎世联邦理工学院（ETH Zurich）的深科技初创企业。我们研发了一款全新的电子散热方案：摒弃机械风扇，采用纯电驱动的先进促动器实现空气流动。依靠电场带动空气运动，无旋转部件、无磨损、无噪音。该散热方案静音、无振动，结构轻薄，可应用在传统风扇无法安装的狭小空间。
产品首批应用场景为激光器、光学设备等高精密仪器 —— 这类设备对极其微小的振动都十分敏感。后续将拓展至小型电子设备、航空、笔记本电脑以及数据中心领域。
公司 2025 年在瑞士圣加仑成立，技术积淀来自十余年经过同行评审的科研成果，目前正处于产品开发阶段。本次参加高交会（CHTF），我们希望寻找制造、落地应用以及试点合作方。
10874.companyProfileEn: Ionic Wind is an ETH Zurich deep-tech startup from Switzerland. We have developed a new way to cool electronics: instead of a mechanical fan, we use advanced actuators based solely on electricity to move air. An electric field sets the air in motion, so nothing spins, wears out or makes noise. The result is cooling that is silent, vibration-free and thin enough to fit where a fan cannot. Our first applications are high-precision instruments such as lasers and optical equipment, where even the smallest vibration matters. Compact electronics, aviation, laptops and data centres follow. Founded in 2025 in St. Gallen (Switzerland), Ionic Wind builds on more than ten years of peer-reviewed scientific research and is currently in product development. At CHTF we are looking for manufacturing, deployment and pilot partners.

10776.companyProfileEn:
AQUAGENA Environmental Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd.​ specializes in electrochemical treatment and zero-liquid discharge (ZLD) water-saving technologies for industrial cooling water systems. The company served as the leading drafting unit for the group standard T/CIESC 72—2024: Technical Specification for Electrochemical Bypass Treatment of Recirculating Cooling Water, and co-compiled T/CECS 646—2019 alongside COFCO Engineering & Technology.

AQUAGENA has pioneered the SICCAVA™​ integrated process, featuring three synergistic units: the Composite Evaporative Cooler, the ECT Electrochemical Bypass, and the ZEFERA™ aerodynamic-assisted evaporation system. Operating entirely without corrosion inhibitors, scale inhibitors, or biocides, this innovative process elevates the spray water concentration ratio to over 40 and eliminates end-of-pipe liquid discharge. These solutions are widely deployed in mission-critical sectors including data centers, coal chemical plants, and power generation facilities.

11005.companyProfileEn:
Shenzhen Miracle Smart Network Co., Ltd. (7G Smart for short) is a national single-item champion for edge intelligent computing products and a specialist in industry AI transformation solutions. Focused on fully domestic TPU edge intelligent computing, sensing-computing integrated products and toolchains, it delivers intelligence for urban, natural and industrial spaces, providing AI scenario services featuring on-site unattended operation, non-intrusive user experience, autonomous system execution and continuous capability iteration.

Guided by its vision of “Empowering Physical AI with Edge Intelligent Computing”, 7G Smart develops tiered computing hardware including TPU Edge-Lite, Edge-Mid and Edge-Max. It has built integrated capabilities covering sensing, communication, computing, positioning and security: coordinated scheduling of edge computing and power supply, plug-and-play IoT perception, self-evolving scenario algorithms, vertical model distillation and fine-tuning tools, flexible multi-agent collaborative workflows, and a national cryptography-based data security system. The company supplies new AI infrastructure for urban, natural and industrial spaces with easy deployment, autonomous operation and scalable learning, enabling a data flywheel for Physical AI through the sensing-computing loop, training loop and feedback loop.
- The sensing-computing loop enables data collection, automatic annotation and real-time inference.
- The training loop supports scheduled pre-training, periodic distillation of vertical models, algorithm self-evolution and complex reasoning.
- The feedback loop drives continuous model iteration via human-machine collaboration, online upgrades and fine-tuning.

Founded in 2017, Shenzhen Yufan Microelectronics Co., Ltd. is a technology service provider and resource integrator specializing in MCUs and co-packaged chips for the consumer electronics market. Built around three core lines — custom co-packaging, MCU selection and supply, and hardware/software application solution development — the Company helps customers shorten the chip–PCBA–mass production cycle for lower costs, higher efficiency and reliable delivery. It is committed to becoming a comprehensive technology enterprise with one of the world's most complete consumer electronics MCU industry chains, bringing manufacturers more innovative MCU solutions, serving the end-user market better, and creating smarter living through the power of chips. Under its strategy for the next three to five years, the Company will focus on embedded AI hardware and systematically build a comprehensive service platform for the industry chain.
Since its founding, Yufan Microelectronics has continued to deepen its industry presence, providing full-chain design services covering Nyquest and Puya wafer supply, custom co-packaging and MCU application solution development. Its MCUs have passed SGS testing and RoHS certification, and AQL sampling inspection shows a pass rate as high as 99.97%. Beyond China, its customers reach across the globe, with partners and local teams in Malaysia, Germany, Russia, the United States and other countries.

Currently under construction, S³FEL will provide advanced experimental capabilities for frontier research.
The Shenzhen Superconducting Soft X-ray Free Electron Laser (S³FEL) is a new-generation large-scale scientific facility for X-ray coherent light sources. Based on superconducting high-frequency technology, S³FEL is a high-repetition-rate X-ray free-electron laser facility featuring high brightness, ultrashort pulses, high coherence, and continuously tunable wavelengths. It enables nondestructive, time-resolved observation of atomic, molecular, and outer-shell electron structures on the femtosecond timescale, serving as a “high-speed camera” for scientists to investigate the microscopic structure of matter and its dynamic evolution.
The Advanced Scientific Instruments Regional Technology Transfer and Industrialization Center (Shenzhen) /ASIC-SZ was approved by the Ministry of Education in April 2025. Located in Guangming Science City, Shenzhen, and based at the Institute of Advanced Light Source Facilities, Shenzhen (IASF), it is dedicated to advancing the commercialization of scientific and technological achievements from universities.
ASIC-SZ will bring together universities and research institutes with strengths in scientific instrumentation, accelerate the development of domestically produced high-end scientific instruments, and promote closer integration between university research and regional industries.

ASR：基于开源语音识别基座，针对通话等业务场景做微调（Fine-tune），再用自研脚本完成量化（Quantization）与模型导出，形成不同算力档对应的自有端侧 ASR 模型（如 Q4KM / Q6_K 等量化版本）；支持真流式（Streaming ASR）-固定声学窗持续解码，边说边上字，而不是说完再整段离线转写
LLM：基于开源大模型基座，用约四万条业务语料做监督微调（SFT），再量化导出为端侧可运行的模型包（MNN 部署形态），对齐通话摘要、待办/时间实体抽取、联系人沟通进度归纳、本地知识库 RAG（检索增强生成）等垂直任务，提升的是格式服从度与业务可用性，而非泛化闲聊。

While others build “recording tools,” we build “deal-closing tools.” Aimed at business and working professionals (sales, business development, consultants, lawyers, financial practitioners and others), the headset acts as an entry point that converts speech from calls, meetings and on-site conversations into customer records, sales leads and follow-up to-dos in real time, so that users can “hear clearly, remember reliably, follow up in time and close the deal.”
Our Core Technologies
1.  Proprietary On-Device Model: AW-Voice-1.0
ASR:  Built on an open-source speech-recognition foundation model and fine-tuned for business scenarios such as phone calls, then quantized and exported with our own tooling to produce proprietary on-device ASR models for different compute tiers (Q4KM, Q6_K and other quantized versions). It supports true streaming ASR — continuous decoding over a fixed acoustic window, transcribing as the user speaks rather than performing a full offline transcription after the fact.
LLM:  Built on an open-source large-model foundation, supervised fine-tuned (SFT) on approximately 40,000 business-domain samples, then quantized and exported as an on-device model package deployed in MNN format. It is aligned to vertical tasks such as call summarization, to-do and time-entity extraction, contact-communication progress summarization, and local knowledge-base RAG (retrieval-augmented generation). What it improves is format compliance and business usability, not general-purpose chit-chat.

Maiweier (Linyi) Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd. remains steadfast in its core philosophy: "Empowering intelligent entities through precision manufacturing." 10993.companyProfileEn:
JX Intelligence is a leading force in the large-scale adoption of Physical AI in China, dedicated to building a “General-Purpose Cross-Embodiment Physical AI Brain” for the real world. Leveraging a fully self-developed technology stack, the company uses industrial environments as its primary proving ground to accelerate the real-world application and scaled deployment of Physical AI.
This architecture consists of JX-Phi Brain, a general cross-embodiment Physical AI brain, and JX-Phi World, a closed-loop data infrastructure. The former covers the entire "perception-understanding-decision-execution" pipeline, capable of driving various embodiments such as drones, quadruped robots, and humanoid robots, while adapting to diverse industrial tasks and complex environments. The latter is built upon real industrial data, physical robot data, and a world model simulation engine, continuously training and iterating the foundational model to drive its evolution in real-world applications.
The company's solutions have been deployed across over 1,000 industrial sites, covering key sectors such as renewable energy, power grids, oil and gas, chemicals, and rail transit. Its core team comprises top-tier global talent, combining cutting-edge technical expertise with extensive industry experience. Building on eight years of industry dedication, the company has established long-term partnerships with leading institutions and strategic industrial partners, including Sequoia China, Lenovo Capital, and CATL.

Our facility houses a modification laboratory, pelletizing lines and multiple injection molding machines, enabling custom material formulas and performance specs tailored to clients’ application scenarios.

We have established a full industrial chain spanning modified plastics, lamp housings and mold development. Our products are well received by customers worldwide.

10985.companyProfile:
一、核心定位：“太空4S店”
未来宇航以“太空4S店”为核心定位，面向卫星“研制—发射—入轨—在轨—应用”全生命周期提供一站式空间服务，由卫星在轨交付与在轨服务两大业务板块构成：在轨交付覆盖卫星研制、发射适配、测运控与数据应用，在轨服务覆盖在轨维修、燃料加注、轨道碎片清除与在轨延寿。公司以“实业+投资”双轮驱动，是国内商业航天率先实现全产业链闭环的产业公司。
二、在轨交付业务
公司整合商业航天上下游产业链与供应链资源，构建一站式在轨交付体系：从卫星平台与载荷研制、发射机会匹配与适配、入轨部署与测运控，到数据接收与应用，客户提出任务目标即可获得端到端交付。公司已完成多个星座项目交付，覆盖多轨道、多相位组网需求。
三、锋行系列空间飞行器
FX-1：国内首个、全球第三个服务于卫星组网发射和在轨服务的商业飞行器，面向近地轨道多星部署的低成本轨道转移飞行器，解决“一次发射、多目标轨道”痛点。面向300kg至4000kg级任务，具备8颗20kg级微纳卫星承载与多轨道多相位部署能力；负载能力≥200kg、在轨寿命≥3 年、供电能力≥600W。采用模块化设计，分系统集成度高、整器轻量化；使用绿色四氧化二氮 / 甲基肼推进剂；适配长征、朱雀、引力等多型火箭。可拓展空间目标观测、碎片清除、在轨延寿等任务。
FX-2：高轨道机动平台，面向低轨至地球同步轨道、低轨至地月转移等高轨与深空运输需求，与 FX-1 共同构成“LEO→GTO→GEO→深空”全轨道运输体系，以“太空摆渡”解决太空运输最后一公里。
四、公司布局
公司已在北京、上海、雄安、西安、深圳、合肥、海口设立办公室。雄安新区建有国内首个商业空间飞行器总装厂房，面积5000平方米，配备自动化总装产线，具备全流程能力，规划年产能60台；承担锋行系列总体组装与关键系统测试，形成“雄安研发、雄安制造、雄安交付、雄安生态”格局。
10985.companyProfileEn:
1. Core Positioning: “Space 4S Store”
FutureSpace is positioned as a “Space 4S Store,” delivering one-stop space services across the satellite lifecycle: development, launch, orbit insertion, in-orbit operation and application. Two pillars underpin the model: in-orbit delivery (satellite development, launch adaptation, TT&C and data applications) and in-orbit servicing (on-orbit maintenance, refueling, space-debris removal and life extension). Driven by industry and investment, the company is among the first in China's commercial space sector to achieve a full-value-chain closed loop.
2. In-Orbit Delivery
The company integrates upstream and downstream resources across the industry and supply chains into a one-stop turnkey solution: from satellite platform and payload development, launch opportunity matching and adaptation, in-orbit deployment and TT&C, to data reception and application. Customers set mission objectives and receive end-to-end delivery. Multiple constellation projects have been delivered, covering multi-orbit and multi-phased deployment.
3. FutureX Series Orbital Transfer Vehicles
FX-1: China's first and the world's third commercial space vehicle for constellation deployment and in-orbit servicing, and a low-cost orbital transfer vehicle for LEO multi-satellite deployment addressing the “one launch, multiple target orbits” challenge. For 300–4,000 kg missions, it carries and deploys up to eight 20 kg-class micro-satellites across multiple orbits and phases. Payload capacity ≥200 kg, in-orbit lifetime ≥3 years, power supply ≥600 W. Modular design, highly integrated subsystems and lightweight structure; green NTO/MMH propellant; compatible with Long March, Zhuque and Yinli; extendable to space object observation, debris removal and life extension.
FX-2: A high-orbit maneuvering platform for LEO-to-GEO and LEO-to-lunar-transfer missions. With FX-1, it forms a full-orbit system spanning LEO–GTO–GEO–deep space, acting as a “space ferry” for the last mile of space transportation.
4. Company Footprint
FutureSpace operates offices in Beijing, Shanghai, Xiong'an, Xi'an, Shenzhen, Hefei and Haikou. In Xiong'an New Area, China's first commercial space-vehicle final assembly plant: 5,000 square meters, automated assembly line, full-process capability, planned annual capacity of 60 units. It undertakes overall assembly and key system testing of the FutureX series, under the pattern of “R&D, manufacturing, delivery and ecosystem in Xiong'an.”

10934.companyProfileEn:
Guangzhou Motion Throttle Drone Racing Co. Ltd (MTDR), also known as the Guangzhou Xueersi Drone Competition Team, focuses on youth drone-racing training. Founded in 2023, it has a well-established core team and steady business growth, with outstanding results in district, municipal, provincial and national competitions.
Catering to teenagers aged 7–17, its five-level progressive curriculum takes beginners to competition readiness within three months. Courses run from introductory science, basic flight operation, FPV control and track assembly to specialised competition training and intensive elite coaching, suiting learners at different proficiency levels. Elite small classes with a 1:4 teacher-student ratio ensure sufficient individual guidance.
A complete competition pathway covers Ministry of Education whitelist events, provincial aeromodeling championships, National Games trials, national team selections and the Drone World Cup. Whitelist results can serve as references for comprehensive quality evaluation and support tech-talented students. In 2024–2025, all participants won municipal and provincial awards, gaining numerous certificates. Many earned provincial and district championships; some joined the Guangdong National Games trials and national team selections, others competed at the Drone World Cup, and several obtained aeromodel athlete certificates.
Drone training builds concentration, hand-eye coordination and spatial awareness while integrating STEM knowledge such as aerodynamics, mechanical structures and programming. Young learners gain confidence through preparation and competition and enjoy tech-themed parent-child interaction. With systematic, scientific training, the institution helps teenagers push their limits and fly higher and further.

目前，复旦大学有院（系）41个，附属医院17家。学校设有本科专业87个，拥有一级学科博士学位授权点46个，一级学科硕士学位授权点49个（含一级学科博士学位授权点），博士专业学位授权点10个，硕士专业学位授权点41个，博士后科研流动站39个。在校普通本科生16101人，在校研究生37975人（含全日制和非全日制的大陆港澳台生），学历留学生2190人。在校教学科研人员3711人。中国科学院、中国工程院院士47人（含双聘、退休），文科资深教授31人，哲学社会科学领域专业技术一级岗位教师9人，获得各类国家级人才计划1076人。
复旦大学拥有世界一流的办学声誉，国际声誉进入世界前30，居内地高校第3位。在全国第五轮一级学科评估中建设成效显著提升。文、社、理、工、医五大学科门类均进入世界前100。第二轮“双一流”建设以来，学校率先启动建设全国首个“交叉学科”门类一级学科集成电路科学与工程。13个学科入选上海市高峰学科建设。
10578.companyProfileEn:
The name "Fudan University" is derived in Shangshu Dazhuan (Extended Commentary on the Book of Documents), meaning "The sun and moon shine brightly, and the morning dawns anew each day." Founded in 1905 as Fudan Public School, the institution was officially renamed Fudan University in 1917. It was the first institution of higher education independently established by Chinese people. Shanghai Medical University originated from the Medical College of the National Fourth Sun Yat-sen University, founded in 1927. In 2000, Fudan University merged with Shanghai Medical University. Today, the University encompasses 12 broad academic disciplines: Philosophy, Economics, Law, Education, Literature, History, Science, Engineering, Medicine, Management, Arts, and Interdisciplinary Studies. In 2021, 20 disciplines at Fudan University were selected for the second round of China's "Double First-Class" Initiative, an increase of three disciplines compared with the first round.

Fudan University enjoys a world-class academic reputation, ranking among the world's top 30 universities in international reputation and third among universities in mainland China. The University has demonstrated significant improvements in the fifth round of China's national first-level discipline evaluation. Its five major academic fields—Humanities, Social Sciences, Natural Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine—are all ranked among the world's top 100. Since the launch of the second round of the "Double First-Class" Initiative, Fudan University has taken the lead in establishing Integrated Circuit Science and Engineering, China's first first-level discipline under the newly established category of Interdisciplinary Studies. Thirteen disciplines have been selected for Shanghai's Peak Discipline Development Program.

Through a portfolio of intelligent hardware that supports round-the-clock learning scenarios, we redefine growth companionship in the AI era.

Tongwuji’s mission goes far beyond creating a single learning product. We are building a fully self-controllable AI School Operating System, reshaping the underlying logic of education with AI, so that every child can grow at their own pace.

Saluentra Medical Technology Co., Ltd.
Founded in 2018 in Zhongguancun, Beijing, Saluentra focuses on early screening of upper gastrointestinal cancers. Its proprietary AICAM ultra-miniature dual-control capsule endoscope is the world’s first system combining magnetic navigation and tethered drive. Real-time megapixel imaging achieves over 96% sensitivity and specificity for full visualization of the esophagus, stomach and duodenum. The compact 0.6 ㎡ console works in standard clinics.

Saluentra undertakes national key R&D projects and is a Specialized & Innovative Enterprise. AICAM received Beijing’s “New Technology, New Product, New Service” certification in 2026. More than 600 million Chinese aged 45+ are high-risk patients, while screening rates remain low.

AICAM serves hospitals, wellness centers and primary care settings. Saluentra aims to make upper GI screening as accessible as ultrasound, raising the early diagnosis rate of gastric and esophageal cancers from ~20% to over 50%.

11135.companyProfileEn:
SHENZHEN PiQNANO TECH CO., LTD., founded in 2013, is a National High-Tech Enterprise and one of China's pioneering teams in immersion-type PCBA moisture protection technology. Headquartered in Longhua District, Shenzhen, the company has focused on the R&D, production, and application of electronic protection nanomaterials for more than a decade. Serving hundreds of corporate customers, its products are widely used in consumer electronics, automotive electronics, new-energy storage, industrial control, communications and IoT, power equipment, and special equipment.

PiQNANO's core products are electronic protection nano coatings, fluoropolymer electronic coatings, and nano conformal coatings, with perfluoroalkyl acrylate polymer as the main component. Unlike Parylene and other vacuum vapor deposition technologies, PiQNANO adopts a liquid spray-type fluorinated nano coating approach. The coating is only microns thick and offers waterproofing, moisture resistance, corrosion resistance, and salt-spray resistance, while also providing process advantages such as connector mask-free application, room-temperature curing, and no impact on heat dissipation or conductivity—enabling seamless integration into customers' existing production lines.

The company's product portfolio covers two major technical routes: hydrophobic and superhydrophobic. The S Series hydrophobic coatings achieve a contact angle above 110 degrees, making them suitable for demanding conditions such as outdoor industrial control, energy storage, and automotive-grade applications. The U15 Series superhydrophobic coatings exceed a 140-degree contact angle, with water droplets beading and rolling off the surface. A fluorescent indicator version, U15-UVY, enables "inspectable and traceable" coating quality. In addition, the company is expanding into new materials such as liquid-cooling fluorinated fluids for data center cooling, seizing the window of import substitution.

Technology is the foundation of PiQNANO. The company has built a complete patent portfolio around superhydrophobic and electronic protection technologies. Its core invention patent, "A Composite Material with Superhydrophobic Coating and Its Preparation Method," was filed in 2013 and granted in 2021 after rigorous substantive examination. Meanwhile, the company collaborates with universities such as Shandong University of Technology to translate cutting-edge materials research into scalable production formulations, continuously driving technological iteration.

But what Zhongcheng Wisdom is building goes beyond individual 3D printing machines.
Our long-term vision is to use proprietary industrial jetting technology as the foundation for integrating equipment, materials, software, processes, and manufacturing data into an continuously evolving digital manufacturing technology ecosystem—and to extend these capabilities into a broader range of advanced manufacturing applications.

ABR develops remanufactured cathode materials (NCM, LFP, and LCO) and anode materials (graphite and LTO), as well as second-life solutions and technologies that harness the remaining value of EV batteries.

By connecting battery reuse, material regeneration, and resource recovery, ABR aims to establish a circular battery value chain. Through this battery industry exhibition, ABR seeks to expand technical exchanges and explore business partnerships with battery manufacturers, material suppliers, and recycling companies in China and around the world.

Since 2022, it has been jointly run by Beijing Graphene Technology Research Institute and Jinjiang Municipal Government as an innovative R&D and pilot testing institute.
Guided by the innovation-driven development strategy, FGI promotes the R&D, commercialization and industrialization of graphene and other new materials. It helps upgrade traditional industries and bridges the innovation chain from laboratory samples to marketable commodities, acting as a vital platform to empower industries and develop new-quality productive forces.
Endowed with core strengths in independent R&D and scenario application, FGI centers on technical and commercial pilot testing while pooling new-material technologies and industrial resources. Following market demands, it targets high-quality living needs and private enterprises’ innovation requirements, focusing on advanced footwear and apparel materials, green low-carbon technologies, medical-engineering materials, electronic information and new energy.
FGI has set up industry-university-research incubation platforms and postgraduate training bases with universities, and built joint laboratories with enterprises across China. It has developed proprietary technologies and products for pharmaceuticals, environmental protection, footwear and apparel, microbiology and brewing sectors, including graphene-modified TPU, carbon fiber composite, polyurethane sponge and purification materials, graphene-coated pharmaceutical packaging materials, as well as anaerobic ammonium oxidation autotrophic nitrogen removal technology.
These outcomes facilitate the regional application of core technologies, enhance scenario deployment capabilities, deepen the integration of science and industry, and cultivate new growth engines for local industries.

10918.companyProfile:
珠海跃嘉俊科技有限公司是一家以“对话记忆”为核心的 AI 技术公司，同时也是 Hera AI 在中国的运营与研发主体。公司立足珠海，面向全球，致力于解决一个普遍却长期被忽视的问题：人们在对话中往往需要在“专注在场”和“记住细节”之间做取舍，而事后回溯又依赖模糊的印象或零散的笔记。

公司的使命是让每一段值得留存的对话都成为可检索、可调用、可行动的知识，而不是录音文件里沉睡的音频。围绕这一目标，团队选择了一条“硬件极简、AI 做重”的路径：设备只负责可靠地采集声音，复杂的工作，包括逐字稿、摘要、决策提取、待办识别和源头追溯，交给云端与端侧协同的 AI 系统完成。产品形态只是载体，真正构建壁垒的是对“对话如何转化为后续行动”这一链条的持续打磨。

团队采取小规模、高密度的组建方式，成员覆盖硬件工程、语音 AI、产品设计与国际化运营，强调每个人对端到端结果负责，而非局限于单一职能。公司自成立起即以全球市场为默认视野，在产品定义、隐私控制和跨场景适配上同步考虑不同市场的合规习惯与使用方式。
10918.companyProfileEn:
Zhuhai Yuejiajun Technology Co., Ltd. is the China-based operating and R&D entity behind Hera AI, an AI company built around conversational memory. Headquartered in Zhuhai, the company serves a global market and addresses a trade-off most people accept without question: staying fully present in a conversation versus retaining its details. Hera' s mission is to turn conversations worth keeping into searchable, callable knowledge—not audio files that never get revisited.

The team pursues a “minimal hardware, heavy AI” approach: devices capture sound reliably, while the AI system handles transcription, summarization, decision extraction, action-item detection and source traceability. The product is the vehicle; the real asset is a continuously refined pipeline that connects what was said to what should happen next.

The team is deliberately small and dense, spanning hardware engineering, speech AI, product design and international operations, with each member owning end-to-end outcomes rather than a narrow function. Global market is the default from day one, reflected in product definition, privacy controls and cross-market compliance.

10971.companyProfileEn:
XJTS, founded in March 2022 and based in Guiyang, is a national high-tech enterprise covering power semiconductor chip design, packaging, testing and reliability validation. With subsidiaries in Beijing and Shandong and a core team from China's National Science and Technology Major Projects, it runs power device, component testing and reliability service lines.
Power devices form the core business. An ISO Class 7 cleanroom packaging and test line of over 5,000 m² with an annual capacity of 12 million units produces IGBT and SiC MOSFET discretes and modules from 650 V to 3,300 V. The internally insulated IGBT discretes withstand 4,000 V at device level and have passed LG's global type test in Korea, making XJTS one of only two qualified suppliers alongside Infineon. The devices serve aviation, naval, ordnance and aero-engine applications and new energy and industrial markets, and are pin-to-pin compatible with Infineon equivalents.
XJTS also develops IGBT and SiC gate driver boards that, with DC-link capacitor boards and power switch modules, form one-stop 3–50 kW motor-drive solutions for mainstream packages such as HPD and EconoDUAL.
Reliability testing is provided by Shandong Xinsaisi, whose 2,500 m² CNAS-accredited, CMA-certified laboratory in Weihai offers automotive-grade AEC-Q101 and AQG 324 testing of IGBTs, MOSFETs and SiC devices — static, dynamic and thermal parameters plus electrical, thermal and mechanical stress tests — and issues third-party reports.
Belief reliability prediction is a key capability: with Beihang University, XJTS has established a Joint Laboratory for Belief Reliability, applying accelerated degradation testing and modeling to extrapolate power-device service life with in-house assessment software — moving evaluation beyond pass/fail qualification to quantified service life.
XJTS serves the equipment manufacturing and new energy industries, advancing domestic alternatives to imported power devices.

11000.companyProfileEn:
Nova Fusion Energy Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. (NovaFusionX) was established in 2025, led by Professor H.Y. Guo, the founder of the FRC-SMR (Field-Reversed Configuration Small Modular Reactor) technology roadmap. The company is committed to being the first to solve the AI-era energy bottleneck with FRC-SMR.
Its core product, "Nova One," is China's first FRC-SMR experimental device. The prototype measures 19 meters in length, weighs 35 tons, and is located in Shanghai Lingang. Leveraging the inherent high-beta property of FRC (the ratio of plasma pressure to magnetic field pressure), FRC-SMR integrates core technologies including magneto-inertial compression and direct energy conversion, lowering the net electricity generation threshold to a Q value of approximately 1.5. It is expected to achieve grid-connected commercialization within 5–10 years, precisely matching the five critical demands of AI data centers: high power density, continuous and stable supply, flexible urban deployment, zero carbon emissions, and competitive cost of electricity.
The company has already achieved domestic production of four core components that were previously subject to foreign monopoly, and is now racing toward engineering milestones. Since its founding, NovaFusionX has completed three funding rounds totaling RMB 2.4 billion, with a post-money valuation exceeding RMB 10 billion. NovaFusionX is committed to powering infinite computing with the light of fusion — Fusion for AI & Beyond.

With air-pump oscillometric technology, it reaches ±3 mmHg accuracy. It features an AI health assistant, 4G standalone calling, BeiDou+GPS positioning and one-touch SOS, forming a “monitoring – analysis – intervention” closed loop.
We also offer a 15-day CGM continuous glucose monitor (no fingertip calibration, real-time alerts) and a smart health ring for 24h blood oxygen, heart rate, atrial fibrillation, stress and emotion assessment. Nearly 80% of our core team are R&D engineers.
We master full-chain capabilities including chip design, medical sensing, AI algorithms and medical device manufacturing. Our portfolio covers self-developed chips, 52 patents (7 invention patents) and 19 software copyrights.
Certified in 2025, our products are selected into the MIIT Elderly Products Catalogue and awarded at the China Hi-Tech Fair. Our partners include Longgang health authorities, hospitals, community centers, CUHK(SZ), telecom operators, pharmacy chains and e-commerce platforms.
Our benchmark Longgang “Health Authority–Enterprise Integration” Model links wearables to the Longgang Family Doctor platform. Authorized health data is auto-shared with family doctors for chronic disease management. The first service site launched in June 2026. We also roll out operator all-in-one packages and build an AI health ecosystem with partners to empower grassroots healthcare.
Xincore focuses on medical-grade wearables for public health, providing accurate, smart home monitoring services for families.
