Bange County Jinshi Yuyuan
Jade Development Co., Ltd.
Established in 2016, Bange County Jinshi Yuyuan Jade Development Co., Ltd. is a leading enterprise supporting rural revitalization and industrial development in Bange County. The company independently owns a Bange jade mine and a processing base, and its Bange jade products sell well both within and outside the Tibet Autonomous Region.
The company's cashmere quilt factory makes full use of local Sewa sheep and yak down resources and actively processes agricultural and livestock products. It has engaged a team led by Dr. Yang Xizi, who holds a PhD in biochemistry from The Chinese University of Hong Kong, to carry out a series of research projects, including low-temperature, environmentally friendly enzymatic fiber scouring; lanolin recovery from wool-scouring wastewater; and the production of water-retaining ecological mats from waste wool. Patent applications for these technologies are currently being prepared.
The company has introduced advanced yak down and cashmere processing technologies and production equipment to produce a range of high-quality cashmere quilts and yak down quilts under the Jinzhi Rongye brand. These products are lightweight, soft, comfortable and warm. The raw materials undergo cleaning, combing, scouring, mercerization, softening, mothproofing and degreasing, resulting in cashmere that is white, soft, odorless, fluffy and hypoallergenic.
Jinzhi Rongye of Bange County brought its wool quilts to the agricultural expo in Hangzhou, Zhejiang. The quilts are made with fine wool from Bange Sewa sheep, a geographical-indication product originating on the pristine, pollution-free snowy plateau at an altitude of 4,750 meters. The quilts won a Gold Award at the Hangzhou Agricultural Expo in 2023.

10939.companyProfile:
山西福米克能源科技有限公司是一家面向新型能源技术及液态储氢载体应用领域开展产业布局的科技企业，重点关注氢能储运、绿色液体燃料、工业气体资源化利用及分布式能源应用等方向。
公司立足山西能源产业基础和煤化工资源优势，积极探索工业富余氢气、二氧化碳等资源的高价值利用路径，重点关注以甲酸为代表的液态储氢载体及其绿色燃料供应链建设。
甲酸作为一种常温下呈液态的有机化合物，具有储存、运输方式灵活等特点，可通过催化反应释放氢气。与此同时，利用二氧化碳加氢合成甲酸，也为工业碳资源利用及液态储氢载体生产提供了新的技术路径。
公司与广东即氢科技有限公司开展产业协同，结合甲酸催化制氢、燃料电池及终端能源应用技术，探索从上游燃料供应到下游移动式、分布式供能的产业链衔接。
相关技术已在低空经济领域展会开展联合展示，并围绕无人机、轻型交通工具、便携式发电及离网能源等应用方向持续推进技术交流与工程化验证。
未来，山西福米克将依托山西氢能及煤化工产业资源条件，重点探索液态储氢载体供应链、工业副产资源利用和绿色燃料产业合作，为新型氢能应用提供上游燃料及产业资源支持，推动山西能源产业优势与新型终端能源技术协同发展。
10939.companyProfileEn:
Formic Energy Technology (Shanxi) Co., Ltd. is a technology enterprise developing its industrial footprint in new energy technologies and the application of liquid organic hydrogen carriers (LOHCs). The company focuses on hydrogen storage and transportation, green liquid fuels, resource utilization of industrial gases, and distributed energy applications.
Grounded in Shanxi’s energy industry base and its advantages in coal chemical resources, the company actively explores high-value utilization pathways for industrial surplus hydrogen, carbon dioxide, and other resources. It places particular emphasis on building a supply chain for LOHCs represented by formic acid and for green fuels derived from them.
The company collaborates with Guangdong Jiqing Technology Co., Ltd. on industrial synergy, combining catalytic hydrogen production from formic acid, fuel cells, and end-use energy application technologies to explore industrial-chain linkages from upstream fuel supply to downstream mobile and distributed energy supply.
The relevant technologies have been jointly exhibited at exhibitions in the low-altitude economy sector, and the company continues to advance technical exchanges and engineering validation in application areas such as unmanned aerial vehicles, light vehicles, portable power generation, and off-grid energy.
In the future, Formic Energy will leverage Shanxi’s resource conditions in hydrogen energy and the coal chemical industry, focusing on exploring LOHC supply chains, utilization of industrial by-product resources, and cooperation in the green fuel industry. It aims to provide upstream fuel and industrial resource support for new hydrogen energy applications and to promote coordinated development between Shanxi’s energy industry advantages and new end-use energy technologies.

ANHUI RAYCON-TECH CO.,LTD is a National Key Specialized, Sophisticated, Unique and Innovative "Little Giant" Enterprise and National High-tech Enterprise. It mainly provides customers with precision optomechanical products and technical solutions characterized by high precision and high dynamic performance.
The company has developed a product matrix at three tiers: unit-level (high-precision sensors), component-level (precision beam control assemblies including fast steering mirrors), and system-level (laser counter-UAV systems, optoelectronic radars, precision turntables, etc.). Its products are widely used in optoelectronic measurement & control, low-altitude security, space exploration, laser communication, precision manufacturing and other sectors.
Founded in 2018, RAYCON-TECH was formerly BEIJING RAYCON-TECH CO., LTD. In September 2023, the company relocated to Luyang District, Hefei, forming a dual-drive operation structure with Beijing and Hefei bases.

二十余年深耕积淀，公司始终秉持“技术领先、品质至上”的发展理念，持续深耕精密控温算法、全域温场校准、极限工况适配、安全防护体系及本土化服务体系的迭代优化，产品综合性能、运行稳定性、测试精度及全周期服务能力，已全面突破行业传统设备性能边界。整机可靠性、测试精准度与安全防护标准，对标德国韦思、日本爱斯佩克、日立等国际一线进口品牌，完全适配高端制造严苛的试验与认证规范，可全方位实现高端试验设备进口品牌、传统台系主流品牌的优质国产化替代，广泛赋能汽车电子、新能源锂电、半导体元器件、5G通讯、AI服务器、光电显示、医疗电子、消费电子、航空军工等高端领域，是多精密制造细分赛道的可靠性测试引领企业。
公司产品包括：高低温（湿热）试验箱，快速温变试验箱，冷热冲击试验箱，高低温低气压试验箱，温湿度结合振动试验箱及其它非标定制气候环境模拟试验箱; 跌落/拉力/插拔力及其它非标定制机械环境模拟试验机。
11601.companyProfileEn:
Shenzhen Dingzhun Electronics Co., Ltd.  Founded in 2005 in Bao’an, Shenzhen, Dingzhun Electronics is a 12-year consecutive National High-Tech Enterprise and 6-year consecutive Shenzhen “Specialized, Refined, Differential and Innovative” (SRDI) SME.
With 21 years of dedication to environmental and reliability test equipment, the company integrates R&D, production, sales and full-scope services. It holds 27 product patents and 18 software copyrights with core proprietary technologies, standing as a high-end intelligent manufacturer with solid technical barriers in China’s premium reliability test equipment industry.
Its core products include high & low temperature humidity test chambers, rapid temperature change test chambers, thermal shock test chambers, high & low temperature low-pressure test chambers, and temperature-humidity-vibration combined test systems. It also customizes non-standard climatic simulation chambers and mechanical test equipment for drop, tensile, insertion & extraction force testing, fully satisfying high-standard, customized reliability verification demands across industries.
Adhering to the philosophy of “Technology Leadership, Quality First”, the company continuously optimizes precision temperature control algorithms, full-range temperature field calibration, extreme condition adaptation, safety protection systems and localized service networks. Its products outperform traditional industry equipment in overall performance, operational stability, test accuracy and full-cycle service capacity.
Benchmarked against global leading brands such as Germany’s Weiss, Japan’s Espec and Hitachi, its products meet stringent high-end manufacturing test and certification standards. The company offers high-quality domestic alternatives to imported premium and mainstream Taiwanese brands, serving automotive electronics, new energy lithium batteries, semiconductors, 5G communications, AI servers, optoelectronic displays, medical electronics, consumer electronics, aviation and defense, and leads reliability testing in multiple precision manufacturing niches.
Product Range
High & low temperature (humidity) test chambers, rapid temperature change test chambers, thermal shock test chambers, high & low temperature low-pressure test chambers, temperature-humidity-vibration combined test chambers, other customized non-standard climatic simulation test chambers; drop/tensile/insertion & extraction force test machines, other customized non-standard mechanical environment simulation test machines.

11617.companyProfileEn:
Hangxing Dynamics — Ultra-Light Electric Drive Systems

Hangxing Dynamics designs and manufactures ultra-light electric drive systems, built on three core technologies it develops entirely in-house: advanced materials, new-generation motors and intelligent control — from core material to complete drive system, one continuous chain.

Soft magnetic composites were long dominated by European and American suppliers. That dependency set the founding team on an independent path: a National Major Project on soft magnetic materials in 2013, in-house preparation of SMC by 2016, a new axial-flux motor built on its own material from 2017, and a national-level appraisal in 2020 rating the technology as "filling a domestic gap, internationally leading." Intelligent control followed, completing the chain.

Today the company powers high-end equipment — intelligent robots, new-energy vehicles, special-purpose equipment and low-altitude aircraft — with domestically developed drive systems that keep supply independent and secure.

公司与上海师范大学建立深度校企合作关系，引进“一种艾叶发酵提取及其制备方法和应用”（专利号：202410571710.3）和“一种用于促进伤口愈合的医用敷料”（专利号：202410619334.0）两项核心发明专利，围绕艾草生物转化原料开展联合研发。公司已投入500万元建成艾草生物发酵提取分离自动化设备，涵盖粉碎、生物转化、提取、分离、浓缩、冷冻干燥等全工艺流程。2025年，公司作为全县唯一企业荣获李时珍中医药文化节“蕲艾精品奖”；经湖北省信息技咨询服务行业协会组织专家科技成果评价，相关技术成果达到国内领先水平。未来三年预计年产值突破2.0亿元以上，力争建成国内首个艾草生物医药全产业链示范基地。
10780.companyProfileEn:
Le’ai Technology (Hubei) Co., Ltd. was established in February 2024 and is located at No. 19 Jinshan Road, Li Shizhen Medical Industrial Park, Qichun County, Huanggang City, Hubei Province. It is a technology-based enterprise driven by synthetic biology to upgrade the Qiai (Qichun mugwort) industry. Relying on Qichun’s unique mugwort resources and profound traditional Chinese medicine cultural heritage as “China’s Artemisia Capital,” the company focuses on the Qiai health industry. With “tradition + technology” as its core, it has built a GMP-compliant Class 100,000 clean production workshop and owns 8 invention and utility model patents, 11 trademarks, and 5 copyrights.

The company has established in-depth university-enterprise cooperation with Shanghai Normal University and introduced two core invention patents: “A Fermented Extract of Artemisia argyi Leaves and Its Preparation Method and Application” (Patent No.: 202410571710.3) and “A Medical Dressing for Promoting Wound Healing” (Patent No.: 202410619334.0). It carries out joint research and development around mugwort biotransformation raw materials. The company has invested RMB 5 million to build automated equipment for biological fermentation, extraction, and separation of mugwort, covering the full process including crushing, biotransformation, extraction, separation, concentration, and freeze-drying. In 2025, as the only enterprise in the county, the company won the “Qiai Premium Product Award” at the Li Shizhen Traditional Chinese Medicine Culture Festival. An expert scientific and technological achievement evaluation organized by the Hubei Information Technology Consulting Service Industry Association concluded that the relevant technical achievements have reached the domestic leading level. In the next three years, the annual output value is expected to exceed RMB 200 million, and the company strives to build China’s first mugwort biomedicine full-industry-chain demonstration base.

10798.companyProfile: 承德市天乾地坤科技股份有限公司成立于2017年，是国家级高新技术企业、国家级科技型中小企业、河北省专精特新企业。公司聚焦微波等离子体化学气相沉积（MPCVD）金刚石技术研发、装备制造、材料制备及产业化应用，致力于构建高端金刚石全产业链绿色智造体系。公司拥有自主研发的MPCVD核心技术体系，覆盖核心部件、智能控制系统及晶体生长工艺，实现关键技术自主可控。以“风光储钻·绿电造绿钻”为战略理念，探索风能、太阳能、储能与金刚石制造深度融合，推动绿电直连、智能生产与碳足迹管理协同发展。公司构建“一总部、四中心、三基地”产业发展体系，以北京为集团总部，协同建设半导体研发、珠宝设计、MPCVD装备研发及绿电应用等研发中心，依托承德双滦、张家口沽源、新疆铁门关三大产业基地，形成装备制造、材料生产与终端应用协同发展的产业格局。公司依托高端人造金刚石合成与应用工程研究中心，重点开展大尺寸、高纯度单晶及多晶金刚石研发与规模化制备，产品应用覆盖半导体衬底、高功率器件散热、高端光学窗口、精密超硬工具等领域，并积极探索NV色心、量子计算、量子精密测量及生物传感等前沿应用。旗下河北投实晶铠科技有限公司成立于2025年，承担高端金刚石材料制造与产业化任务，已完成中试测试并进入投产阶段，具备从晶体生长、毛坯加工到精密切割、性能检测的工艺能力，为高端材料应用及珠宝产业提供供应保障。公司旗下“绿荻”珠宝品牌以“不采矿·只采爱”为理念，融合绿色科技与设计美学，开展培育钻石珠宝设计、生产协同及国内外市场运营，产品涵盖白钻、粉钻、黄钻及大克拉培育钻石。未来，公司将持续推进核心技术创新、绿色能源融合及产业链协同发展，加快高端金刚石在半导体、量子科技和高端制造领域的应用，打造具有国际竞争力的绿色金刚石产业平台。
10798.companyProfileEn:
Established in 2017, Chengde Tianqiandi Kun Technology Co., Ltd. is a National High-Tech Enterprise, a National Technology-Based SME, and a Hebei Province Specialized and Innovative Enterprise. The company specializes in MPCVD diamond technology, equipment manufacturing, material production, and industrial applications.

With independently developed MPCVD technologies covering core components, intelligent control systems, and crystal growth processes, the company is committed to advancing high-end diamond manufacturing. Guided by the concept of "Green Electricity Creates Green Diamonds," it integrates wind, solar, and energy storage technologies with advanced manufacturing.

The company operates under an industrial framework of "One Headquarters, Four Centers, and Three Production Bases," with its headquarters in Beijing and bases in Chengde, Zhangjiakou, and Tiemenguan, Xinjiang.

Its research focuses on large-size, high-purity single-crystal and polycrystalline diamonds, with applications in semiconductor substrates, thermal management, optical windows, and precision tools. It also explores emerging fields such as NV centers, quantum computing, precision measurement, and biosensing.

Its subsidiary, Hebei Toushi Jingkai Technology Co., Ltd., established in 2025, has completed pilot-scale testing and entered production, providing integrated capabilities from crystal growth to precision processing and testing.

The company's jewelry brand, LÜDI, embraces the philosophy of "No Mining, Only Love," combining green technology with design aesthetics. Its products include white, pink, and yellow lab-grown diamonds, as well as large-carat diamond jewelry.

Looking ahead, the company will continue advancing technological innovation, renewable energy integration, and high-end diamond applications, building an internationally competitive green diamond industry platform.
10798.typeProduct: 金刚石材料及培育钻石

10952.companyProfile:
上海潓美医疗科技有限公司，专注于氢氧医学研究与应用的高新技术企业，研发的氢氧气机（原名“氢氧气雾化机”），获得“国家创新”医疗器械，2020年获批第一张三类医疗器械证（国械注准20203080066），成为国内该领域首个获批的氢氧呼吸设备，并于2023年取得第二张三类医疗器械证（国械注准20233081929）。
截至2025年12月，潓美与中国前百大三甲医院中80多家联手，开展基础与人体临床研究项目超过300项，其中包括多中心人体临床实验18项、单中心人体临床实验16项，国家自然基金项目10项。
目前，关于高浓度氢氧吸入应用的论文，潓美医疗发表占比93%，从时间、数量，涉及适应症等方面来看，我国在氢氧医学领域的研究领先世界！
潓美医疗积极承担社会责任，尽己所能帮助更多的人，疫情期间，向全国各地医院捐赠氢氧气雾化机近3000台，总价值超1.5亿元。此外，为支持和帮助海外民众抗击疫情，潓美医疗参与了对尼泊尔、柬埔寨等国家的抗疫援助。
2024年3月，潓美医疗获得上海市高新技术企业认定。
2025 年 11 月，国际学术组织“ ISHMB”授予潓美“产业创新突破”奖！
10952.companyProfileEn:
Shanghai Asclepius Meditec Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise focusing on hydrogen-oxygen medicine research and application. Its Hydrogen-Oxygen Generator (formerly the "Hydrogen-Oxygen Nebulizer") was designated a "National Innovative" medical device. In 2020, it obtained the first Class III Medical Device Registration Certificate (National Medical Device Registration Certificate No. 20203080066), becoming the first approved hydrogen-oxygen respiratory device in this field in China. In 2023, it obtained its second Class III Medical Device Registration Certificate (National Medical Device Registration Certificate No. 20233081929).

As of December 2025, Asclepius Meditec has collaborated with more than 80 of China's top 100 tertiary Grade A hospitals, carrying out more than 300 basic and human clinical research projects, including 18 multicenter human clinical trials, 16 single-center human clinical trials, and 10 National Natural Science Foundation of China projects.

At present, Asclepius Meditec accounts for 93% of published papers on applications of high-concentration hydrogen-oxygen inhalation. In terms of timing, quantity, and the indications involved, China's research in the field of hydrogen-oxygen medicine leads the world.

Asclepius Meditec actively fulfills its social responsibilities and does its utmost to help more people. During the pandemic, it donated nearly 3,000 hydrogen-oxygen nebulizers to hospitals across the country, with a total value exceeding RMB 150 million. In addition, to support and help overseas populations fight the pandemic, Asclepius Meditec participated in pandemic assistance to countries including Nepal and Cambodia.

In March 2024, Asclepius Meditec was recognized as a Shanghai High-Tech Enterprise.

In November 2025, the international academic organization ISHMB awarded Asclepius Meditec the "Industrial Innovation Breakthrough" Award.

珠海市福洛施科技有限公司（FULLOWS）成立于2017年，是国家高新技术企业、国家创新型中小企业和国家科技型中小企业。公司始终致力于让流体技术更加智能化，努力成为流体控制领域行业中的领先者。公司拥有多年的产品设计经验，专攻高端流体控制，通过不断改进设计和生产工艺来实现最佳的工程解决方案，专注于半导体、数据中心等新兴行业领域。公司目前拥有两个厂区和一处写字楼办公点，年产值800万。
FULLOWS拥有强大的维保服务团队，可以为客户提供24小时快速响应与紧急维修保障服务，为客户正常生产与工艺改造保驾护航，同时可以为客户提供现场阀门安装、调试与并网服务，并且配合 EPC 完成现场系统调试服务。
FULLOWS采用“国际研发、中国智造”的战略，整合国际范围内（如德国）的前沿产业科技资源，与中国高端智造相结合，打造非凡产品和服务。十年一路走来，FULLOWS的业务逐步覆盖了海洋石油、化工、先进水处理、半导体、数据中心等多个行业的流体过程控制领域，并与多家国内外知名阀门公司保持长期合作关系。我们在有着十年成熟的现场运营经验基础上，始终不断发展和提升我们的研发能力、高端智造能力、工程改进能力、严苛工况驾驭能力与问题解决能力，以保持我们的产品和服务在市场上始终保持领先地位。
11105.companyProfileEn:
Zhuhai FULLOWS Technology Co., Ltd.(FULLOWS) was established in 2017 and is a national high-tech enterprise, national innovative small and medium-sized enterprise, and national technology-based small and medium-sized enterprise.The company is always committed to making fluid technology more intelligent and striving to become a leader in the fluid control industry. The company has many years of product design experience, specializing in high-end fluid control, and achieves the best engineering solutions through continuous improvement of design and production processes, focusing on emerging industries such as semiconductors and data centers. The company currently has two factory areas and one office building, with an annual output value of 8 million yuan.
FULLOWS has a strong maintenance service team that can provide customers with 24-hour rapid response and emergency repair support services, safeguarding their normal production and process transformation. At the same time, it can provide on-site valve installation, commissioning, and grid connection services, and cooperate with EPC to complete on-site system commissioning services.
FULLOWS adopts the strategy of "International research and development, Chinese intelligent manufacturing", integrating cutting-edge industrial technology resources from international sources such as Germany, and combining them with high-end intelligent manufacturing in China to create extraordinary products and services. Over the past decade, FULLOWS has gradually expanded its business to include fluid process control in multiple industries such as offshore oil, chemical, advanced water treatment, semiconductor, and data centers. It has also maintained long-term partnerships with several well-known valve companies both domestically and internationally. On the basis of ten years of mature on-site operation experience, we have continuously developed and improved our research and development capabilities, high-end intelligent manufacturing capabilities, engineering improvement capabilities, ability to handle harsh working conditions, and problem-solving capabilities to maintain our leading position in the market for our products and services.

11143.companyProfile: 中交海峰新能源科技(汕尾)有限公司是由中交集团、中广核集团两大央企联合设立的海上风电一体化智慧运维综合服务商，注册地广东汕尾，是广东省创新型中小企业，拥有港航施工总承包二级等多项核心资质，业务范围覆盖东南沿海和全国中广核海上风电场。公司致力于打造“全区域、全周期、全场景”的海上风电一体化智慧运维服务，主要业务包括海上风电风机定检、监测监测、智慧运维服务、防腐消缺、基地服务、大部件更换等技术服务以及海上光伏、海洋牧场等“风光渔”融合业务及其他“海上风电+”等运维服务；同时，公司致力于海上风电运维技术研发，重点开展智慧运维系统开发、无人巡检装备研发应用、AI智能定检识别等前沿技术攻关，其中自研的海上风电智慧运维数字化平台获评省级名优高新技术产品，自主研发的国内领先的51系列运维船舶，具备大型海上风场集群项目运维能力，同时能够适配海上光伏、海上制氢等“海上风电+”新兴业务以数字化、无人化技术助力海洋新能源产业高质量发展。
11143.companyProfileEn: CCCC Haifeng New Energy Technology (Shanwei) Co., Ltd. is an integrated smart operations and maintenance service provider for offshore wind power, jointly established by two central state-owned enterprises: China Communications Construction Company (CCCC) and China General Nuclear Power Group (CGN). Headquartered in Shanwei, Guangdong, the company is recognized as an innovative small and medium-sized enterprise in Guangdong Province. It holds multiple core qualifications, including Level II general contracting for port and navigation construction, and its business scope covers offshore wind farms operated by CGN along the southeastern coast and across China. The company is committed to delivering "full-region, full-lifecycle, full-scenario" integrated smart operations and maintenance services for offshore wind power. Its main services include routine inspection and monitoring of offshore wind turbines, smart O&M solutions, corrosion prevention and defect remediation, base support services, major component replacement, and other technical services. Additionally, it offers integrated "wind-solar-fishery" projects such as offshore photovoltaic and marine ranching, as well as other "offshore wind power+" O&M services. The company also focuses on R&D in offshore wind power O&M technologies, with key efforts directed toward developing smart O&M systems, designing and applying unmanned inspection equipment, and advancing AI-powered automated inspection identification. Notably, its self-developed digital platform for smart offshore wind power O&M has been awarded the title of a provincial renowned and high-quality new and high-tech product. Furthermore, the company has independently developed the leading domestic 51-series O&M vessels, which possess the capability to support the O&M of large-scale offshore wind farm clusters while also adapting to emerging "offshore wind power+" businesses such as offshore photovoltaics and offshore hydrogen production. Through digitalization and unmanned technologies, the company contributes to the high-quality development of the marine new energy industry.

陕西清能动力科技有限公司（以下简称“清能科技”），成立于2022年，系西安交通大学的科技成果转化项目。公司依托西安交大能动学院教授领衔的技术研发团队，以绿氢装备研发、制造，制储氢材料研发和高纯氢气供应为核心，面向煤化工、石油化工企业节能减碳和双碳战略的时代任务和市场需求，提供催化剂和电解槽关键材料与关键部件、电解水制氢成套设备等。

11293.companyProfileEn:
Shaanxi Qingneng Power Technology Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as “Qingneng Technology”), founded in 2022, is a scientific and technological achievement transformation project of Xi’an Jiaotong University. 10729.companyProfileEn:
Tineng Technology (Hubei) Co., Ltd. was founded on June 11, 2024 and is located in Wuhan Carbon Exchange Tower. Its core technological achievement, the power-type BPS renewable energy recovery technology, is jointly developed by Tineng Technology (Hubei) Co., Ltd., Huazhong University of Science and Technology and Beijing Institute of Technology. Adopting bidirectional DC inversion and high-power-density energy storage modules, the technology recovers kinetic and potential energy generated during equipment braking and downward operation in real time for efficient reuse.
Featuring high power density, millisecond-level response, long service life and high safety, the products are applicable to multiple scenarios: elevator kinetic and potential energy recovery; rail transit braking energy recovery; energy recovery for port hoisting machinery; green power direct connection in zero-carbon parks, power frequency regulation and peak shaving, as well as flexible DC microgrid systems.
At present, the company focuses on elevator energy saving and rail transit braking energy recovery. Field tests show that the energy-saving rate of a single elevator unit reaches 30%–45%, with annual power saving of 3,500–7,000 kWh and carbon emission reduction of approximately 2.6–5 tons. For metro applications, the system can reduce traction power consumption by around 30% and support emergency power supply for evacuation upon power failure.
The company has secured incubation cooperation with Zhejiang Energy Baimahu Laboratory and strategic financing from Jiangcheng Fund. In the elevator sector, it is an appointed national supplier for Poly Property and Vanke Property. For rail transit, it has established cooperation with China Railway 12th Bureau Group and Zhejiang Energy Group to carry out energy-saving project tests on Wuhan Metro and Hangzhou Metro.

热真空测试旨在模拟任务环境条件下的温度和压力情况。进行 TVAC 测试是为了在低压条件下执行温度循环时检查硬件的功能性。TVAC 测试是空间硬件认证所必需的，并且在系统级和组件级进行。
泰事达TVAC代表了多功能性的顶峰，提供了大量设计选项和尺寸，可满足不同的测试需求。 这些测试室既有非常适合在部件层面进行空间认证的紧凑型测试室，也有为适应大型航天器测试而专门设计的更大范围的测试室。
我们的专用真空系统经过精心设计，即使在被测设备(DUT)产生典型气体负荷的情况下，也能达到超高真空(UHV)水平。我们的热控技术的核心在于它能够解决各种应用问题。我们的专长主要体现在硅油系统上，该系统专为低地球轨道的温度而设计。此外，我们的重点还扩展到使用GN2/LN2基础技术的热控制单元(TCU)，提供模拟地球静止轨道及更远处极低温环境的能力。

11215.companyProfileEn:
Zhongshan Tianchuang Qisheng Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on industrial ultra-large 3D printing. With fully independent core technologies, we serve high-end manufacturing fields including wind power, shipbuilding, aerospace, heavy machinery and infrastructure. We provide integrated solutions for equipment R&D, contract manufacturing and technology licensing. Our innovative processes solve major pain points of large components in cost, size, structure and transportation, conforming to national strategies of carbon peaking, carbon neutrality and new industrialization.

We have five proprietary core technologies for differentiated competitiveness:
First, compound gantry and lifting platform collaborative printing system. High-precision gantry printhead movement plus platform sinking supports continuous integrated printing of components over 20 meters. Compatible with metals and polymers, it works as a versatile ultra-large 3D printing base.
Second, synchronous integrated printing for steel reinforcement cages and matrix materials. Reinforcement frames are formed in-situ, delivering continuous internal structures to meet high dynamic load requirements of wind turbine towers.
Third, built-in column integrated forming. Internal reinforcing columns and stiffeners are printed concurrently, balancing lightweight design and high rigidity to improve deformation and overturning resistance.
Fourth, integrated mortise-tenon ring beam forming. Mortise-tenon joints and ring beams are printed as one piece, eliminating segmented assembly and joint defects. It reduces water seepage and improves durability for offshore and outdoor scenarios.
Fifth, mobile 3D printing factory mode. Equipment can be deployed on-site for local production, addressing over-limit transportation, damage and high freight of oversized components, suitable for remote wind farms and deep-sea infrastructure.

Supported by these technologies, the company owns seven invention patents. Several innovations are exclusive, outperforming domestic and overseas peers in forming size, integrated reinforcement and printing precision.

Our template-free integrated forming technology allows direct printing of wind turbine towers. Combined with topological optimization to reduce wind loads and overturning bending moments, it enables flexible customization of special-shaped towers for onshore and offshore wind power. It cuts steel mould investment, shortens delivery cycles and enhances mechanical performance.

11337.companyProfileEn: Jianhong (Shenzhen) Industrial Development Co., Ltd. is a research and development enterprise built on open-source HarmonyOS as its technology foundation, serving the building industry across its entire process, full lifecycle and all categories, with the core mission of driving the industry's cloud adoption, data utilization and AI empowerment. In 2024, Jianhong worked with the Shenzhen Housing and Construction Bureau, Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. and other institutions to jointly release the white paper Building HarmonyOS Interconnection Reference Architecture. With end-to-end delivery capability covering solution design, product support, a complete ecosystem, equipment deployment and system commissioning, the company has delivered Shenzhen's first HarmonyOS construction site at Tian'an Cloud Park Phase III, and has implemented pilots in construction sites, parks and whole-home intelligence, including Qinghu Industrial Park Phase II in Longhua District, the Xinqiao East Cold Station confined-space project in Bao'an District and the HarmonyOS Smart Home project at Zhenlong Building 4 in Wenzhou, covering housing construction, municipal works, industrial parks,

深圳检测院锚定“重大活动的保障者、政府治理的支撑者、产业发展的服务者、科技创新的助推者和品质消费的守护者”五重角色定位，集成应用计量、标准、检验、检测、认证等QI要素，深化从基础研究、应用技术研究到成果转化应用的全链条服务。

面向新能源等领域，先后承担国家重点研发计划等市级以上科技项目260余项。起草的各类标准（含规程）获发布500余项，其中国际标准12项、国家标准380余项。主导编译IEC历史上首个中文国际标准并推动正式发布。专利授权100余项，获得市厅级以上奖励97项。
深圳检测院不断拓宽国际合作领域，构建完善“1+N+X”国际化服务体系。与38个国家和地区的80家机构实现检测数据和报告互认，检测认证服务能力获得超过230个国家和地区认可，助力中国制造更便利进入国际市场。
11374.companyProfileEn:
The Shenzhen Academy of Metrology and Quality Inspection (SMQ) is a statutory technical institution established by the Shenzhen Municipal People's Government and authorized by the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR).
In accordance with its statutory responsibilities, SMQ is primarily responsible for the mandatory verification of measuring instruments; supervisory sampling inspections of food and other products; food safety assurance for major events; the establishment of key laboratories at various levels; and metrology, testing and certification services covering products, engineering, services, the environment and other fields.
SMQ continues to strengthen collaboration among industry, academia, research and inspection, building an integrated, open and shared public technical platform. It has established 15 national-level platforms and 45 provincial- and municipal-level platforms in fields including digital electronics, textiles and apparel, carbon metrology, medical devices, nutritional foods and intelligent manufacturing. SMQ is the only technical institution in China that simultaneously hosts a National Quality Inspection and Testing Center, a National Industrial Metrology Center, a National Technology Innovation Center, a National Carbon Metrology Center and a National Quality Infrastructure Integrated Application Center. These platforms provide strong support for the mutually reinforcing development of industrial innovation and scientific and technological innovation.
SMQ is committed to developing itself as a new type of research and development institution. Focusing on fields such as new energy, it has undertaken more than 260 science and technology projects at or above the municipal level, including projects under the National Key Research and Development Program. It has drafted more than 500 standards and technical regulations that have subsequently been promulgated, including 12 international standards and over 380 national standards. SMQ led the translation and publication of the first Chinese-language international standard in the history of the International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC). It has secured more than 100 granted patents and received 97 awards at or above the municipal level, including the Second Prize of the National Science and Technology Progress Award, the First Prize of the Guangdong Science and Technology Progress Award, and the Second Prize of the SAMR Scientific and Technological Achievement Award.

We are a prominent provider of spatial positioning services in China. As a national-level high-tech enterprise, a national-level specialized, refined, unique and innovative (“SRDI”) Little Giant enterprise, and a Guangdong Provincial Manufacturing Single Champion Enterprise, Allystar offers chips, modules and related solutions that support major GNSS, including BeiDou, GPS,
GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS, and NavIC.

Allystar has a solid technical foundation in BeiDou GNSS navigation and positioning chips, with full-chain capabilities spanning integrated baseband and RF design, algorithm research and productized solutions. The company independently developed the world's first multi-system, multi-frequency, high-precision SoC chip with integrated baseband and RF that supports BeiDou-3 signal systems. Its self-developed GNSS chips, modules and related solutions serve applications including bike sharing, intelligent driving, smartphones, smart wearables, the Internet of Things, meteorological observation and deformation monitoring, enabling accurate and efficient navigation and positioning, location tracking, displacement monitoring and satellite communication.

Located in the Northern Metropolis of Hong Kong, the Loop Hong Kong Park spans approximately 87.7 hectares of land, adjacent to the Lok Ma Chau Spur Line and the Lok Ma Chau control points. The Hong Kong Park, together with the Shenzhen Park on the other side of the river, form the Hetao Shenzhen Hong Kong Science and Technology Innovation Co-operation Zone (“the Co-operation Zone”). Under the country’s staunch support, the Co-operation Zone is a brand-new testbed for pilot cross-boundary policies, in line with the principle of “one zone, two parks” at “one river, two banks” under the auspices of “One Country, Two Systems”.

The Loop Hong Kong Park strives to evolve into a world-class I&T hub by advancing its development in four major directions: to build a world-class industry-academia-research platform, to establish an internationally competitive research and development transformation and pilot production base for industries; to foster a hub for pooling global innovation and technology resources, and to cultivate a testing ground for institutional and policy innovation. The Loop Hong Kong Park is envisioned to develop into a world-class hub for technological innovation that connects the Mainland with the international community, and to serve as an important source for fostering and advancing new quality productive forces for the country.

10080.companyProfileEn:
JA Biotech specializes in the research of advanced functional hydrogel material synthesis technologies and the industrialization development of related products. The company holds over seventy core patents and multiple proprietary manufacturing processes, particularly leading globally in the field of high-energy radiation-induced hydrogel synthesis.
JA Biotech has established two major industrialization directions: industrial hydrogels and medical hydrogels. In the industrial sector, the company's independently developed solid-state hydrogel ultrasonic couplant has been successfully applied in non-destructive ultrasonic testing for major domestic equipment such as the C919 large aircraft and  nuclear power plants. In the medical field, its self-developed product lines—including wound dressings, eye care and protective products, and light medical aesthetic patches—have been used by more than ten million patients worldwide. Current industrialization research initiatives include nano-microsphere hydrogels, amorphous hydrogels, soft hydrogels, smart-responsive hydrogels, and in-situ synthesized functional component hydrogels, aiming to achieve commercial applications in tissue engineering repair, efficient drug delivery systems, energy-conducting media, and new cosmetic formulations.

Eartech is recognized as a National High-Tech Enterprise and a Shenzhen “Specialized, Refined, Differential, and Innovative” enterprise. Its products have obtained China’s Class II medical device registration and production licenses, as well as relevant U.S. FDA certifications, enabling compliant access to both domestic and international markets. Backed by a core R&D team with expertise from Tsinghua University and collaborations with institutions such as Tianjin University and the Institute of Semiconductors, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Eartech has developed proprietary technologies in hearing-aid chips, acoustic signal processing, AI noise reduction, intelligent audiometry, and remote fitting. Its hearing aids are designed to optimize speech clarity in Chinese-language environments and complex acoustic scenes, offering features such as adaptive noise reduction, feedback suppression, personalized hearing compensation, and remote audio-video fitting.
Through an online-offline service model, Eartech provides users with convenient hearing assessment, product selection, remote debugging, and long-term after-sales support. The company aims to make professional hearing solutions more accessible, affordable, and easy to use for elderly and hearing-impaired users.

云储新能源科技有限公司（IBatteryCloud Technologies Co., Ltd.）是清华大学孵化的硬科技企业。

11407.companyProfileEn:
IBatteryCloud Technologies Co., Ltd. is a hard-tech enterprise incubated by Tsinghua University. Through its Digital Energy Switch System based on a dynamic reconfigurable battery network（DRBN）, the company enables the acceptance and management of battery variability, disrupting the traditional fixed series-parallel battery application paradigm. This fundamentally solves the world-class challenge of the "weak-cell effect" in battery systems, significantly improving key performance indicators including effective battery lifespan, system energy efficiency, cell balancing, reliability, and safety.
The company's business spans four strategic quadrants:
1. Digital Energy Storage Systems — Covering energy storage scenarios across generation, grid, and consumption sides.
2. Electric Powertrain Applications — Implementing the "energy block" concept to decouple and manage power batteries throughout their full lifecycle, partnering with heavy-duty electric vehicle manufacturers to drive industry paradigm transformation.
3. AI Computing Infrastructure — Providing range-extended power supply systems for AI data centers.
4. AI Intelligent Operations Platform — Building asset digitalization operations and financialization services based on the "Xuanwei" system.

重庆国科医创科技发展有限公司是2021年经重庆市两江新区引入，由中国科学院苏州生物医学工程技术研究所、苏州国科医工科技发展（集团）公司，于2021年4月在重庆市两江新区成立的全资国有研发公司。
重庆国科重点围绕生物医学工程内生需求和医疗器械产业链，以“科技创新”与“成果转化机制创新”双轮驱动发展战略，引入苏州医工所技术、人才和成果转化，形成以知识产权为纽带、以高端工程化技术服务为核心、以资本为辅助、成果转化多核心要素（政府、用户、企业等）紧密融合的运营模式，打造集“产、学、研、用”为一体的行业示范基地。目前重庆国科正在建设具有高学历、强研发经验、多学科配套的研发队伍和高级管理团队，公司累计申报专利82项（含发明专利44项），其中已获得授权48项；同时申报商标4项、软件著作权5项，核心技术产品共聚焦显微拉曼光谱仪入选2024年重庆市首台套重大技术装备。
平台功能建设方面，在2022年成为“重庆两江新区、成都天府新区旗舰产业联盟”单位；2023年与陆军军医大学联合申报了教育部国家基础医药创新研究中心并已获批；与两江新区新赛亚生物联合申报了并获批了2024重庆市首批创新医疗器械应用示范项目；通过技术转化、技术服务促成在重庆市两江新区落产项目2项。
10657.companyProfileEn:
Chongqing Guoke Yichuang Technology Development Co., Ltd. was introduced by Liangjiang New Area, Chongqing in 2021. Founded in April 2021, it is a wholly state-owned R&D company initiated by the Suzhou Institute of Biomedical Engineering and Technology, CAS and Suzhou Guoke Medical Engineering Technology Development (Group) Co., Ltd.
Focusing on biomedical engineering and the medical device chain, we adopt a dual strategy of sci-tech innovation and commercialization mechanism innovation. Drawing on technologies, talents and achievements from SIBET, we operate a model linking IP, high-end engineering services and capital, uniting governments, users and enterprises. We build a demonstration base combining industry, academia, research and application.
We are building a high-caliber, multidisciplinary R&D and management team. We have filed 82 patents (44 invention patents), 48 granted; 4 trademark applications and 5 software copyrights. Our confocal micro-Raman spectrometer was selected for Chongqing First Sets of Major Technical Equipment (2024).
We joined the Liangjiang-Tianfu Flagship Industrial Alliance in 2022. In 2023, our joint bid with Army Medical University for the National Basic Medical Innovation Research Center (MOE) was approved. We and Novasense Biotechnology won a 2024 Chongqing Innovative Medical Device Application Demonstration Project. Two industrial projects have settled in Liangjiang New Area via our technology transfer and services.

10705.companyProfile:
林芝毛尖茶叶有限责任公司成立于2020 年 11 月，位于西藏林芝市察隅县下察隅镇钢桥，茶园分布上、下察隅镇、竹瓦根镇承包近 3000 亩茶园，建设成为规模化有机茶园示范基地。我司还计划实行多元化发展，合理利用土地资源，打造集茶叶生产深加工、批发销售、制作体验教学与文化茶旅游接待为一体的综合性企业。
我公司拥有近3000 余亩生态健康茶园。茶叶加工园区占地47 亩，建筑面积约9000 平方米，为当地1260 余户村民提供了直接和间接工作岗位。目前公司正常每天工人工作量平均在20 人，生产旺季工人数量可达到500 人，为当地创造诸多就业岗位，丰富了当地茶产业。同时也一定程度地带动了当地经济发展。
绿水青山就是金山银山、冰天雪地也是金山银山。林芝毛尖茶园经高山雪水浇灌，得冰川雪野之灵气，受充沛阳光之沐，极纯极净属实雪域之健康茶。独特珍稀的原料运用先进制茶工艺，制作而成的林芝毛尖干茶外形细圆光直，条形完整，色泽翠绿，略带白毫；汤色橙黄明亮，汤感绵柔，水中兰花香明显，味醇回甘；舒展后的叶底明亮鲜活，呈均匀的翠绿色，实为茶中臻品，显示出雪域高原茶叶天然优异的特质。
目前，本公司配套标准化现代加工厂，在当地政府的关心和支持下，公司在品牌文化建设、产品研发、市场占有率等方面做了大量工作，目前已注册“域峰 ”“雪域金眉 ”商标，品牌有“林芝毛尖 ”“雪域金眉 ”“察隅白茶 ”等品牌。并种有软枝乌龙、金宣、梅占、名选 131、福鼎大白等优良品种，年产精品茶 20万斤，年产边销茶200 万斤的能力，林芝毛尖茶叶有限责任公司不定期为当地藏族同胞提供茶叶种植、管护、采摘、茶叶加工等技能丰富了藏族同胞的种植知识与生活技能。为察隅县当地居民提供了多重岗位，提高了藏族人民的生活水平。
公司产品在各种展会上荣获红茶金奖、绿茶金奖。
2025 年 1 月被西藏自治区评为自治区级农业产业化重点龙龙头企业。
10705.companyProfileEn:
Linzhi Maojian Tea Co., Ltd. was founded in November 2020, located at Gangqiao, Lower Zayü Town, Zayü County, Nyingchi City, Xizang. Our tea plantations spread across Upper Zayü Town, Lower Zayü Town and Zhuwageng Town. We have contracted nearly 3,000 mu of tea gardens and built a large-scale organic tea demonstration base.
Committed to diversified development, our company plans to make rational use of land resources and build an integrated enterprise featuring deep tea processing, wholesale and sales, tea-making experience and training, as well as cultural tea tourism reception.
We own more than 3,000 mu of eco-friendly and healthy tea gardens. The tea processing park covers an area of 47 mu with a construction area of approximately 9,000 square meters. It provides direct and indirect employment for over 1,260 local households. Normally, around 20 workers are engaged in production each day, and the workforce can rise to 500 in peak production seasons. The company creates numerous local jobs, enriches the local tea industry and boosts regional economic development.
Lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets; snow-capped mountains and glacial lands are also invaluable assets. Watered by alpine snowmelt, nourished by the essence of glaciers and snowfields, and bathed in abundant sunshine, Linzhi Maojian tea is pure and healthy snowland tea. With unique and rare raw materials and advanced tea-making techniques, the finished Linzhi Maojian presents fine, round, straight and intact dry tea leaves in emerald green with fine white hairs. Its liquor is orange-yellow and bright, soft on the palate with distinct orchid aroma and sweet aftertaste. The infused leaves are bright, lively and evenly emerald green, making it an exceptional tea that embodies the natural superior quality of tea grown on the snow-covered plateau.
In January 2025, the company was recognized as an Xizang Autonomous Region Key Leading Enterprise in Agricultural Industrialization.

10876.companyProfile:
福建医科大学附属协和医院是一所集医疗、教学、科研、预防和保健于一体的大型三级甲等综合性医院。本次展示医械智探与智循医策（EBM-Agent）两个独立的人工智能项目，分别面向医疗器械产业决策与医学科研。
医械智探围绕企业现有产品，汇集法规、注册、专利、竞品和市场资料，通过动态监测、多源检索、前沿分析、机会推荐与路线建议，为产品升级、目标市场选择及出海准备提供有来源依据的决策参考。
智循医策衔接研究问题梳理、文献检索与筛选、数据提取、Meta分析及网状Meta分析，以人工智能辅助资料整理、R执行统计计算，保留原文出处、输入数据与分析记录，便于研究者核查和复核。
欢迎医疗器械企业、产业园区、科研院所及临床研究团队，围绕联合研发、应用场景验证、数据资源合作与成果转化开展交流。
10876.companyProfileEn:
Fujian Medical University Union Hospital is a major tertiary general hospital integrating clinical care, education, research, prevention and health services. At this exhibition, the hospital presents two distinct AI projects: Yixie Zhitan for medical device industry decision support, and EBM-Agent for medical research.
Yixie Zhitan brings together regulatory, registration, patent, competitor and market information relevant to a company's existing products. Its workflow covers monitoring, information retrieval, technology analysis, opportunity identification and roadmap suggestions, providing source-supported references for product upgrades, target market selection and preparation for overseas expansion.
EBM-Agent connects research question formulation, literature search and screening, data extraction, meta-analysis and network meta-analysis. AI assists with information processing, while R performs statistical calculations. Source references, input data and analysis records support researcher review and verification.
We welcome medical device companies, industrial parks, research institutions and clinical research teams to explore joint development, application testing, data resource collaboration and research translation.
10876.typeProduct: 医械智探——医疗器械全球研发与出海智能决策平台；智循医策（EBM-Agent）——医学证据合成与分析平台

10881.companyProfile:
海南省种业实验室（原海南省崖州湾种子实验室）于2023年12月重新更名并优化目标定位，面向国家“蓝色粮仓”、“南繁硅谷”战略，服务海南省自贸港产业建设，专注水产种业、热带果蔬领域，吸引国内外优秀人才，推动精准育种和高效农业的技术创新与成果转化。
实验室现拥有精准育种技术中心、国家野生稻资源圃、冯家湾设施渔业中试研究基地、基因组测序平台及遗传转化平台等核心研究设施；围绕“热带水产”“热带果蔬”两大主线，重点布局五大科研方向，已引进15个创新团队，形成覆盖应用基础研究、技术开发与产业转化的全链条创新体系。
截至2026年5月，实验室累计承担国家自然科学基金及博士后项目28项、省部级科研项目146项，获批国家发明专利10项，发表学术论文381篇，为海南热带高效农业发展和国家种业振兴战略提供了重要科技支撑。根据科睿唯安ESI数据，海南省种业实验室在农业类科研机构中排名第29位，“植物学与动物学”学科进入全球前1%，为海南热带高效农业发展和国家种业振兴战略提供了重要科技支撑。
10881.companyProfileEn:
The Hainan Provincial Seed Industry Laboratory (formerly known as the Hainan Yazhou Bay Seed Laboratory) underwent a name change and refined its target positioning in December 2023. Aligned with the national strategies of "Blue Granary" and "Silicon Valley of Southern Seed Production", it serves the industrial development of Hainan Free Trade Port, specializing in the aquatic seed industry and tropical fruits and vegetables. The laboratory aims to attract outstanding talents from both domestic and international backgrounds, and promote technological innovation and the commercialization of achievements in precision breeding and efficient agriculture.
The laboratory currently boasts core research facilities such as the Precision Breeding Technology Center, the National Wild Rice Resource Garden, the Fengjiawan Facility Fisheries Pilot Research Base, the Genome Sequencing Platform, and the Genetic Transformation Platform. Centered around the two main themes of "tropical aquatic products" and "tropical fruits and vegetables", the laboratory focuses on five major scientific research directions. It has introduced 15 innovative teams, forming a full-chain innovation system covering applied basic research, technology development, and industrial transformation.
As of May 2026, the laboratory has undertaken a total of 28 national natural science foundation and postdoctoral projects, 146 provincial and ministerial-level scientific research projects, obtained 10 national invention patents, and published 381 academic papers, providing important scientific and technological support for the development of tropical high-efficiency agriculture in Hainan and the national strategy for revitalizing the seed industry.

10909.companyProfile: 贵州深碳科技有限公司，是深碳科技旗下、由贵州绿色产业技术研究院孵化的创新型企业。公司聚焦 DAC 直接空气碳捕集、工业固废资源化、低碳地聚物建材三大方向，核心技术源自南方科技大学专家团队。公司自主研发固体吸附材料，实现空气中二氧化碳高效捕获提纯，配套矿化封存与资源化利用，开发高质量负碳资产；同时依托地聚物技术处置大宗固废，制备高性能绿色建材，融合碳移除与固废协同固碳，为省内外资源型企业提供一体化负碳解决方案。
10909.companyProfileEn: Guizhou Deep Carbon Technology Co., Ltd. is an innovative enterprise under Deep Carbon Technology and incubated by the Guizhou Green Industry Technology Research Institute. The company focuses on three major areas: DAC (Direct Air Capture), industrial solid waste resource utilization, and low-carbon geopolymer building materials. Its core technologies originate from an expert team at the Southern University of Science and Technology (SUSTech). The company has independently developed solid adsorbent materials to achieve efficient capture and purification of carbon dioxide from the air, supported by mineralization storage and resource utilization, and develops high-quality negative-carbon assets. At the same time, relying on geopolymer technology to dispose of bulk solid waste, it produces high-performance green building materials, integrating carbon removal with synergistic carbon sequestration through solid waste, and provides integrated negative-carbon solutions for resource-based enterprises both within and outside the province.
10909.typeProduct: 一是直接空气碳捕集（DAC）技术，由贵州深碳科技母公司深碳科技（深圳）有限公司研发并工程化落地。该技术捕集空气中低浓度 CO₂，通过吸附 - 脱附循环富集，产出纯度 99% 以上高纯 CO₂。百吨级项目已商业化运营，正推进千吨级、布局万吨级产能；产出的绿色 CO₂可用于绿色甲醇、可持续航空燃料（SAF）生产，也可对接矿化封存、国际优质碳信用业务。二是地聚物低碳胶凝材料成套技术，利用磷石膏、赤泥、锂渣、煤矸石、粉煤灰等大宗固废，定向活化制备 PS-C、RM-C、PG-C 系列胶凝产品，强度对标 PO32.5-52.5 水泥。固废掺量最高超 80%，对比传统水泥，成本降低约 30%、碳排放削减 70% 以上，适配矿山膏体充填泵送。产品应用于矿山充填、边坡治理、基坑回填、路基水稳、免烧建材，已在贵州多地验证，可提供材料与配方定制一体化方案，解决工矿企业固废堆存、采空区治理、降碳增效痛点。

11074.companyProfile:
深圳亿普生态科技有限公司坐落于深圳罗湖区，是深耕OpenHarmony开源鸿蒙产业化落地企业，涵盖前海新丝路、开鸿智联、华芸尚等多个业务品牌。公司依托十余年半导体供应链积淀，整合南向硬件配套资源与北向软件应用开发能力，具备从芯片适配、系统优化到场景应用开发的鸿蒙全链条服务能力。
公司坐拥多项行业权威资质，为开放原子开源基金会OpenHarmony A类捐赠人、项目组共建单位与代码贡献者，自研多款芯片模组取得鸿蒙官方兼容性认证；同时是首批鸿蒙智联ISV、HarmonyOS原生应用开发服务商、星闪联盟成员、华为云精英服务商、海思芯片生态服务商、华为Hicar ISV、华为数字能源分销商，也是仓颉编程语言生态推动者。在行业标准建设层面，公司深度参与多项国家级鸿蒙行业规范编制，牵头移动通信子系统鸿蒙化标准、公安部警用鸿蒙设备标准化建设，同时入驻中国电信小翼管家鸿蒙生态体系，深度参与鸿蒙底层技术迭代与行业合规落地。
业务端可一站式承接硬件主板定制、PCBA量产代工、OpenHarmony内核移植裁剪、行业应用软件开发等业务，面向政务、能源、医疗、安防、智能家居等领域输出标准化鸿蒙芯片模组、SDK接口以及整套行业智能化解决方案，依托成熟供应链体系帮助合作企业缩减产品鸿蒙改造成本、缩短项目落地周期。公司采用三地分工运营模式，依托深圳统筹供应链整合与市场渠道拓展，依托武汉、南京两大研发基地分层开展轻智能终端开发与高阶鸿蒙系统研发。面向行业合作伙伴，公司配套技术开发、供应链集采、量产代工、渠道分销、产业培训一站式赋能服务，累计赋能超3000家企业入局开源鸿蒙赛道，全方位推动OpenHarmony商业化规模化落地。
11074.companyProfileEn:
Shenzhen Yipu Ecological Technology Co., Ltd. is located in Luohu District, Shenzhen. It is an enterprise dedicated to advancing the industrial implementation of OpenHarmony.
The company holds a host of authoritative industry qualifications. It is an OpenHarmony Class A Donor of the OpenAtom Open Source Foundation, a co-builder of project teams and a code contributor. Multiple self-developed chip modules have passed official OpenHarmony compatibility certification. It is also among the first batch of HarmonyOS Connect ISVs, a HarmonyOS native application development service provider, a member of the SparkLink Alliance, a Huawei Cloud Elite Service Partner, a Hisilicon chip ecosystem service provider, a Huawei HiCar ISV, and a distributor of Huawei Digital Energy. Additionally, it is a promoter of the Cangjie programming language ecosystem.

In terms of industry standard development, the company is deeply involved in the formulation of multiple national-level OpenHarmony industry specifications. It takes the lead in developing standards for the OpenHarmony adaptation of mobile communication subsystems and advancing the standardization of police OpenHarmony devices for the Ministry of Public Security. It has also joined the Xiaoyi 管家 OpenHarmony ecosystem of China Telecom, and participates in the iterative upgrade of OpenHarmony underlying technologies and compliant industry deployment.

11129.companyProfile:
宁波电牧人科技有限公司成立于2026年9月，注册地位于浙江省宁波市，是一家从事户外移动能源网络的企业。
公司主要业务包括业务涵盖互联网软件、智能硬件开发、物联网应用及运营，聚焦新能源移动电站运营解决方案领域。企业自主研发锂电池光 - 储 - 充 - 租 - 售管理系统、锂电池管理系统、锂电池远程控制系统、锂电池共享户外租赁柜、北斗 GPS 定位终端等软硬件产品

11129.companyProfileEn:
Ningbo Dianmuren Technology Co., Ltd., established in September 2026 and based in Ningbo, Zhejiang Province, is a company specializing in outdoor mobile energy networks.

10819.companyProfile:
重庆纳米金属研究院是由重庆两江新区与卢柯院士纳米金属科学家工作室共同建设的创新型高端研究机构，依托科学家工作室前沿研究成果和优质创新资源，聚焦纳米金属材料的应用技术研究，开展关键共性技术研发，推进科技成果转化。重庆新纳金甲科技有限公司成立于2024年11月，是研究院孵化的第一家产业化公司，核心业务为梯度纳米技术（GNT）专用设备装置研发、制造与销售，GNT技术服务，以及纳米金属新材料。
卢柯院士是金属材料梯度纳米结构、纳米孪晶材料等研究领域的开创者，持续引领国际科学前沿，在近三十年的金属纳米化研究过程中创立了材料素化理论。材料素化理论通过调控晶格缺陷（例如晶界的结构与能量）替代传统合金化路径，实现材料性能的跨越式提升，减少稀、贵、毒元素的使用，从而支撑金属材料的绿色循环再利用，并延长金属材料全生命周期。GNT技术作为材料素化理论的实现手段之一，在不改变基体材料成分的情况下，在金属材料表层构筑梯度纳米结构，显著提高材料表面和整体的综合性能和使用寿命。
作为新材料底层技术，GNT可对辊轴零部件包括高附加值轴肩类零件、具有圆弧过渡部位的零件（疲劳断裂为主要失效形式）以及对耐磨耐腐蚀性能要求的零部件进行表面处理，应用于金属加工、精密机械、航空航天、海洋工业、核能、军工等行业，具有非常广阔的工业应用前景。
10819.companyProfileEn: The Chongqing Institute of Nanometals, jointly established by Chongqing Liangjiang New Area and Academician Lu Ke's Nanometal Scientist Studio, is an innovative, high-end research institution. Drawing on the studio's cutting-edge research and innovation resources, it focuses on applied technology research on nanometallic materials, develops key generic technologies, and promotes the commercialization of scientific achievements. Chongqing Narmor Technology Co., Ltd., founded in November 2024 and incubated by the institute, specializes in the R&D, manufacturing, and sales of specialized equipment for Gradient Nanostructuring Technology (GNT), GNT technical services, and nanometallic new materials. Academician Lu Ke is a pioneer in gradient nanostructured and nanotwinned metallic materials, long leading the international scientific frontier. Through nearly three decades of research on metal nanostructuring, he established the Theory of Plainified Materials, which replaces traditional alloying with the regulation of lattice defects (e.g., the structure and energy of grain boundaries), achieving leapfrog improvements in material performance while reducing the use of scarce, precious, and toxic elements—supporting the green recycling of metallic materials and extending their full life cycle. As a key means of realizing this theory, GNT builds a gradient nanostructure on the surface of metallic materials without changing the base material's composition, significantly enhancing overall performance and service life. As an underlying technology for new materials, GNT can treat roller and shaft components, including high-value-added shoulder parts, parts with arc transitions (where fatigue fracture is the main failure mode), and components requiring wear and corrosion resistance. It applies to metal processing, precision machinery, aerospace, marine, nuclear, and defense industries, showing broad industrial prospects.

Guided by its philosophy of "Fast Design, Fast Delivery, Fast Charging, and Fast Service," Yunxing's business covers more than 20 provinces across China. The company is committed to becoming a leading one-stop provider of integrated solar PV, energy storage, and EV charging solutions, delivering smarter, more efficient, and sustainable energy solutions to customers worldwide.

11358.companyProfileEn:
Shenzhen Bartons Technology Co., Ltd. (abbreviated as Bartons) is a Sino-foreign joint venture limited liability company founded in March 2014. It was established by a young team with over 10 years of experience in the sensor industry. We are a high-tech enterprise specializing in the production of magnetostrictive displacement sensors, linear displacement sensors, draw-wire displacement sensors, magnetostrictive liquid level sensors, pressure/liquid level transmitters, temperature transmitters, switch-type sensors and liquid level control products.

Upholding the corporate culture of innovation, cooperation and mutual benefit, the company adheres to the business philosophy of taking customer demands as the center and technological development as the driving force, to provide customers with suitable products and solutions.

The company always prioritizes product quality and after-sales service, and treats every partner with a pragmatic and enterprising attitude. All staff members live by Bartons’ core values: Innovation, Integrity, Pragmatism and Enterprising Spirit.

## Products & Development Orientation

Our products are widely applied in engineering machinery, automotive electronics, compressors, environmental protection equipment, metallurgical machinery, filling equipment, wind power generation, material forming, and IoT monitoring systems, including smart city, smart fire protection, smart pipe gallery and other fields.

**Transmitter Division**: Its main business covers the supporting application of pressure transmitters in engineering machinery, compressors and other industries, as well as vehicle sensors for the automotive industry.

**Magnetostrictive Gauge Division**: It focuses on the supporting application of magnetostrictive displacement / liquid level sensors (short for magnetostrictive gauges) in engineering machinery, mobile base stations, metallurgical machinery, wind power generation, material forming, food industry, petrochemical industry, oil fields, depots and gas stations.

**IoT Monitoring Systems**: NB-IoT (pressure & liquid level) monitoring is widely used in online monitoring systems for smart fire protection (pipeline pressure monitoring, water tank liquid level monitoring) and urban waterlogging monitoring systems; electronic water gauges with GPRS/GSM communication are also available.

11068.companyProfile:
苏州特思恩科技有限公司（以下简称特思恩），2021年成立于苏州工业园区，2023年成立上海分公司，2024年成立武汉研发中心。
特思恩以“设计高性能、低时延、易部署的交换芯片”为愿景，自主研发国产TSN（时间敏感网络）、超低时延交换等芯片，并提供工业自动化、智慧城市、车联网、航空航天、医疗、金融等领域芯片和技术解决方案，与广大客户和合作伙伴一起推动国产化通信芯片、技术的创新进程。
特思恩现有员工近百人，其中硕士及以上占比30%、985/211本科占比50%。研发团队核心人员在通信芯片设计、硬件开发、数据交换软件及系统测试方面有平均10年的工作经验。
特思恩以时间敏感网络（TSN）全协议芯片为核心，构建了“芯片/IP—设备—软件—解决方案”一体化产品体系，聚焦工业自动化、智能汽车、金融证券等对低时延、高可靠有严苛要求的场景，以全国产化、亚微秒级确定性转发为核心优势，具备高端网络芯片进口替代能力。
目前公司已实现28nm 全自研 64G TSN 交换芯片 TSN761210B0BI量产，该芯片支持完整 TSN 协议簇，提供 128G 线速交换能力；10G 端口 64 字节报文典型转发时延＜1μs，时间同步精度±20ns，典型功耗＜3W，采用 10×10mm WLBGA 封装，满足工业级宽温环境应用，整体性能达到国际一流水平。目前该芯片已在电力、轨道交通、低空经济等多个关键行业实现规模化落地。
2025 年，由特思恩牵头、联合 32 家企事业单位共同编制，完成了中国汽车工业协会《汽车以太网交换芯片技术要求与试验方法》团体标准，有力推动了国内车载网络芯片的标准化与产业化进程。
11068.companyProfileEn:
Suzhou TSN Technology Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "TSN") was established in Suzhou Industrial Park in 2021, established a Shanghai branch in 2023, and established a Wuhan R&D Center in 2024.
With the vision of "designing high-performance, low-latency, and easy-to-deploy switching chips," TSN independently develops domestic TSN (Time-Sensitive Networking) and ultra-low-latency switching chips, and provides chip and technical solutions for industrial automation, smart cities, connected vehicles, aerospace, healthcare, finance, and other fields. Together with customers and partners, TSN is advancing the innovation of domestically produced communication chips and technologies.
TSN currently has nearly 100 employees, of whom 30% hold a master's degree or above and 50% hold bachelor's degrees from 985/211 universities. Core members of the R&D team have an average of 10 years of work experience in communication chip design, hardware development, data switching software, and system testing.
With its full-protocol TSN chip as the core, TSN has built an integrated product system covering "chip/IP—equipment—software—solutions." The company focuses on scenarios with stringent requirements for low latency and high reliability, such as industrial automation, intelligent vehicles, and finance and securities. With fully domestic solutions and sub-microsecond deterministic forwarding as its core advantages, TSN possesses the capability to substitute imported high-end networking chips.
The company has achieved mass production of the 28nm fully self-developed 64G TSN switching chip TSN761210B0BI. The chip supports the complete TSN protocol suite and provides 128G line-rate switching capability. Its overall performance has reached the international first-class level. The chip has already been deployed at scale in multiple key industries, including power, rail transit, and the low-altitude economy.

11080.companyProfile: 贵州科晖创业投资管理有限责任公司成立于2018年，是省级科创投资专业平台，围绕“产业-科技两张皮”的使命，致力打通科技与产业之间的断层，实现资本增值与产业升级的双重目标。其下属子公司——贵州省黔云科创私募基金管理有限公司，承接科晖创投“投早、投小、投长期、投硬科技”的核心理念，以产业基金为抓手，推动“以投带引”，强化资本招商，助力全省“六大产业基地”建设与“3533”目标落地。公司围绕“三大战略产业+富矿精开+六大产业基地”，重点投向数字经济（AI、芯片、工业互联网等）、先进制造（高端装备、智能制造）、新一代信息技术（半导体、云计算、5G）及生物医药、新能源等战略新兴领域。通过贵州省科技创新股权投资基金、黔云科创成果转化股权投资基金等工具，精准锁定国家战略早中期、成长期创新企业，尤其关注具备“卡脖子”技术突破能力的硬科技项目，实现从实验室到产业化的资本助推。
11080.companyProfileEn: Guizhou Kehui Venture Capital Management Co., Ltd. was established in 2018 and is a provincial-level specialized platform for science and technology innovation investment. Guided by its mission of addressing the “two skins” disconnect between industry and science and technology, it is committed to bridging the gap between technology and industry and achieving the dual goals of capital appreciation and industrial upgrading. Its subsidiary, Guizhou Qianyun Sci-Tech Innovation Private Equity Fund Management Co., Ltd., carries forward Kehui Venture Capital’s core philosophy of “investing early, investing small, investing long-term, and investing in hard tech.” Using industrial funds as a key lever, it promotes “investment-led attraction,” strengthens capital-based investment promotion, and supports the province’s construction of the “six major industrial bases” and the implementation of the “3533” goals. Focusing on the “three major strategic industries + precision development of rich mineral resources + six major industrial bases,” the company prioritizes strategic emerging fields such as the digital economy (AI, chips, industrial internet, etc.), advanced manufacturing (high-end equipment, intelligent manufacturing), next-generation information technology (semiconductors, cloud computing, 5G), biomedicine, and new energy. 11113.companyProfileEn: South Sea Submarine Cable Co.,Ltd. is a wholly-owned subsidiary of ZTT Group (stock code: 600522), a Fortune China Top 500 enterprise. Phase I investment totaled RMB 2 billion and Phase II (RMB 1.5 billion) is under construction, with total floor area reaching 100,400 m². The company specializes in R&D, design, manufacturing, sales and technical services for AC fiber-optic composite submarine cables and power cables up to 500 kV, DC fiber-optic composite submarine cables and power cables up to ±800 kV, and special submarine cables including dynamic submarine cables and umbilical cables. It is one of only three manufacturers in China with mass-production capability for 500 kV three-core fiber-optic composite submarine cables, the highest voltage level commercially available worldwide, and has mastered manufacturing technologies for EHV, long-length and deep-water fiber-optic composite submarine cables and flexible joints. It has been certified as a National High-Tech Enterprise, a National Key "Little Giant" Enterprise and a National Specialized, Refined, Differentiated and Innovative (SRDI) "Little Giant", together with Guangdong Provincial SRDI SME status. It is recognized as a Guangdong Provincial Submarine Cable Engineering Technology Research Center and Enterprise Technology Center, holds Guangdong Green Industry Chain Certification, and has been approved as a National Green Factory, Guangdong Advanced Smart Factory and Guangdong Standard-Setting Leading Enterprise. It co-built the Guangdong Key Laboratory of Advanced Manufacturing Technology for Marine Energy Equipment. The company holds 65 patents, including 46 invention patents, and has participated in drafting 2 national standards, 1 industry standard and 8 group standards. In recent years it has received the Science and Technology Progress Award of the Chinese Mechanical Engineering Society, the Science and Technology Progress Award of the China Electrotechnical Society, the Electric Power Science and Technology Innovation Award of the China Electricity Council, science and technology awards from the Guangdong Mechanical Engineering Society, the Guangdong Electrical Industry Association and the Guangdong High-Tech Enterprise Association, and the Quality Technology Award of the Guangdong Association for Quality.

11222.companyProfile:
OXTS：为智慧港口提供高精度定位解决方案
OXTS 自 1998 年成立以来，始终致力于推动惯性导航与全球卫星导航系统（GNSS）技术的创新与发展。凭借 25 年以上的技术积淀，我们将高精度 GNSS 接收机与世界级惯性导航技术深度融合，专注于解决复杂环境下的高精度定位难题，为汽车测试、地理测绘、自动驾驶及移动测绘等领域提供高可靠性、高精度的定位解决方案。OXTS GNSS/INS 惯性导航系统可持续输出厘米级位置、航向、横滚角、俯仰角及速度等关键导航数据。

面向智慧港口的自动化与智能化发展需求，OXTS 推出WayFinder系列产品与 LiDAR Boost 激光雷达辅助定位技术，为复杂港口环境下的连续、高精度定位提供新的解决方案。在集装箱堆场、密集货物堆叠区域、仓储设施及室内外过渡区域，即使是卫星信号可能受到遮挡、干扰甚至完全中断的场景，通过将GNSS、惯性测量单元（IMU）与激光雷达（LiDAR）等传感器数据进行融合，在 GNSS 信号不稳定或缺失时维持可靠的厘米级定位与运动轨迹输出。

This fundamentally mitigates the pain point of data abuse and guarantees judicial admissibility in 72 countries globally.

11186.companyProfileEn:
Hefei Unitary Quantum Technology Co., Ltd. (Unitary Quantum), established in July 2022, is among the first companies founded through the transfer of intellectual property from the University of Science and Technology of China(USTC). It is China's only full-stack quantum computing company dedicated to the research, development, and commercialization of trapped-ion quantum computing based on the quantum charge-coupled device (QCCD) architecture, with technology developed in-house across the entire stack.

Unitary Quantum focuses on overcoming key technological challenges and accelerating the commercialization of research outcomes. The company has built extensive expertise in QCCD ion-trap chips, multi-ion control, quantum optics, and distributed quantum computing networks. The company operates a 5,500m² R&D center supported by 2,500m² of Class 10,000 cleanroom facilities with precision temperature and humidity control. It has undertaken major special projects for scientific and technological innovation in Anhui Province as well as “bidding‑by‑public‑listing” projects in Hefei. The company has built China's first cryogenic chip‑based trapped‑ion quantum‑computing prototype, realizing cryogenic ion trapping and ion transport. It has completed multiple iterations of integrated trapped-ion quantum computing systems and became the first in China to pass a quantum volume (QV) benchmark of 128, bringing its overall system performance to an internationally advanced level. Committed to systematic scientific and technological innovation, Unitary Quantum has partnered with numerous domestic universities, research institutes and high‑tech enterprises to establish the QCCD Trapped-Ion Quantum Computing Innovation Consortium. Through these collaborations, the company advances breakthroughs in key technologies and develops practical applications, helping drive the growth of future industries.

Unitary Quantum has received numerous qualifications and honors, including the National High-Tech Enterprise, Silver Award of the National Postdoctoral Innovation and Entrepreneurship Competition, Gold Award of the Anhui Postdoctoral Innovation and Entrepreneurship Competition, First Prize Winner in the “Innovating China” Anhui Innovation & Entrepreneurship Competition, Anhui Province Enterprise R&D Center, Anhui Province Postdoctoral Research Workstation, Anhui Province Specialized, Refinement, Differential, Innovation (SRDI) SME, and the "Advanced Collective" Award for Contribution to High-quality Economic and Social Development i

11187.companyProfile: 金属有机框架材料（MOF）荣获2025年诺贝尔化学奖，被誉为"改变世界的多孔材料"。开洋新材料（珠海）有限公司专注于MOF材料的规模化制备与产业化应用，突破了MOF材料批量化合成中成本高、成型难、稳定性差的行业瓶颈，实现千克级高纯度MOF颗粒及粉末的稳定量产。项目产品凭借超高比表面积和可精准调控的孔道结构，在极低湿度条件下仍具强吸附能力，可将空气中的水分高效捕获转化为饮用水，破解干旱缺水地区"有水无源"难题；同时可定向吸附甲醛、氨气等有害物，实现工业废气治理与室内空气净化的超低排放。产品已应用于空气净化、气体分离、应急饮水等领域，达产后预计年产值超亿元，对推动我国新材料产业升级、助力"双碳"目标及全球缺水地区饮水安全具有显著的经济与社会效益。
11187.companyProfileEn:
Metal-organic frameworks (MOFs), recognized by the 2025 Nobel Prize in Chemistry, are hailed as “world-changing porous materials.” KYON New Materials (Zhuhai) Co., Ltd. specializes in the scaled production and industrial application of MOF materials. The company has overcome major industry bottlenecks in large-scale MOF synthesis, including high costs, difficult shaping, and limited stability, achieving stable mass production of kilogram-scale, high-purity MOF granules and powders.
Featuring ultrahigh specific surface areas and precisely tunable pore structures, the project’s products maintain strong adsorption capacity even under extremely low humidity. They can efficiently capture moisture from the air and convert it into drinking water, offering a solution to the challenge of “water without a source” in arid regions. At the same time, they can selectively adsorb formaldehyde, ammonia, and other harmful substances, enabling ultra-low emissions in industrial exhaust treatment and indoor air purification.
The products have already been applied in air purification, gas separation, emergency drinking water supply, and other fields. Once full production capacity is reached, the project is expected to generate an annual output value exceeding RMB 100 million. It will deliver significant economic and social benefits by driving the upgrading of China’s new materials industry, supporting the country’s “dual-carbon” goals, and improving drinking-water security in water-scarce regions around the world.

10654.companyProfileEn:
Mingyue Lake Laboratory is a Chongqing Laboratory established by the CPC Chongqing Municipal Committee and the Chongqing Municipal People’s Government to implement the national innovation-driven development strategy, advance the “416” science and technology innovation framework, and build the “33618” modern manufacturing cluster system. It was officially inaugurated on July 16, 2025.
Rooted in Chongqing Liangjiang New Area and working in partnership with the Chinese Academy of Engineering, the laboratory builds its technical foundation on materials big data and intelligent design (AI-enabled materials science). Its core research focuses on advanced energy storage materials, high-performance lightweight materials, smart materials, and interdisciplinary frontier materials.
Aligned with the drive for new-quality productive forces, the laboratory follows a staged research pipeline: maturing technologies for commercial deployment, advancing prototypes in active development, preparing next-generation concepts, and exploring far-frontier ideas. Its vision is to grow into a world-leading hub for new-materials innovation, talent cultivation and industrial translation, serving western China and the whole nation.
As of October 2026, the laboratory brings together more than 700 researchers, research administrators and technical support specialists. Its landmark breakthroughs include ampere-hour scale magnesium-ion batteries, magnesium-based solid-state hydrogen storage materials and devices, and ultra-large integrated magnesium alloy castings — achievements recognized by honors such as the International Magnesium Association Future Technology Award, among more than ten major accolades.
The laboratory has forged industrial partnerships with leading enterprises including COMAC, Baowu Magnesium, Chinalco High-End Materials, Chaowei Group, Changan Automobile, Seres, BYD, Volvo and Mercedes-Benz.

10902.companyProfileEn:
Wuhan Skyblue Environmental Protection Technology Co., Ltd. is a national high-tech and national superior intellectual property demonstration enterprise. Its core integrated agglomeration and collaborative treatment technology was assessed by the China Electricity Council as internationally advanced and unique in China. In January 2025, it was Hubei’s only environmental protection manufacturer selected for the Green Technology Promotion Catalogue (2024 Edition) issued by eight authorities including the NDRC. Focused on coal-fired power environmental governance, it supports the transformation of new-generation coal power.

High-sulfur coal co-firing easily causes air preheater blockage in thermal power plants. Skyblue developed an original source control technology to fundamentally solve ammonium bisulfate blockage. It supports stable deep peak regulation under full-load conditions and enables safe co-firing of low-cost high-sulfur coal to cut fuel costs. It helps plants reach Grade A environmental performance, avoid emission-related production limits, reduce carbon and improve efficiency, balancing compliance and benefits.

This technology realizes collaborative multi-pollutant removal with stable mercury removal over 95%. It treats PM2.5, sulfur trioxide and desulfurization wastewater in one system. It needs little extra land and suits retrofits on existing facilities. It has obvious advantages in investment and operation cost over conventional processes.

The company serves major power groups including China Energy Investment, Huadian, SPIC and China Three Gorges. It has many stable operation cases on large coal-fired units and rich experience in commissioning and O&M. Long-term field operation has proven its reliability.

For the high-quality development of new coal-fired power, Skyblue abandons single-pollutant treatment ideas. Its integrated technology turns environmental investment from pure cost into extra benefits. It meets strict evaluation and Grade A standards, releases unit peak regulation capacity and taps high-sulfur coal co-firing potential to cut pollution, control carbon and raise profits.

Committed to thermal power upgrading via innovation, Skyblue provides customized one-stop environmental solutions for coal-fired plants. It guarantees stable, efficient and green operation and contributes to the new power system.

Shenzhen Technology University (SZTU) is a public institution of higher education established by Guangdong Province and Shenzhen Municipality with a sound beginning and high standards. Officially approved by the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China in November 2018, the university admitted its first cohort of undergraduate, master's, and doctoral students in 2019 (with master's and doctoral programs initially offered in collaboration with Shenzhen University). It closely aligns with national strategic needs and the industrial demands of Shenzhen and the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, striving to build itself into a cradle for innovative engineers and entrepreneurs, as well as a source of industrial technological innovation in the Greater Bay Area.

SZTU is located in Pingshan District, Shenzhen, with a total construction area of 1.05 million m². As of August 2025, there are more than 14,500 undergraduate students and over 1,100 master’s and doctoral students. The university employs more than 870 full-time teachers, including 116 professors and 235 associate professors. Over 400 faculty members are recognized as high-level talents at or above the municipal level, and 15 of them are listed among the world’s top-2% scientists. Among the full-time faculty, 83% hold doctoral degrees, 56% have overseas study or research experience, and 40% possess corporate R&D backgrounds.

光谷东智是华中地区首家具备研发、生产、交付与落地应用能力的具身智能机器人企业。公司以“打通机器人场景落地最后一公里”为使命，依托机器人本体和具身智能模型，打造行业场景解决方案，持续拓展具身智能机器人的应用场景，构建“+机器人”产业闭环。公司成立于2025年2月，由东阳光联合智元机器人、北武院及灵初智能共同组建，是东阳光布局人工智能产业的重要载体。
自成立以来，光谷东智专注于具身智能技术的研发与应用，已形成光子系列机器人产品矩阵，产品类别涵盖全尺寸人形、小尺寸人形、轮式人形、四足机器人、功能型机器人等，适配多样化场景需求。公司产品已落地于智慧康养、物流、新闻传媒等场景。在智慧康养场景，光谷东智推出“1+1+N”智慧康养解决方案。该方案以光子系列机器人为硬件载体，搭载自研智慧康养垂域大模型，面向养老院、康养社区等机构，提供健康管理、带操锻炼、安全巡检、情感陪伴、物流配送等人机协同服务，目前部分产品已在湖北养老机构进行试点。在医院物流场景，公司推出全院级物流机器人解决方案，可有效覆盖全院95%以上的物资转运场景。在新闻传媒场景，公司与湖北广电共同打造国内首个“媒体机器人”。2026年初，机器人记者已在全国两会、湖北两会上岗，承担中英文采访、互动交流、现场拍摄、新闻评论等工作。
量产方面，公司已建成湖北首座机器人工厂，目前已投产6条成熟产品生产线和3条样机中试线。光谷东智机器人工厂具备研发设计、样机中试、批量生产、综合测试等全链条能力。2025年8月，光谷东智与北京舞蹈学院联合打造的《秦俑魂》荣获首届世界机器人运动会首枚金牌；11月，公司荣获2025高新技术成果交易会“优秀科技创新企业”奖；12月，光子系列机器人获评2025年武汉市人工智能十大创新产品。

实验室在牵头重大任务中着力探索社会主义市场经济条件下关键核心技术攻关新型举国体制，累计承担国家及省部级科研项目250余项，已获批国家新型显示技术创新中心显示装备创新平台、广东省半导体高端装备及关键零部件工程研究中心等。成功研制出OLED喷墨打印装备及配套墨水材料、SiC高温外延装备、远程等离子源、晶圆缺陷检测装备、大功率微波/射频电源等系列成果。同时，在高端数控机床、航空航天、量子科技、超滑技术、人工智能、智能机器人、增材制造、新材料新器件、高端医疗装备等关键领域取得代表性成果，累计申请发明专利3239件，其中已授权2049件，在省实验室中位列首位。孵化27家科技型企业，孵化企业累计营业收入超10.8亿元。与过百家企业开展合作，助力制造产业高质量发展。

秉持 “凡是有‘呼吸’的地方都有康风的身影，让人们自由呼吸” 的创立初心，2026 年康风进一步拓展技术边界，将 AOP‑KF 固体碱专利技术应用至女性护理领域，推出康盾薇功能型卫生巾，具备抗病毒抑菌防护能力，打造女性健康护理品牌，以科技赋能女性经期健康防护。
11370.companyProfileEn:
Founded in 2013, Kangfeng is a national high-tech enterprise focused on the environment and health sectors. The company is dedicated to research on new materials for air disinfection and purification, as well as the development of related technologies and equipment, integrating R&D, production, sales, and technical services.
The company independently developed AOP-KF® solid alkali, a new air purification material that has been granted invention patents in both China and the United States. Kangfeng was the first to apply advanced oxidation technology to air disinfection and purification in micro-environments such as medical facilities, offices, homes, and large dynamic spaces, with its technology and products reaching the domestic leading level.
Its capabilities have repeatedly earned authoritative recognition. During the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics, Kangfeng's air disinfection and purification equipment was installed in competition venues including the Capital Indoor Stadium and the "Ice Ribbon" training venue, strengthening air safety for the Games, and the company was honored as a joint research unit under China's Ice and Snow Science and Technology Initiative. In 2024, it became the designated air purification brand of the Hangzhou Open. In 2026, Kangfeng's air jet purifier was deployed at the venue of the APEC Forestry Ministerial Meeting in Shenzhen; leveraging its full-area continuous purification and circulation technology, it provided clean air, odor control, and environmental safety assurance for this high-level international summit, successfully completing the air quality assurance mission for a top-tier international conference.
Guided by its founding mission—"Wherever there is breath, there is Kangfeng, so that people can breathe freely"—Kangfeng further expanded its technological reach in 2026 by applying its patented AOP-KF solid alkali technology to the feminine care sector. It launched Kangdunwei functional sanitary pads with antiviral and antibacterial protection, building a feminine health care brand and empowering women's menstrual health protection through science and technology.

福全至消防科技(深圳）有限公司是一家聚焦“保障生命安全”领域的创新型应急装备制造商,致力于研发为高质量发展兜底的生命救助装备。2019年因身边朋友一家六口遭遇火灾罹难,创始团队立志做一款应对火灾的救命产品。公司历时七年，以“平急两用+折叠收纳”为设计理念,联合应急管理部天津消防研究所，成功研发出全球首创的[福安至火灾自救舱],委托应急管理部四川消防研究所检验合格，取得多项发明专利，,制定了企业标准，参与多项火灾救援设施团体标准编制。针对“救不了，逃不了”的极端火灾场景，以“空间换时间”构建“自救+互救+公救”闭环,重点保障“一老一小”等应急脆弱群体生命安全，打造以家庭为单位的基层应急救援体系建设,夯实韧性城市安全基座。

公司秉承“防救结合”的经营理念,通过“设备救援+安全培训+家庭火灾险”等多重体系，构建人身安全、财产安全与认知安全的综合保障系统,持续引领应急装备革新。
11435.companyProfileEn:
Fuquanzhi Fire Protection Technology (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd. is an innovative emergency equipment manufacturer focusing on the field of "life safety protection". It is committed to developing life-saving equipment that underpins high-quality development.

In 2019, after the founding team witnessed the tragedy where a friend’s family of six died in a fire, they resolved to create a life-saving product for fire emergencies. Over seven years of development, guided by the design concept of **dual-purpose for daily and emergency use + foldable storage**, the company jointly developed the world-first **Fuanzhi Fire Self-rescue Capsule** with the Tianjin Fire Research Institute of the Ministry of Emergency Management. The product passed inspection by the Sichuan Fire Research Institute of the Ministry of Emergency Management, holds a number of invention patents, has formulated enterprise standards, and participated in the drafting of multiple group standards for fire rescue facilities.

For extreme fire scenarios where rescue and escape are impossible, the product adopts the strategy of "trading space for time" to form a closed loop of **self-rescue + mutual rescue + public rescue**. It prioritizes protecting vulnerable groups such as the elderly and children, builds a grassroots emergency rescue system based on family units, and consolidates the safety foundation of resilient cities.

Upholding the business philosophy of **integrating prevention and rescue, the company establishes a comprehensive protection system covering personal safety, property safety and safety awareness through an integrated solution including rescue equipment, safety training and family fire insurance. It keeps driving innovation in emergency equipment.
