贵州科学城科技创新园介绍
一、功能定位
贵州科学城科技创新园是省政府与中国科学院共建的省院合作重大科创平台，地处贵阳国家高新区白金大道与高海路交汇处，属贵阳贵安“一核三心”北部核心区。园区占地185.4亩，总建筑面积21.2万㎡，分科研办公区、研发实验区、中试区三大板块，使用率85.27%，自2022年起连续三年入围全国科技城百强榜。2023年5月获批国家级科技企业孵化器，紧扣“四新四化”战略部署，聚焦电子信息、新材料、先进制造、生物医药、新能源、现代农业六大方向招才引智。
二、运营主体与培育体系
园区由贵州省科技创新中心有限责任公司统筹，贵州科学城管理有限责任公司负责现场运维与孵化运营，对接中科院、南方科技大学等大院大所。构建“国家级科技企业孵化器—贵州省技术交易市场—专业垂直孵化基地”三位一体培育体系，形成“孵化—加速—产业化”全生命周期服务链条；贵州省技术交易市场征集科技成果4684项，布局数字经济专业孵化器、中医药技术转化创新中心两大垂直平台，探索“省外科研+贵州载体+本地产业化”协作模式。
三、运营成效
园区集聚科研机构、企业140余家，其中在孵企业41家；集聚科研人员2000余人，含两院院士2人、博士140人、硕士236人，培育高新技术企业15家、专精特新企业11家。2025年新增科技成果113项，累计3461项，促进转化113项，带动企业累计实现产值266亿元。
四、政策服务与发展方向
园区统筹省、市、高新区三级政策资源，推行“三包一免”服务模式，对优质创业团队落实食宿、创业、资源对接保障及场地费用减免，高能级平台实行“一事一议”；创新“先投后股（拨投结合）”机制，提供项目研判、创业辅导、设施共享、技术交易、市场拓展全链条孵化服务。下一步，园区将立足贵州、面向西南、服务全国，对标国家卓越级科技企业孵化器标准，打造科技成果转化示范标杆。
10946.companyProfileEn:
Guizhou Science City Sci-Tech Innovation Park
I. Positioning
Co-built by the Guizhou Provincial Government and the Chinese Academy of Sciences, the Park is a key provincial-academy platform in Guiyang National High-tech Zone. Covering 185.4 mu (12.36 ha) and 212,000 m2 at 85.27% occupancy, it has ranked among China's top 100 science cities since 2022 and became a national sci-tech business incubator in May 2023. It recruits talent in six fields: electronic information, new materials, advanced manufacturing, biomedicine, new energy and modern agriculture.
II. Operators and System
Guizhou Provincial Sci-Tech Innovation Center Co., Ltd. coordinates the Park; Guizhou Science City Management Co., Ltd. runs operations and incubation, partnering with the Chinese Academy of Sciences and other top institutions. A three-in-one system — national incubator, Guizhou Technology Exchange Market and vertical bases — forms a full-cycle incubation-acceleration-industrialization chain. The Market has pooled 4,684 achievements and hosts two vertical platforms for digital economy and TCM transformation.
III. Performance
The Park hosts over 140 institutions and firms, including 41 incubated companies, and 2,000-plus researchers: 2 academicians, 140 PhDs, 236 master's holders. It has nurtured 15 high-tech and 11 SRDI enterprises. In 2025 it added 113 achievements (3,461 cumulative) and commercialized 113, driving RMB 26.6 billion in cumulative output.
IV. Policies and Direction
Integrating provincial, municipal and zone policies, the Park applies a "three guarantees, one exemption" model for quality teams and case-by-case terms for top platforms. It pioneers grant-to-equity funding and offers full-chain services from assessment to market expansion. Going forward, it will root in Guizhou, serve the Southwest and reach nationwide, benchmarking national excellence standards to become a commercialization demonstration.

It is the fifth engineering technology company in China to hold the top-tier "Four Comprehensive and One Grade A" qualifications portfolio, comprising Grade A comprehensive engineering design, Grade A comprehensive engineering survey, comprehensive engineering supervision, Grade A comprehensive credit rating for engineering consulting, and Grade A urban and rural planning.
Its market reach extends both domestically and internationally. With a well-established nationwide market network and more than 80 branch offices, it has undertaken projects in Belt and Road countries such as the Philippines, Qatar, Angola, and Nepal. The company is home to a large contingent of distinguished experts, including National Engineering Survey and Design Masters, experts receiving special government allowances from the State Council, and professor-level senior engineers. It operates a number of engineering technology research centers and has won more than 200 science and technology awards of various kinds. It serves as the president unit of the Wuhan Survey and Design Industry Association and the vice-president unit of the Hubei Province Survey and Design Association.

Xi’an Saite New Materials Science and Technology Co., Ltd. was established on November 20, 2000, with a registered capital of 90 million RMB. It is a holding company of  Northwest Institute for Nonferrous Metal Research Group（NIN) . Saite is located in Xi’an Economic and Technological Development Zone , covering an area of 137,333m². Currently, it has more than 300 employees. Saite specializes in the fields of biomedical, aerospace, and ordnance equipment, mainly engaged in the research, production, and sales of titanium and nitinol materials.Saite is recognized as a national high-tech enterprise and a key player in the “Specialized, Refined, Distinctive, and Innovative” enterprise.
Saite has two wholly-owned subsidiaries, Xi’an Saite Simai Titanium Industry Co., Ltd. and Xi’an Siwei Smart Materials Co., Ltd. It possesses a complete process of rare metal processing materials production line from raw materials to finished products.Saite is one of the largest research and production bases for biomedical titanium materials in China, and also one of the leading manufacturers of large-sized single-weight wire for aerospace fasteners. At the same time, it is one of the earliest high-tech enterprises in China to engage in the research and production of nitinol materials. As well as one of the larger domestic production bases for small and medium-sized precision forgings for both military and civilian use. It is capable of producing various types of rare metal processed materials as well as customer-customized ones.
Saite Company's products cover four areas: high-end titanium materials for biomedical applications, metal wires and bars for dual-use (military and civilian) fasteners, multi-purpose nickel-titanium-based functional materials, and precision titanium alloy forgings for dual-use (military and civilian) purposes.

主打产品AI柔性重载搬运机器人已在16个行业、87个场景完成应用验证，覆盖重载码垛、高速分拣、智能立库和自动装卸车。客户包括中兴通讯、京东物流、欧派家居等。

本届高交会，行远清大期待与制造企业、系统集成商、科研院所及产业资本合作，推动柔性机器人在高端制造、物流仓储和新能源领域的规模化应用。
11626.companyProfileEn:
Xingyuan Qingda (Gobeyond Robots) Technology is a leading developer of cable-driven flexible robots, with its technology rooted in Tsinghua University. The company was founded to commercialize the cable-driven flexible control technology that Tsinghua University developed for China's FAST radio telescope ("China Sky Eye"), and holds invention patents licensed by Tsinghua University. Instead of rigid robot arms or gantries, the company uses ultra-high-molecular composite cables that work together to move the end effector. A single robot can cover a workspace tens of meters wide while handling heavy loads at high speed. The company delivers complete solutions for flexible packaging automation, long-span heavy-load handling, and plant-wide process scheduling and equipment integration.
The group follows a "R&D in the Greater Bay Area, manufacturing in Guangqing" model. Its headquarters and R&D center are at Tsinghua Innovation City, Songshan Lake, Dongguan, where it runs a joint laboratory with Tsinghua University. Its manufacturing base and regional delivery center is in the Guangqing Industrial Park, Qingyuan. The group also works with Sun Yat-sen University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, and research teams in Canada and Italy.
The company holds more than 20 invention patents and 6 software copyrights, and has published over 30 papers. A novelty search found its core technology to be internationally unique, and an expert evaluation rated its key results as internationally leading. Awards include the 2021 China Patent Silver Award, the China Machinery Industry Science and Technology Award, and the First Prize for Technological Invention from the China Instrument and Control Society.
Its flagship product, the AI-Powered Cable-Driven Flexible Heavy-Load Handling Robot, has been validated in 87 scenarios across 16 industries, including heavy-load palletizing, high-speed sorting, automated storage and truck loading/unloading. Customers include ZTE, JD Logistics and OPPEIN.
Looking ahead, Xingyuan Qingda is extending cable-driven technology into new energy and embodied intelligence. In concentrated solar power (CSP), the company is exploring cable-driven flexible transmission for heliostat drives and mirror-field cleaning and maintenance. Fewer mechanical drive parts and lighter structures could lower the cost of building and maintaining mirror fields, making CSP, a clean power source with built-in storage that can be dispatched on demand, more economical. 11688.companyProfileEn:
StarArk (Shenzhen Fuxi Technology Co., Ltd.) is an AI wearables and proactive Agent hardware company founded in October 2025. Our core team, drawn from CUHK, Peking University and leading AI labs, operates a lean OPC model and is backed by MiraclePlus. We are a founding hardware partner in Huawei Cloud's AI device zone and a deep technology partner of ByteDance Volcano Engine ArkClaw.
We build always-on, lightweight wearable devices — AI collaboration glasses, an AI smart ring and an AI pendant recording pod — that capture round-the-clock context, build long-term memory and execute tasks autonomously. Our Perception–Memory–Action framework closes the loop from hands-free information capture to structured memory and proactive task completion: on-device sensing records conversations without manual operation; a three-layer long-term memory system organizes people, events and relationships into a knowledge graph; and a proactive Agent generates meeting minutes, syncs to-dos and updates customer profiles across Feishu, OA, CRM and ERP systems — delivering "conversation as execution."
Targeting high-information-density professionals such as managers, sales teams, consultants, finance researchers and lawyers, our solutions have completed POCs with clients including PwC and Huawei Hong Kong, improving key-requirement capture accuracy by about 40% and cutting information-organizing time by about 80%. We have received awards including the Best Technology Application Award at WAIC 2025 and the Best AI Hardware Award at the 2026 Shenzhen AI Conference, and have showcased our products at Huawei Connect, WAIC, the PwC AI Summit and the Huawei Hong Kong Summit.

Guangdong Huibaochang Precision Manufacturing Co., Ltd. was founded in 1994 and is an enterprise dedicated to the research, development, and manufacturing of precision hardware components and precision molds. With over 30 years of experience in precision manufacturing, the company has established integrated manufacturing capabilities spanning product process evaluation, mold R&D and design, sample prototyping, precision stamping and deep drawing, automated mass production, and quality inspection.
The company's core products include precision deep-drawn components, precision stamped structural parts, internal metal structural components for equipment, precision molds, and automated continuous stamping products. Existing products are widely applied in fields such as intelligent equipment, robotics, industrial automation, medical devices, smart home appliances, and power tools. Leveraging long-term accumulated capabilities in precision stamping, deep drawing, mold development, and automated mass production, the company is strategically expanding into the semiconductor equipment, high-end automation equipment, and precision instrumentation sectors. It is equipped to undertake the R&D, prototyping, and batch manufacturing of internal equipment brackets, enclosures, base plates, shielding components, mounting parts, and various non-standard precision stamped and drawn components.
The company possesses strong capabilities in deep drawing, continuous stamping, multi-station forming, and automated mass production. With an in-house mold R&D team, we deliver end-to-end services including process evaluation, mold design and development, sample prototyping, process optimization, and mass production launch based on customer drawings and application requirements. 海南清文雅音科技有限公司是国家高新技术企业、国家知识产权优势企业，为绿色声环境开创者，核心技术源自新加坡、文莱，具备全球化科研视野与较强社会责任担当。公司与中央民族大学可信数据智能与安全治理实验室、清华大学物理系声学实验室、新加坡南洋理工大学 AI 实验室、文莱理工大学科学技术创新联合实验室等多家国内外顶尖科研机构建立深度战略合作，累计取得 186 项荣誉认证及国内外知识产权证书。
公司自主研发全球首款民用定向声环境系统 “定向听博士” 系列产品，实现声音定向传播，斩获多项国内外大奖，产品广泛应用于展览展示、金融银行、公共交通、医院医疗、安防驱离等十余个行业场景。企业荣获 2025 年度 “最具成长潜力的留学人员创业企业”，是海南近十年唯一获此殊荣的企业。同时公司曾斩获由中国科技部、东盟秘书处主办的 2023 年中国 — 东盟创新创业大赛一等奖，拥有深厚的中国东盟科技创新合作基础。
立足海南陵水数字基础设施优势，依托本地国际海底通信光缆登陆基站、海底智算中心以及黎安国际教育创新试验区、海归小镇产业生态，公司发起陵水 “词元港” Token 出海项目。项目充分发挥陵水亚洲快链（ALC）国际海缆登陆站南向通道优势，联合贵阳贵安超算研究院、中央民族大学可信数据智能与安全治理实验室，在超算调度、Token 聚合、隐私计算、数据跨境合规等方面构建核心技术能力，面向东南亚高校、中资企业输出高性价比 AI 算力服务，打造 “算力在境、服务出海、收入回流” 商业闭环。

11178.companyProfile: 青岛清万水技术有限公司初创于1999年（以下简称“清万水”），深耕于水流量在线监测技术的研发和应用已有27年。是国家级高新技术企业、山东省瞪羚企业、山东省专精特新企业、山东省节水产业重点企业、山东省首台（套）技术装备生产企业、青岛市产业领军人才团队、青岛市“一企一技术”研发中心、青岛市国际科技合作项目关键技术攻关企业；自主研发的测流设备分别入选2021年度及2024年度《水利先进实用技术重点推广指导目录》。清万水是中国农业节水协会第四届理事会理事单位；是青岛市智能制造产业商会会长单位；是中国水利学会水利量测技术专业委员会委员单位。清万水是多项国家标准与团体标准的主要起草单位，如国家标准《GB/T 35717-2024水轮机、蓄能泵和水泵水轮机流量的测量超声传播时间法》；中国水利学会团标《声学时差法流量测验规范》等。清万水为一系列抗旱防灾建设提供先进可靠的量测技术和服务，包括管涵计量、平原河网、明渠输水和山区性洪水测量。从我国南部的海南省南渡江引水工程到北部的鸡西七台河供水工程，从我国东部的上海青草沙水源地原水工程到西部的西藏冲巴雍措水库，产品应用已覆盖全国走向海外，如著名的南水北调东中线工程、珠江三角洲水资源配置工程、三峡电站、嘉兴南排骨干河道流量量测工程、越南松拉水电站、土耳其kzbuku水电站等。清万水于青岛市临空经济示范区建设投产的世界级大管道动水明渠大流量实验室。该实验中心占地规模33,125㎡，集校准、检测、测试、研发、办公多功能为一体。具备世界级动水流量在线检测校准实验设施，该实验设施长85.2m，宽36.2m，占地规模达3084㎡。其明渠检测段最大宽度技术指标为7m，管道检测段最大管径技术指标为DN3000。清万水，测万水，为中国水量测事业努力奋斗，推动世界水量测技术进步。
11178.companyProfileEn:
Founded in 1999, Qingdao Headwaters Technology Co.,Ltd (hereinafter referred to as Headwaters) has been engaged in the R&D and application of online water flow monitoring technology for 27 years. It is a National High Tech Enterprise, Shandong Gazelle Enterprise, Shandong Specialized.
Headwaters is a principal drafter of multiple national and association standards, such as the national standard GB/T 35717 2024 Measurement of Flow in Hydraulic Turbines, Storage Pumps and Pump Turbines — Ultrasonic Time of Flight Method, and the association standard Specification for Acoustic Time Difference Flow Measurement issued by the Chinese Hydraulic Engineering Society.Headwaters provides advanced and reliable measurement technologies and services for drought resistance and disaster prevention projects, covering pipe culvert metering, plain river networks, open channel water conveyance and mountain flood measurement. Its products are deployed nationwide and exported overseas. Representative projects range from the Nandujiang Water Diversion Project in Hainan Province in southern China and the Jixi Qitaihe Water Supply Project in northern China, to the Qingcaosha Raw Water Project in Shanghai in eastern China and the Chongbayongcuo Reservoir in Xizang in western China. Major landmark projects include the East Middle Route of the South to North Water Diversion Project, the Pearl River Delta Water Resources Allocation Project, the Three Gorges Power Station, and the Jiaxing South Drainage Main River Flow Measurement Project. Overseas references include Vietnam’s Son La Hydropower Station and Türkiye’s Kzbuku Hydropower Station.Headwaters has built and commissioned a world class large pipe dynamic water and large open channel flow laboratory in the Qingdao Lingang Economic Demonstration Zone. Covering a total area of 33,125 m², this experimental center integrates calibration, inspection, testing, R&D and office functions. It houses world class facilities for online dynamic water flow inspection and calibration: the test facility is 85.2 m long and 36.2 m wide, occupying 3084 m². Its open channel test section reaches a maximum width of 7 m, and its pipe test section accommodates a maximum pipe diameter of DN3000.

GanoHerb Group, which originated in 1989, integrates the breeding and cultivation, production, research and development and health services of Ganoderma. In recent years, GanoHerb has continued to focus on scientific research innovation and cultural heritage, promoting the high-quality development of the Ganoderma health industry. In 2018, GanoHerb was selected as the only Ganoderma category enterprise in the national "Three Frees and One Whole" brand medicinal material bases. In 2019, the national key research and development plan undertaken by GanoHerb, namely the Ganoderma special project on "Research on the Modernization of Traditional Chinese Medicine", was approved by the Ministry of Science and Technology. In 2020, GanoHerb was selected into the National Brand Project of Xinhua News Agency and settled in the Xinhua Credit Platform, and was dedicated to building a "leading brand in Chinese Ganoderma industry".

11479.companyProfileEn:

The second large-scale production base, Tiger-Hydraulics, was also put into operation in Changzhou. HANSA-FLEX China has become the largest overseas market outside Europe. We are constantly striving to become the world's leading hydraulic supplier, and the Chinese market is our top priority.

Core product
HANSA-FLEX's core products encompass the processing and production of hose assemblies, pipe fittings and flanges, quick connectors and ball valves, pipe clamps and testing systems, hydraulic components, and hydraulic systems.

Technology

Equipped with multiple high-precision CNC tube bending machines, the center can accommodate tubes of different sizes and provides a one-stop solution for tube solutions, including hard and soft tube assemblies, tube accessories, as well as on-site tube mapping and installation services.

10766.companyProfileEn:
Shanghai Sysolar Technology Co., Ltd. (SUNY) is a new materials enterprise focusing on the space photovoltaic sector, with technologies originating from the Shanghai Institute of Optics and Fine Mechanics, Chinese Academy of Sciences. Centered on space-grade perovskite formulations, flexible substrate technologies and aerospace environmental testing capabilities, the company has established a product portfolio of space photovoltaic devices featuring light weight, flexibility and high specific power.The company’s core products fall into two categories. The first is self-developed aerospace-grade transparent polyimide material SCPI. Built upon lightweight and flexible properties, it delivers high light transmittance, thermal dimensional stability and compatibility with space environments. It can meet the front and rear transparent encapsulation requirements for various batteries including perovskite, HJT and crystalline silicon cells, and is also applicable to substrates for transparent flexible solar arrays. The second is the in-house developed single-junction bifacial light-absorbing perovskite cell. 11483.companyProfileEn:
Huagong Xinyan (Shenzhen) Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2021 and is a National High-Tech Enterprise and a Shenzhen Specialized, Refined, Distinctive and Innovative (SRDI) Small and Medium-sized Enterprise. Relying on industry–academia–research platforms established with South China University of Technology and the China-Singapore International Joint Research Institute, the company has co-built the "Joint Research Center for Innovative Pharmaceuticals and Soluble Microneedle Skincare Technology Applications" and the "Joint Laboratory for Frontier Pharmaceuticals and Soluble Microneedle Ultra-Penetration Skincare Research and Industrial Translation," and is deeply engaged in ultra-penetrating, painless and precise delivery technologies for active ingredients. Its core "Dual-Import Precise Delivery Technology System for Active Substances" combines the physical microporation of soluble microneedles with the biochemical penetration enhancement of borneol derivatives, increasing the transdermal absorption rate of active ingredients from less than 5% under conventional conditions to over 90%.
The company has established three core delivery technology platforms: borneol-based soluble microneedles, DNA nanonucleic acids, and biomass carbon quantum dots. In the borneol-based soluble microneedle direction, it has built China's first automated microneedle patch production line, with an annual capacity of more than 20 million patches; its nucleic acid pyramid technology focuses on the intracellular delivery of active ingredients via DNA nanostructures; and its carbon quantum dot direction centers on the preparation and application development of nanomaterials derived from the leaves of Cinnamomum burmannii (borneol-type). Relevant invention patents have been granted. The company holds more than 20 patents and has integrated the entire chain from R&D through production to market, supporting OEM/ODM services. Its own brand "Huagong Xinyan" has maintained a leading position in sales within its market segment for soluble microneedle patch products on e-commerce platforms such as Xiaohongshu and Douyin. The company continues to advance the industrialization of frontier technologies in the beauty, health, and biopharmaceutical fields.

11633.companyProfileEn:
Shenzhen Tongwei Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in Shenzhen, Guangdong in 2010. It boasts a top-tier R&D team specializing in equipment computers and industrial control computers in China. Its core technical experts have been engaged in the industry for more than a decade with solid expertise in developing industrial-grade computing products. Since its establishment, the company has consistently focused on the industrial control computing track, pursuing continuous innovation across the full technology stack of hardware, firmware and software. It has accumulated mature application cases in multiple fields including industrial control, servers, vehicle-mounted systems, marine equipment and information encryption. Its products are widely recognized in the industry for high stability and reliability.
At present, targeting high-risk operation scenarios, Tongwei Technology has launched an embodied intelligent quadruped robot inspection system. It addresses industry pain points of manual inspection, such as high safety risks, low efficiency, blind inspection zones and passive fault handling, and enables unmanned operations in high-risk environments. Adaptable to complex working conditions, the system features outstanding obstacle-crossing and climbing performance. Integrated with multi-sensors, it achieves centimeter-level positioning and high accuracy in meter reading recognition. Equipped with quickly replaceable mission payloads, it supports 7×24-hour automatic on-duty inspection. Built on its self-developed four-layer architecture Embodied AI OS, the system integrates three core technologies: SLAM mapping, vision-language large model Agent and reinforcement learning adaptive gait, and is compatible with heterogeneous devices such as quadruped robots and UAVs. The solution covers the whole chain from R&D to deployment. With self-developed underlying algorithm base, it significantly cuts delivery costs. The company provides industrial customers with a standardized and open general embodied intelligence central platform, empowering the digital and safety upgrading of high-risk industrial scenarios.

11396.companyProfileEn:
China-Singapore International Joint Research Institute (hereinafter referred to as "the Institute") is a major science and technology cooperation project between China and Singapore. Based in China-Singapore Guangzhou Knowledge City, it serves as a major international science and technology cooperation platform that brings together world-class R&D resources. Guided by demand, the Institute will introduce the superior scientific and technological expertise and talent resources of South China University of Technology, Nanyang Technological University of Singapore, and other renowned universities and R&D institutions at home and abroad. Through institutional and technological innovation, it will establish an "open, diverse, dynamic and efficient" innovation model, further unleash the vitality and creativity of scientific and technological resources, and accelerate the translation and commercialization of advanced, mature international technologies and products. Focusing on the IAB (Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence and Biotechnology) and NEM (New Energy and New Materials) industries that Guangzhou prioritizes, the Institute has built six R&D platforms: Information and Communication Technology, Life and Health, New Energy, New Materials, Green Building and Smart City, and Pollution Control and Environmental Remediation. It has introduced a number of international cooperation industrialization projects and incubated and brought in a group of high-tech start-up enterprises.
Guangzhou Huachi Natron Energy Technology Co., Ltd. is a technology-based start-up incubated on the platform of the Institute by the Guangdong Provincial Key Laboratory of Advanced Energy Storage Materials of South China University of Technology. Dedicated to the industrialization and application of sodium-ion battery cathode materials, the company also engages in the development of sodium-ion battery technology and customized development of sodium-ion battery applications. At the same time, the company is pursuing the development of next-generation energy storage devices, namely high-specific-energy solid-state battery materials, processes, technologies and devices.

实验室聚焦“粤语+人工智能”的文化科技融合，围绕粤语文化精神标识体系研究、通用粤语语料库建设、大模型粤语言语交互质量评测、大模型粤语言语交互质量提升四个方向开展研究，推动粤语数据化、资源化、服务化和产业化。
在语料资源方面，研究粤语文化分类、标注规范与质量标准，建设涵盖文本、音频、图像、视频等类型的多模态高质量粤语语料库，并探索AI辅助标注、人机协同和开放协作机制。在技术平台方面，围绕统一词条身份、结构化标签、语义检索及API服务，研究面向人工智能应用的粤语数据检索、基础设施开发与多模态大模型研发。
在大模型研究方面，重点开展粤语言语理解与生成、语音 ASR 与 TTS、内容安全评测与文化评测等方向，并通过数据、模型、AI Agent及应用系统的协同优化，提升文本/语音大模型的粤语交互质量、安全性与实际应用能力，形成“粤语数据集—大语言模型—AI Agent—创新应用”一体化研究体系。
11029.companyProfileEn:
The laboratory focuses on the integration of Cantonese language and culture with artificial intelligence (AI), advancing research in four key areas: **Cantonese Cultural Identity and Representation, General-Purpose Cantonese Corpus Development, Evaluation of Cantonese Language Interaction Quality in Large Models, and Enhancement of Cantonese Language Interaction Capabilities in Large Models.** Through these efforts, the laboratory aims to promote the digitization, resource development, service delivery, and industrial application of Cantonese language resources.

**In language resources**, the laboratory investigates Cantonese cultural classification, annotation specifications, and quality standards. It is developing a high-quality multimodal Cantonese corpus encompassing text, audio, images, and video, while exploring AI-assisted annotation, human–AI collaboration, and open collaborative frameworks.

**In technology platforms**, the laboratory focuses on unified lexical entry identification, structured tagging, semantic search, and API services. Its research covers Cantonese data retrieval systems, AI-oriented infrastructure development, and multimodal large model development.

**In large model research**, the laboratory prioritizes Cantonese language understanding and generation, automatic speech recognition (ASR), text-to-speech synthesis (TTS), content safety evaluation, and cultural competency assessment. Through the coordinated optimization of data, models, AI agents, and application systems, it seeks to enhance the quality, safety, and real-world applicability of Cantonese interactions with large language and speech models.

Ultimately, the laboratory aims to establish an integrated research framework encompassing **Cantonese Datasets → Large Language Models → AI Agents → Innovative Applications**, fostering technological innovation and practical applications within the Cantonese AI ecosystem.

Its business scope covers aerospace technology application and technical services; design, development, manufacturing and sales of vacuum, cryogenic and electronic equipment as well as surface engineering products; and self-operated and agency import and export of various goods and technologies.

Leveraging its strengths in vacuum and surface engineering technologies and focusing on national strategic emerging sectors such as commercial aerospace and advanced new materials, the company, together with the 510th Institute, follows the overall principle of “institute-company linkage” and “integrated technological innovation”. It explores and practices pathways for the transformation and industrialization of aerospace technologies, and has grown into a core and premium supplier of lubricated bearings for commercial aerospace, lubrication for moving parts, thermal control films, coatings and related products.

The company has established a supplier management and control system and a qualified supplier roster, fostering a pool of reliable and stable suppliers to guarantee the supply of raw materials and materials. It has obtained certification to the GJB 9001C quality management system. Featuring consistent and dependable quality, its products have been widely deployed on satellite constellations including the State Grid constellation and the G60 constellation.

CNACG is the only national-level comprehensive analytical and testing center established by the Ministry of Science and Technology of China in South China. It holds accreditation from the China National Accreditation Service for Conformity Assessment (CNAS) and China Inspection Body and Laboratory Mandatory Approval (CMA).

In response to national strategic priorities and industrial development needs, CNACG focuses on advancing key research disciplines, including chemical metrology, environmental chemistry, materials chemistry, medicinal chemistry, and scientific instrumentation development. The institute operates two national-level centers and 14 provincial-level research, development, and technical service platforms. Its technical services encompass eight major sectors: pharmaceuticals and healthcare, food and agricultural products, ecological and environmental protection, occupational and industrial safety, materials and chemical engineering, light industry and textiles, precision instrumentation, and forensic science.

Over the years, CNACG has achieved more than 200 significant scientific and technological research outcomes and provides technical services to over 10,000 clients annually. Through its comprehensive analytical and testing capabilities, the institute delivers robust cross-cutting analytical and testing technologies and technical support, contributing to the development of a modern industrial system and the improvement of public well-being.

The company is committed to combining technological innovation with practical engineering applications, providing high-performance, highly reliable, and cost-effective products and integrated solutions for the commercial aerospace industry and related sectors. It aims to advance satellite integrated electronics toward greater intelligence, networking, modularization, and mass production.

11552.companyProfileEn:

Centered on tactical-grade noise reduction technology, OPSMEN specializes in the R&D, manufacturing, and sales of hearing protection and tactical communication equipment. Its products include sound-amplifying noise-reduction headsets, electronic earplugs, PTT (push-to-talk) devices, and the “Little Bird” tactical communication system. They are used in military and law-enforcement operations and in fire and rescue scenarios. The company operates an integrated model covering R&D, production, and sales. It holds ISO 9001, ANSI, and CE certifications and exports to more than 40 countries.

OPSMEN is a National High-Tech Enterprise and a provincial-level specialized, refined, distinctive, and innovative (SRDI) small and medium-sized enterprise. It has a Grade A taxpayer credit rating and more than 70 patents. Guided by the EARMOR philosophy of “hear clearly, protect reliably,” the company has pursued independent R&D to break the international monopoly in the field. Its products are officially endorsed by IPSC and sell well in more than 120 countries.

Committed to its founding mission of “protecting our most beloved people,” OPSMEN provides domestically developed protective equipment to frontline personnel in the military, police, firefighting, and rescue services. It has supported earthquake rescue efforts in Myanmar and is working to bring Chinese tactical communication equipment to the global market.

乙川具芯（深圳）科技有限公司是一家专注具身机器人关节驱控一体化SoC芯片研发的集成电路设计企业，核心团队源自高校集成电路重点实验室，拥有多款ASIC量产经验与多项国内外发明专利。公司致力于为客户提供自主可控、高性价比的国产关节芯片解决方案。
公司主力产品YC32I104，是一款面向电机控制应用的SoC芯片，为机器人提供高性能、低功耗、高可靠性的“小脑“。芯片内核基于32位RISC-V指令集，主频高达180Mhz；支持FOC矢量控制，转速可达5000rpm以上，持续扭矩可达30N·m（搭配减速器）。产品具备高精度力矩控制与快速动态响应，满足协作机器人、人形机器人关节对紧凑集成、低纹波、高可靠性伺服驱动的需求。相比传统产品，板卡体积缩小80%以上，功耗降低40%以上，成本降低40%以上，可有效帮助客户增效、降本和实现平台复用。
11568.companyProfileEn:
Yckon (Shenzhen) Technology Co., Ltd. is an IC design company specializing in the R&D of system-on-chip (SoC) solutions that integrate joint drive and control for embodied robots. Its core team comes from IC laboratories at leading universities and brings experience in the mass production of multiple ASIC products, along with a number of domestic and international invention patents. The company is committed to delivering efficient, highly reliable, and cost-effective domestic chips to its customers.

The company’s flagship product, the YC32I104, is an SoC designed for motor control applications, and serves as a high-performance, low-power, highly reliable "cerebellum" for robots. Built on the 32-bit RISC-V instruction set architecture, the chip features a main frequency of up to 180 MHz. It enables FOC vector control, achieving rotational speeds exceeding 5000 rpm and continuous torque of up to 30 N·m (when paired with a reducer).

Delivering high-precision torque control and fast dynamic response, the product meets the servo drive requirements of collaborative robots and humanoid robot joints-namely compact integration, low ripple, and high reliability. Compared with conventional products, it reduces board size by more than 80%, power consumption by more than 40%, and cost by more than 40%. It effectively helps customers improve efficiency, cut costs and achieve platform reuse.

10891.companyProfile: 前身为西南大学家蚕基因组生物学国家重点实验室，2022年11月科技部批准依托西南大学和中国农业科学院蜜蜂研究所重组建设本全国重点实验室。以蚕、蜂为主要研究对象，拓展研究其他资源昆虫，重点建设资源昆虫生长发育与繁殖调控、系统生态与病害防控、高效养殖与高值利用三个方向。蚕学研究处于世界领先地位，蜜蜂研究快速迈入国际第一方阵。建有国家蚕遗传资源基因库（重庆）、国家蜜蜂基因库（北京）。拥有以工程院院士和一批国家级领军及青年人才等为带头人的固定人员200余人。重组以来取得了家蚕超级泛基因组图谱、蜂王发育的王台调控机制、蚕丝蛋白高效止血剂、性别标记新品种等一批国际领先成果，在Nature正刊及CNS子刊发表一批重要论文，引领国家蚕桑、蜂产业技术体系建设。
10891.companyProfileEn: The State Key Laboratory of Resource Insects, formerly known as the State Key Laboratory of Silkworm Genome Biology, was approved by the Ministry of Science and Technology in November 2022 for re-establishment as a joint entity hosted by Southwest University and the Institute of Apicultural Research, Chinese Academy of Agricultural Sciences. Primarily working with silkworms and honeybees while extending research to other resource insects, the laboratory prioritizes three core research areas: growth, development and reproduction regulation of resource insects; systematic ecology and disease prevention & control; and efficient rearing and high-value utilization. Silkworm research here is globally preeminent, and honeybee research has rapidly joined the top tier internationally. The laboratory has established the National Silkworm Genetic Resources Gene Bank (Chongqing) and the National Honeybee Gene Bank (Beijing). It comprises a permanent team of over 200 researchers, led by the academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering and a cohort of national-level leading scientists and young talents. Since reorganization, the laboratory has achieved a series of internationally leading breakthroughs, including the super pan-genome map of silkworm, the queen-cell-mediated regulatory mechanism of queen bee development, silk fibroin-based high-efficiency hemostatic agents, and novel sex-marked silkworm varieties. The Laboratory has undertaken 91 research projects funded through government science and technology programs and implemented 70 internally funded research projects. The Laboratory has organized two major releases of scientific and technological achievements, covering a total of 13 research outcomes. 金迈捷航天级低温系列包括低温液位、低温压力和低温振动传感器，三类产品均已在火箭上完成配套验证。其中，液位传感器已在约 −253 ℃ 的液氢环境下完成飞行试验验证，低温压力和低温振动传感器均可耐受 −196 ℃ 低温。低温液位系列覆盖连续液位测量、点式液位检测和耗尽关机检测，可分别用于监测液位变化、判断液体是否到达指定位置，以及在推进剂耗尽时提供关机信号。
面向液氢储存、运输、加注及低温试验台架，金迈捷可围绕储罐液位监测、低温管路压力测量、设备振动测试及试验过程多参数采集等需求，提供传感器选型与测控系统方案。公司可结合介质特性、温度范围、测点布置、安装空间和信号接口，开展单机配套及多测点集成，支持客户从样机研制、试验验证到批量配套的不同阶段。
除低温系列外，公司产品还覆盖温度、冲击、位移、热流等物理量，可配合客户开展装备研发试验与运行监测。根据具体产品和工况，智能变换器可提供在线自诊断、量程切换和输出线性化等功能。针对安装空间受限或需要同步采集多个参数的测点，公司也可提供温度与压力等多物理量的集成测量方案。
11753.companyProfileEn:
Gmagii is recognized in China as a national-level specialized and innovative "Little Giant" enterprise. It develops, manufactures and supplies high-precision, high-reliability sensors and intelligent measurement and control systems. Serving aerospace and high-end industrial equipment manufacturers, the company offers standalone sensors, smart signal conditioners and multi-parameter measurement and control systems. Its capabilities span sensing element design, signal conditioning, instrument development and system integration.

Gmagii's aerospace-grade cryogenic range includes liquid-level, pressure and vibration sensors. All three types have been integrated and validated on rockets. Its liquid-level sensor has completed flight testing in liquid hydrogen at approximately −253 °C. Both its cryogenic pressure and vibration sensors can withstand temperatures as low as −196 °C. The liquid-level range covers continuous measurement, point-level detection and depletion detection for engine cutoff. These products monitor changes in liquid level, detect whether liquid has reached a specified point and provide a cutoff signal when propellant is depleted, respectively.

For liquid hydrogen storage, transport and refueling, as well as cryogenic test rigs, Gmagii offers sensor selection and measurement and control system design. Applications include tank level monitoring, pressure measurement in cryogenic piping, equipment vibration testing and multi-parameter data acquisition during tests. The company supplies standalone sensors and integrates measurements at multiple points based on fluid properties, temperature range, measurement locations, available mounting space and signal interfaces. It supports customers through prototype development, testing and validation, and volume supply.

Beyond its cryogenic range, Gmagii offers sensors for temperature, shock, displacement and heat flux, among other parameters, to support equipment development, testing and operational monitoring. Depending on the product and operating conditions, its smart signal conditioners can provide online self-diagnostics, range switching and output linearization. For measurement points with limited mounting space or a need for simultaneous data collection, the company also offers integrated measurement of multiple parameters, such as temperature and pressure.

VOYAH is a premium intelligent new energy brand under Dongfeng Motor Corporation. Through sculptural characteristics of sharpness, smoothness and elegance in styling, together with cabin spaces inspired by the Confucian ideals of “Upright Mind, Self-Cultivation and Family Harmony”, its vehicles carry the wisdom of Chinese culture and echo the belief that what belongs to the nation belongs to the world.

VOYAH shoulders two pivotal missions: to explore new development models for Chinese independent automotive brands and to elevate the brand positioning of Dongfeng Motor Group. It serves as a pioneer for Dongfeng’s “Oriental Wind Rises” initiative and “Technology Leap” strategy. In March 2026, VOYAH was officially listed on the Main Board of The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited under stock code 07489.HK, opening a new chapter for globalised open collaboration among central and state-owned automotive enterprises. 10823.companyProfileEn:
Wenchang International Space City is located in Wenchang City, Hainan Province, situated in the northeastern part of Hainan Island, with the east, south, and north surrounded by the sea. As a key park of the Hainan Free Trade Port, it serves as a strategic base for China’s aerospace power and a pilot area for the commercial aerospace industry, playing a significant role in ensuring major national space missions and advancing the construction of the Belt and Road Initiative.

Wenchang International Space City is China’s first coastal space city with a commercial orientation. It possesses one of the few low-latitude launch sites in the world and is accelerating the formation of a commercial launch capability described as 'hundreds of rockets and thousands of stars.' The city focuses on strengthening and complementing key links in the chains of regular flights, satellite and rocket manufacturing, and satellite applications, aiming to establish an industrial closed loop of 'launch—recovery—reuse.' It carries the important mission of driving innovation and development in China’s commercial aerospace sector. Following the development strategy of 'leading production with the launch site and integrating industry with the city,' it has established industrial systems including the rocket chain, satellite chain, data chain, and aerospace tourism. Efforts are being made to rapidly transform the resource advantages of the launch site into competitive advantages for the high-quality development of the commercial aerospace industry, creating a demonstration zone for commercial aerospace, a model area for the new aerospace economy, and an internationally leading commercial spaceport.

目前，公司在广东省惠州市惠阳区新材料产业园办公大楼拥有1300平方米的固态电池材料实验线，具备每月生产吨级固态电解质的生产能力和相关资质。公司打造了以学术人才和技术专家优势互补的研发创新模式，在公司内部构建了一支集调研、研发、转化、应用和中试能力为一体的技术力量。目前公司与母校清华大学签订了技术支持协议，并与本地高校惠州学院签订了研发工程师培养计划，将公司打造为科研工程结合的重要基地和载体，同时也是相关高校重要的实训基地。

It addresses the industry's core pain points — severe homogenization in materials R&D and disconnection from cell-level applications — by building an integrated capability spanning "demand analysis — materials R&D — cell validation." Through technology integration, it does the simplification for customers and lowers their R&D costs.

The company's core strength lies in a R&D team that is genuinely cross-disciplinary across materials and cells and has deep industry experience on both ends. Its core members all come from Professor He Yanbing's research group at Tsinghua University and from leading battery and materials companies; they have both solid-state battery materials R&D and industrialization experience and cell design, fabrication and validation experience. Unlike single-material companies or large cell manufacturers, the company can define materials in reverse from cell application requirements and complete both material development and cell validation, forming a unique niche track and a differentiated competitive moat.

The company has completed a 1,300 m² R&D center with ton-scale sample delivery capacity per year, and its products have entered validation at customers such as CATL, BYD and Qingtao and have achieved sales.

公司核心产品红旗“天辇1号”采用复合翼构型，自成立仅用5个月便完成带保护首飞，创下国内eVTOL行业时效纪录。2026年3月，该机型获民航局科研类特许飞行许可，目前已进入脱保护飞行阶段。

2026年4月，旗翼科技完成4亿元天使轮融资，成功引入富奥股份、富维股份、大鹏引导基金及深投控基石基金等战略投资人，构建起“产业资本+地方国资+市场化基金+集团赋能”的多元资本格局，并于2026年9月荣膺“中国经济大会——年度（行业）最具投资价值企业”。

未来，公司将全速推动适航认证、核心技术迭代及全球化商业布局，致力于成为中国低空出行领域的标杆科技企业。
11694.companyProfileEn:
Qiyi Technology (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd., founded in July 2025, is the core strategic entity of China FAW in the low-altitude economy and is headquartered in Dapeng New District, Shenzhen. The company focuses on the R&D, manufacturing, and operation of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft.

Its core product, the Hongqi “Tiannian 1,” adopts a compound-wing configuration. Just five months after its establishment, the company completed a protected first flight, setting a time-efficiency record in China’s eVTOL industry. In March 2026, the aircraft obtained a research-category special flight permit from the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC) and has now entered the unprotected flight phase.

Qiyi Technology pursues a “1+N” collaborative development model, with Shenzhen Dapeng as its global headquarters and Xi’an and Changchun as sub-centers. Recently, together with Jilin University and China Aerospace Times Electronics Co., Ltd., it successfully obtained approval for a Key Laboratory of the Ministry of Transport. It also reached a strategic cooperation with the Changchun Jingyue High-tech Industrial Development Zone and secured an intended purchase order for 100 aircraft. The company is accelerating the leap of low-altitude three-dimensional transportation from R&D validation to a commercial closed loop.

In April 2026, Qiyi Technology completed a RMB 400 million angel round of financing, introducing strategic investors including FAWER Automotive Parts Limited Company, Changchun Faway Automobile Components Co., Ltd., the Dapeng Guidance Fund, and the Shenzhen Investment Holdings Cornerstone Fund. This has established a diversified capital structure of “industrial capital + local state-owned capital + market-oriented funds + group empowerment.” In September 2026, the company was honored as the “Annual (Industry) Most Investment-Worthy Enterprise” at the China Economic Conference.

In the future, the company will fully accelerate airworthiness certification, core technology iteration, and global commercial deployment, striving to become a benchmark technology enterprise in China’s low-altitude mobility sector.

Since 2019, it has expanded its business nationwide and established its headquarters in Shenzhen, where Shenzhen Knowcell Cell Biotechnology Co., Ltd. was incorporated (brand name: Knowcell). Focused on the cell sector of the biomedical industry, Knowcell delivers professional technical services covering cell collection, biobanking and clinical translation. It is a national high-tech enterprise and an SRDI (Specialized, Refined, Differential and Innovative) company integrating R&D, production and sales.
Knowcell has built and put into operation its Shenzhen R&D and Innovation Laboratory, Shenzhen Cell Manufacturing Base and Qingdao Cell Manufacturing Base. In 2023, the Shenzhen Cell Manufacturing Center was approved for construction by the relevant Shenzhen authorities. Built and operated in compliance with cGMP Grade B+A cleanroom standards, the center is equipped with state-of-the-art life science instruments. Following the specifications and process requirements set forth in the Chinese Pharmacopoeia, it carries out cell isolation and preparation, quality testing, programmed cooling, thawing and culture, among other operations.
At present, Knowcell has established an integrated industrial layout encompassing “cell biobanking, R&D and clinical translation”. Committed to integrating its cell resource bank, innovative research and clinical translation capabilities, the company strives to facilitate the large-scale and standardized development of the cell industry, and to grow into a core supplier underpinning the industrialization of the cell therapy in China.

11463.companyProfile:
元酉生物聚焦天然活性物的生物制造，利用先进合成生物技术，结合传统发酵工艺，研发并生产圆柚酮、红没药醇等高价值天然活性化合物。项目以微生物细胞工厂替代传统植物提取与化学合成，具有绿色低碳、可规模化、质量稳定、成本可控等先进性。

针对天然活性物长期存在的来源不稳定、受季节产地限制、价格偏高、品质波动大等难题，项目通过发酵法实现稳定供应和标准化生产，显著降低下游原料成本。产品广泛用于香精香料及功能护肤品原料，已服务香精香料、化妆品等领域客户，实现商业化应用。

产值效益方面，项目产品附加值高、市场空间大，已形成批量供货和商业化落地能力；随着天然、安全、可持续原料需求增长，具备良好的规模化放产和持续增长潜力，可带动上下游产业链降本增效，创造显著经济、社会与生态效益。
11463.companyProfileEn:
Terpiot Biotechnology produces high-value natural active ingredients—including Nootkatone and Bisabolol—by combining advanced synthetic biology with precision fermentation. Instead of relying on traditional plant extraction or chemical synthesis, we use engineered microbial cell factories to deliver greener, scalable, and cost-effective ingredient solutions.

Traditional botanical sourcing often suffers from seasonal shortages, geographic limits, inconsistent purity, and volatile pricing. Terpiot’s standardized fermentation process eliminates these supply chain risks, providing brands and manufacturers with reliable, high-purity ingredients at a significantly lower cost.

Today, our ingredients are commercially scaled and widely applied as Food Additives (Food & Beverage), Flavors & Fragrances (F&F), and Functional Skincare actives. With proven bulk supply capabilities across both food-grade and cosmetic-grade applications, Terpiot Biotechnology helps global partners cut formulation costs, secure a resilient supply chain, and meet the growing demand for clean, sustainable products.

深圳市宝安中医院（集团）由始建于1988年的宝安区中医院发展而来，位于粤港澳大湾区，是集医疗、科研、教学、预防、保健、康复于一体的公立三级甲等中医医院，建立“总院—分院—社康中心”三级诊疗体系。集团总院为广东省中医名院、广州中医药大学非直属附属医院及第七临床医学院。医院开放床位1050张，设有47个临床科室，拥有国家临床重点专科1个、国家中医优势专科建设单位3个、省级中医重点专科12个。最近，医院两个专科分别获评“十五五”期间深圳市首批重点疾病医疗中心及临床重点专科。
医院立足中医药临床需求，推动医药与工程技术、人工智能、先进制造融合。依托宝安区医学创新与转化中心、国家医学攻关产教融合创新平台宝安分中心、中医药关键技术概念验证中心，建有1500平方米中心实验室、省级双工程中心、全国首个院内医疗器械可用性测试平台及深圳市首个中医院研究型病房，并设有国家级博士后科研工作站，为技术研发与临床验证提供支撑。2023年以来获批各级科研项目380项，历年累计获国家自然科学基金25项。
医院建立专职创新转化部门，衔接项目筛选、工程研发、概念验证、器械测试、临床研究和质量控制，初步形成全链条转化服务体系。医院获批立项医工融合项目29项，建成9个院企合作基地，成果转化服务体系入库项目100余项。

11504.companyProfileEn:
Shenzhen Bao'an Traditional Chinese Medicine Hospital (Group) grew out of the Bao'an District Hospital of TCM founded in 1988. Located in the Guangdong–Hong Kong–Macao Greater Bay Area, it is a public Grade-A tertiary TCM hospital integrating medical care, research, education, prevention, healthcare, and rehabilitation, with a three-tier system of main hospital, branch hospitals, and community health centers.

The main hospital is a renowned Guangdong Provincial TCM hospital, a non-directly affiliated hospital of Guangzhou University of Chinese Medicine and its Seventh Clinical Medical College. Since 2023, it has won 380 research projects, with 25 cumulative NSFC grants.

A dedicated innovation and translation department links project screening, engineering R&D, concept validation, device testing, clinical research, and quality control, forming a full-chain translation service system. 11693.companyProfile:
广州尚医网信息技术有限公司由留美科学家归国创办，是一家专注于人工智能（AI）、云计算与智慧医疗技术研发及应用的国家高新技术企业，致力于以科技创新推动医疗服务智能化、标准化与普惠化。

公司核心团队汇聚清华大学及海外人工智能博士、国际科技企业资深专家，拥有世界500强企业研发及管理经验，曾获“创业领军团队”等荣誉。公司坚持自主创新，核心AI算法拥有国家发明专利及软件著作权，突破传统算力限制，实现普通CPU上的高效AI推理。英特尔（Intel）专门发布《小济医生技术白皮书》，公司入选英伟达（NVIDIA）创新计划，并成为亚马逊云科技、英特尔等国际科技企业的灯塔项目。

公司自主研发的“小济医生——人工智能超声乳腺癌早筛机器人”，搭载超声视觉大模型（LVM4U），融合实时超声影像分析、智能病灶识别及辅助诊断技术，为大规模乳腺癌筛查提供高效、标准化的AI解决方案。产品已在江苏连云港、山东东营等多地开展真实世界规模化应用，累计服务近50万人次，并与国家癌症中心（中国医学科学院肿瘤医院）等权威医疗机构开展临床研究与验证。

“小济医生”曾获国家卫健委医学人工智能相关奖项，入选广州市优秀人工智能应用场景案例，相关应用获得全国爱卫办认可，并受到新华社、人民日报、光明日报等中央媒体报道。

依托自主超声AI大模型，公司正拓展AI颈动脉斑块、甲状腺结节、肝癌及卵泡检测等智能筛查应用，同时布局AI原生云医院平台、AI医疗规范质控等产品，构建覆盖疾病早筛、临床诊疗及医院管理的智慧医疗体系。

目前，公司正积极拓展日本、美国、越南及中国香港等国际市场，致力于成为具有全球竞争力的医疗人工智能创新企业，为全球医疗健康事业贡献中国智慧与中国方案。
11693.companyProfileEn:
iCare365 Technologies, Inc. is a high-tech medical AI company specializing in artificial intelligence, cloud computing, big data, and intelligent healthcare. The company develops proprietary AI technologies and solutions to improve healthcare accessibility, efficiency, standardization, and clinical quality.

Its flagship innovation, Dr. J – AI-Powered Breast Cancer Ultrasound Screening Robot, enables intelligent, standardized, and large-scale breast cancer screening. Powered by the company's proprietary Large Vision Model for Ultrasound (LVM4U), trained on over 34 million ultrasound frames, Dr. J integrates real-time ultrasound video analysis, intelligent lesion detection, and AI-assisted diagnostic assessment.

In a real-world head-to-head clinical evaluation involving 6,213 individuals, conducted in collaboration with the National Cancer Center / Cancer Hospital, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences and Peking Union Medical College, Dr. J achieved an AUC of 0.949, compared with 0.819 for experienced ultrasound physicians with over 10 years of clinical experience.

iCare365's innovations have received recognition from China's National Health Commission and the National Patriotic Health Campaign Committee. The company has been recognized among Guangzhou's Top 100 AI Companies and featured in a dedicated technical white paper published by Intel. It is also an AWS Lighthouse Project and a NVIDIA Premier Member.

With established real-world deployments and expanding international activities in Japan, the United States, Vietnam, Hong Kong, and other markets, iCare365 is committed to building globally scalable medical AI solutions and making advanced healthcare technologies more accessible worldwide.

中国电子技术标准化研究院（简称“电子标准院”），工业和信息化部直属事业单位，专业从事工业和电子信息技术领域标准化科研工作。自1963年建院以来，电子标准院已从初期的单一标准制定，发展成集标准研制、试验检测、计量校准、认证评估、培训服务和产业研究为一体的基础性、公益性、综合性科研机构。
电子标准院以标准化工作为核心，通过开展标准科研、检测、计量、认证、信息服务等业务，面向政府提供政策研究、行业管理和战略决策的专业支撑，面向社会提供标准化技术服务；积极研究工业领域标准化发展战略，提出相关规划和政策建议；组织建立和完善电子信息技术领域标准体系，开展共性、基础性标准的研究制定和推广应用工作；承担电子产品的试验检测、质量控制和技术评价、质量监督检测和质量争议鉴定等相关工作；负责电子工业最高计量标准的建立、维护和量值传递工作；开展管理体系认证、产品认证等相关活动；建立和维护工业领域标准信息资源网络，开展信息咨询、技术咨询和培训活动。
9682.companyProfileEn: China Electronics Standardization Institute (CESI) is a public institution directly under the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology. It specializes in standardization research in the fields of industry and electronic information technology. Founded in 1963, the Institute has evolved from its early standard making body into a fundamental, public-welfare and comprehensive research institution integrating standard development, testing and inspection, metrology and calibration, certification and evaluation, training services and industrial research.

11464.companyProfile:
香港理工大学大亚湾技术创新研究院（下称“研究院”）由香港理工大学、惠州市人民政府、大亚湾开发区于2024年5月签约共建，9月正式揭牌运营。研究院依托港理大顶尖科研实力，拥有7500平方米科研场地，聚焦新材料与新能源、绿色化学与可持续催化、绿色与智能制造、空间计算与影像、人工智能五大领域，下设五个专业研究中心，现建有5个物理及化学实验室，可开展材料及技术领域"实验室+小试"阶段的各项研究工作。
结合惠州石化、电子信息、新材料等产业发展需求，研究院积极推动科研成果在大亚湾、惠州落地孵化并实现产业化，构建"技术研发—成果转化—产业应用"全链条创新生态，致力于成为连接香港源头创新与内地产业应用的"技术转化加速器"。研究院为企业提供从委托开发、联合攻关、技术指导、技术研发、测试分析等服务，并开展深度产学研合作，培养卓越工程师和高素质技术应用型创新创业人才。
11464.companyProfileEn:
The Hong Kong Polytechnic University Daya Bay Technology Innovation Research Institute (hereinafter referred to as the “Research Institute”) was jointly established by The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, the Huizhou Municipal People’s Government and Daya Bay Development Zone under an agreement signed in May 2024, and officially inaugurated and put into operation in September the same year.
Leveraging the world-class research strengths of The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, the Research Institute occupies a 7,500-square-metre research space. It focuses on five key areas: new materials and new energy, green chemistry and sustainable catalysis, green and intelligent manufacturing, spatial computing and imaging, and artificial intelligence. It has five specialised research centres and five physical and chemical laboratories, supporting a full range of research activities at the laboratory and bench-scale trial stages for materials and related technologies.
Responding to the industrial development needs of Huizhou’s petrochemical, electronic information and new materials sectors, the Research Institute actively promotes the incubation and industrialisation of research outcomes in Daya Bay and Huizhou. It builds a full-chain innovation ecosystem covering “technology R&D – achievement transformation – industrial application”, and strives to serve as a technology translation accelerator linking Hong Kong’s original innovation and mainland industrial application.
The Research Institute provides enterprises with services including commissioned development, joint research, technical guidance, R&D and testing & analysis. It also carries out in-depth industry-university-research collaboration to cultivate outstanding engineers and high-calibre applied technical, innovative and entrepreneurial talents.

致真精密仪器有限公司是以高端科研仪器、集成电路产线测试设备研发与生产为主要业务的国家高新技术企业、国家专精特新小巨人企业。在中国集成电路制造行业迅速发展、芯片研发和制造环节各类设备亟需自主可控的背景下，致真精密仪器通过自主创新、产学研合作及成果转化、行业资源整合等手段对国内尚未实现自主研发能力的相关高端仪器设备展开工程攻关。
自2019年成立以来，公司已汇聚各类人才百余人，由国家级科技创业领军人才带队，打造了光、电、精密机械、测控及自动化、软件和算法等工种齐全的工程团队，通过建设青岛市集成电路测试设备专家工作站等方式，引进仪器领域高水平专家若干，在北京和杭州设有子公司和研发中心。
目前，公司面向广大科研、产业工作者和芯片产业对高性能高质量自主可控设备的需求，已经研发了一系列的高端设备，包括“原子力显微镜、高精度VSM、MOKE等磁学测量设备、各类磁场探针台、磁性芯片测试机等产线级设备、低温设备、集成电路装备实训解决方案”等，产品已经应用于清华大学、中国科学院等国内多家顶尖科研机构和知名集成电路制造公司。致真精密仪器拥有强大的自主创新实力、先进的生产装配能力和健全的品质控制体系，产品性能和品质对标国际一流，服务质量和安全可控性发挥本土企业优势，多次助力中国科研、产业工作者取得高水平成果。我们希望与更多优秀科研、产业工作者合作，持续提供专业的技术服务和解决方案!

11562.companyProfile: 安琪酵母股份有限公司始创于1986年，主导产品酵母、酵母抽提物、食品原料等广泛应用于烘焙与发酵面食、食品调味、酿造及生物能源、人类营养健康、动物、植物、微生物营养等领域。公司在国内11个城市以及埃及、俄罗斯、印度尼西亚建有工厂，发酵产能50万吨，在国内市场占比55%，全球占比超20%。公司建有国家级企业技术中心、博士后科研工作站，检测中心通过CNAS实验室认可，获得授权发明专利500余项。主导和参与制定了酵母行业所有的国家和行业标准，两次获得国家科技进步奖。近年来，先后被工信部评为“国家技术创新示范企业”，被国务院国资委评为“国有重点企业管理标杆创建行动标杆企业”，被人社部表彰为宜昌首个“全国和谐劳动关系创建示范企业”，被农业农村部认定为“农业国际贸易高质量发展基地”，获评湖北最佳上市公司，荣获第三届湖北改革奖。
11562.companyProfileEn:
Founded in 1986, Angel Yeast Co., Ltd. specializes in yeast, yeast extracts, food ingredients and other leading products, which are widely used in baking and fermented flour products, food seasoning, brewing and bioenergy, human nutrition and health, as well as animal, plant and microbial nutrition sectors. The company operates manufacturing facilities in 11 cities across China, alongside production bases in Egypt, Russia and Indonesia, with a total fermentation capacity of 500,000 tonnes. 11575.companyProfile:
新疆桐昕石墨烯科技有限公司成立于2021年5月8日，由深圳市前海桐昕科技有限公司投资，注册资本3000万元，是一家专业从事石墨烯产品的研发、生产、销售为一体的新材料应用科技型企业。2023年引进国际领先的石墨烯高温微晶玻璃生产线，同年获评国家级高新技术企业。
桐昕公司是国内最早使用CVD法石墨烯粉体的企业，主要开发应用于工业烘干/固化、电池涂布烘干、真空镀、真空加热焊接、电供暖、以及各类特种加热场景。石墨烯远红外发热板发射的远红外线与溶剂分子产生共振，突破传统导热的限制，实现物料内部与表面同步快速、均匀的干燥的过程，从微观层面重塑了加热机制。以通电即热、极致节能，效率倍增、品质跃升，安全可靠、使用寿命长、安装简便等优势广受市场欢迎！桐昕公司的石墨烯远红外烘干技术以其卓越性能，在降本增效、推动产业升级方面具有巨大商业价值与不可逆转的发展趋势。
11575.companyProfileEn:
Xinjiang Tongxin Graphene Technology Co., Ltd. was founded on May 8, 2021 and invested by Shenzhen Qianhai Tongxin Technology Co., Ltd. With a registered capital of RMB 30 million, it is a high-tech enterprise specializing in the R&D, production and sales of graphene products.

In 2023, the company introduced the world-leading production line for graphene high-temperature microcrystalline glass, and was awarded the National High-Tech Enterprise title in the same year.

As one of China’s earliest enterprises adopting CVD graphene powder, Tongxin mainly develops products for industrial drying & curing, battery coating drying, vacuum plating, vacuum heating welding, electric heating, and various special heating scenarios.

The far-infrared rays emitted by Tongxin graphene far-infrared heating plates resonate with solvent molecules, breaking the limitations of traditional heat conduction and realizing simultaneous, fast and uniform drying of both the interior and surface of materials. It reinvents the heating mechanism at the microscopic level.

Featured by instant heating upon power-on, extreme energy saving, greatly boosted efficiency, improved product quality, high reliability, long service life and easy installation, our products are widely recognized by the market.

With outstanding performance, Tongxin’s graphene far-infrared drying technology delivers great commercial value and represents an irreversible development trend in cutting costs, raising efficiency and driving industrial upgrading.

11582.companyProfile:
新疆慧玲农业科技有限公司成立于2019年6月，注册资金500万元，坐落于麦盖提县央塔克乡团结大队，是一家专注林果深加工与大健康产品研发、生产、销售的现代化本土企业。

公司自有2000余亩种植基地，包含1500亩优质红枣种植园，配套种植蒲公英、马齿苋等多种药食同源经济作物。企业配备3000平方米标准化现代化厂房、1500吨专业冷链仓储，搭载全自动红枣加工、红枣酒、红枣醋一体化生产线，年产能力稳定，年红枣加工量可达8000吨，红枣醋、红枣酒综合产能2500吨，同时承接红枣代加工业务，产能扎实、供货稳定。

企业深耕林果深加工多年，自2013年启动产业转型，主打红枣原汁深度发酵系列产品。产品经权威检测营养丰富，含15种人体所需氨基酸，维生素、膳食纤维含量优于行业同类产品，口感纯正、枣香浓郁，凭借天然健康的品质，深受一线城市高品质消费群体认可。

公司坚持产学研合作，联合高校科研机构持续迭代产品，2019年申报7项发明专利，全系产品拥有自主知识产权。企业坚守社会责任，优先吸纳本地乡民就业，现有常驻员工65人，用工峰值可达100人，半数员工为当地维吾尔族脱贫户，成立至今已带动当地40余户农户增收脱贫，助力乡村振兴与地方产业发展。

公司始终秉持“天然、健康、纯粹”的经营理念，立足新疆优质林果资源，持续挖掘农产品附加值，深耕大健康产业，以优质产品、稳定产能与务实初心，稳步开拓全国健康农产品市场。
11582.companyProfileEn:
Xinjiang Huiling Agricultural Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in June 2019 with a registered capital of 5 million yuan. Located in Tuanjie Brigade, Yangtak Township, Makit County, it is a modern local enterprise focusing on the R&D, production and sales of deep-processed forest and fruit products and health products.

The company owns over 2,000 mu of planting bases, including 1,500 mu of high-quality jujube orchards, alongside a variety of medicinal and edible cash crops such as dandelion and purslane. It has a 3,000-square-meter standardized modern factory building and a 1,500-ton cold chain warehouse, equipped with fully automatic integrated production lines for jujube processing, jujube wine and jujube vinegar. Its annual jujube processing capacity reaches 8,000 tons, and the combined annual output of jujube vinegar and jujube wine is 2,500 tons. Jujube OEM processing services are also available with stable supply capacity.

Having engaged in deep processing of forest and fruit products for years, the company began industrial transformation in 2013 and features fermented products made from pure jujube juice. Authoritative tests show the products are rich in nutrients, containing 15 kinds of essential amino acids, with higher levels of vitamins and dietary fiber than many similar products. Boasting pure taste and rich jujube aroma, they are well received by high-end consumers in first-tier cities for their natural and healthy quality.

11691.companyProfileEn:
PENDU Technology — An Innovation Leader in AI and 3D Spatial Intelligence Infrastructure Services
PENDU Technology Group serves the emerging era of spatial intelligence through three core proprietary technologies: glasses-free 3D display technology, AI vision and spatial intelligence foundation models, and industrial semantics and decision intelligence. The Group focuses on two key sectors: culture and tourism and energy and industry.
The company’s technologies have received prestigious honors, including the Second Prize of China’s National Award for Technological Invention, the First Prize of the Beijing Science and Technology Progress Award, and the First Prize of the Ministry of Education’s Technological Invention Award.

Culture and Tourism
Powered by its core AI-driven 3D generation and conversion technologies, PENDU digitally reconstructs cultural artifacts, intangible cultural heritage, cultural environments and intellectual property (IP). This enables the consistent production of high-quality 3D digital content, transforming digital exhibitions into immersive 3D experiences designed for broad audience engagement and sustainable operation.

Energy and Industry
PENDU adds understanding, reasoning and decision-making capabilities powered by Physical AI to customers’ existing DCS, SCADA, CAD, CAE, BIM, PLM, MES, ERP, EAM and IoT systems.
By building industrial ontologies, PENDU translates equipment, processes, procedures and operating conditions into a semantic system that AI can reason over. Industry-specific world models and industrial AI agents then generate decision recommendations supported by traceable evidence, constraint validation and auditability. These recommendations feed directly into operational workflows, including work orders, maintenance, dispatch and inspection.

PENDU is more than a display hardware manufacturer, an AI model developer or a consultancy. It is an integrated service provider spanning hardware, algorithms, foundation models, data governance, content platforms, and the delivery and operation of real-world applications.

10241.companyProfileEn:

Beyond biometrics, ID4US develops innovative ultrasound imaging technologies through compact, flexible and easy-to-integrate modules. With a strong focus on innovation and integration, ID4US actively seeks OEM manufacturers, technology partners and system integrators to bring next-generation ultrasound solutions to market.

技术获国际PCT专利及国家发明专利，入选农业农村部“火花技术”成果库，荣获农牧渔业丰收奖、世界银行绿色农业技术创新奖等十余项权威荣誉。目前，产品已纳入湖南“一喷多促”省级方案，以及陕西省小麦秋播官方技术方案（陕植发〔2026〕55号，列为等离子物理制剂配套技术），依托中央财政项目进入县区政府采购。

作为深圳政府投资背书企业，公司拥有完整大田实证与多省推广基础，以物理科技稀缺性对接市属国企与政府平台，打造中国物理农业新质生产力标杆。

11245.companyProfile: 中车株洲电力机车有限公司创建于1936年，是中国中车旗下核心子公司、湖南千亿轨道交通产业集群链主企业。新中国成立以来始终保持快速健康发展，创造了中国轨道交通装备领域的诸多纪录。目前，公司资产总额约395亿元，在全球范围内设有36家全级次子公司，拥有近13000名员工，其中，株洲本部员工约7600名，国内子公司员工约4000名，海外员工约1000名。公司建立了全球行业型谱最全、品种最多的产品体系，形成了以机车、动车组、城市轨道交通和智慧矿山等四大主业为核心，以核心零部件、新兴领域等为支撑，协调发展的“4+X”产业格局，并加快由装备制造向全寿命周期系统解决方案延伸。公司始终坚持创新驱动发展，大力推动科技创新和产业创新深度融合，加快培育发展新质生产力，全力推进正向设计研发体系建设，加快搭建数智化、绿色化、模块化产品基础技术平台，牵头组建了行业唯一的国家级制造业创新中心，建成了国内行业独有的4个“国家级”创新平台——重载快捷大功率电力机车全国重点实验室、轨道交通车辆系统集成国家工程研究中心、轨道交通装备国家级工业设计中心、轨道交通装备系统集成和关键技术研发产业基地，设立了3家海外研发机构，掌握了系统集成、交流传动、重载运输、磁悬浮、车辆储能、故障预测与健康管理等多项前沿技术。目前，公司超过26%的员工从事研究与开发工作，包含1名中国工程院院士，1名中青年科技领军人才，15名享受国务院政府特殊津贴的行业专家，5600余名工程技术人员，其中227人拥有正高级职称。面向“十五五”，公司将坚持以推动高质量发展为主题，协调推进党的建设、产业升级、创新驱动、改革赋能、绿智转型、全球经营、集群发展“七大工程”，全面打造“七个标杆”，加快建设“新质株机”，全力打造交通装备领域的世界一流企业，奋力担当建设世界一流中车的先行者和排头兵，为推动全球轨道交通产业进步不懈努力。
11245.companyProfileEn:

It has formed a coordinated “4+X” industrial pattern centred on four core business lines: locomotives, EMUs, urban rail transit and smart mines, supported by core components and emerging business areas. It has also set up three overseas R&D institutions and mastered a host of cutting-edge technologies covering system integration, AC drive, heavy-haul transportation, maglev, on-board energy storage, as well as prognostic and health management.

公司核心掌握 915MHz/2.45GHz 双频 MPCVD 金刚石制备核心技术，实现大尺寸单晶、微晶、多晶金刚石稳定可控生长，产品主要分为两大方向：70% 产能聚焦半导体金刚石衬底、AI 算力芯片高导热散热 TIM 材料，面向高端算力服务器、功率半导体、光电器件等领域；30% 产能用于高品质培育钻石，打造自有品牌「璇穹钻艺」，覆盖珠宝文创、工业刀具等应用场景。公司已打通设备自研、气源配套、晶体生长、CMP 精密研磨、表面金属化、焊接封装全链条，具备独立的工艺迭代与量产交付能力。
基地汇聚上海交大、长春理工大学等高校院所材料、等离子物理、精密加工领域顶尖专家，组建产学研协同创新团队，持续迭代金刚石生长工艺，不断提升晶体质量、热导率与良率。现阶段基地已投产 MPCVD 设备，同步落地订单交付，中长期规划万台级 MPCVD 产线集群，联动国电投、南通四建等合作伙伴推进园区工程建设，构建集生产、研发、检测、文旅于一体的金刚石产业生态。

11610.companyProfileEn:
Carbon-Based Core Materials (Kashgar) New Materials Technology Co., Ltd. is located in Shache Industrial Park, Kashgar Economic Development Zone within the Kashgar Area of China (Xinjiang) Pilot Free Trade Zone. It is a high-tech enterprise focusing on the R&D, production, deep processing and application of diamond carbon-based new materials. Taking advantage of local low-cost wind and solar green power, we build a zero-carbon advanced material base and develop MPCVD diamond products to break bottlenecks for domestic high-end carbon materials.

Our proprietary 915MHz / 2.45GHz dual-frequency MPCVD technology enables stable growth of large-size single-crystal, microcrystalline and polycrystalline diamond. Seventy percent of our capacity is dedicated to diamond semiconductor substrates and high-thermal-conductivity TIM thermal materials for AI chips, high-power semiconductors and optoelectronic devices. The remaining 30% produces lab-grown diamonds under our brand **Xuanqiong Diamond Art** for jewelry, cultural creation and industrial cutting tools. We cover the whole chain: equipment R&D, gas supply, crystal growth, CMP polishing, surface metallization and packaging.

Our R&D team consists of top experts from Shanghai Jiao Tong University and Changchun University of Science and Technology. We have launched MPCVD production lines with order delivery in progress. In the long run, we plan to build a large-scale MPCVD production cluster, cooperating with SPIC and Nantong Sijian Construction to develop an integrated industrial ecosystem of production, R&D, testing and cultural tourism.

Supported by free-trade policies and green power, we deliver reliable, cost-effective products to global clients in computing, semiconductor and creative sectors. We aim to substitute imported carbon materials, expand production capacity and build a leading diamond material hub in Northwest China, supporting the independent, secure development of China’s semiconductor and AI computing supply chains.

伽师紫砂陶瓷有限责任公司简介

伽师紫砂陶瓷有限责任公司专注于伽师紫砂陶产业全产业链的开拓与发展，业务范围深度涵盖紫砂陶产业规划、产品研发、人才培育、技术咨询以及产品销售等多个关键领域。 伽师独特的地质环境孕育了高品质的紫砂矿。主要分布在享有中国地质运动自然博物馆的伽师七彩山区域。历经四亿年地质运动与沉淀，形成了伽师紫砂基色丰富多样、透气性极佳、发色柔和自然、极具原始生态质感等独特质。 伽师的制陶历史源远流长。远在汉唐时期，当地先民便已熟练掌握制陶技艺，它与如今的紫砂工艺一脉相承，为紫砂产业的发展奠定了深厚的历史文化底蕴。“纯原矿、零添加”的产品理念，让古老制陶技艺和现代紫砂壶作技艺在交流中碰撞、在融合中创新。 公司汇聚了强大的专业力量。拥有着由国家正高级工艺美术师袁国强、国家级工艺美术师张宝余、吴新军等行业领军人物带领的50 人紫砂陶产业研发团队，采取“校企联合”和“师带徒”模式，培育本土人才，为产业的持续发展提供了坚实的人才支撑。在大师们的引领下，团队不断创新，已成功研发300余个品类的紫砂产品，这些产品兼具实用性与艺术性，深受市场青睐，远销至粤港澳大湾区。 我们正借助伽师宜兴缔结友好县市、宜伽两地陶瓷专业院校联办、两地陶瓷行业协会互动、产学研基地建设、“疆品南下粤品北上” 产业援疆平台加持、“三位一体”紫砂陶产业扶持机制，全方位构建伽师紫砂陶全产业链体系。
11558.companyProfileEn:
Jiashi Zisha Ceramics Co., Ltd. is dedicated to developing the full industrial chain of Jiashi Zisha pottery. Its business covers industrial planning, product R&D, talent training, technical consultation and product sales of Zisha pottery.

The unique geological conditions of Jiashi produce high-quality Zisha ore, which is mainly found in the Qicai Mountain area of Jiashi, known as a natural museum of geological movements in China. Formed through 400 million years of geological evolution and sedimentation, Jiashi Zisha features rich base colors, excellent air permeability, soft and natural firing colors, and distinctive primitive ecological texture.

Jiashi boasts a long history of pottery making. Back in the Han and Tang dynasties, local ancestors mastered pottery-making techniques, which are in the same line as modern Zisha craftsmanship and lay a profound cultural foundation for the Zisha industry. Adhering to the product philosophy of "pure raw ore with zero additives", we integrate ancient pottery-making techniques with modern Zisha pot-making skills for innovation.

The company has a strong professional team. Led by leading masters including Yuan Guoqiang (National Senior Arts and Crafts Master), Zhang Baoyu and Wu Xinjun (National Arts and Crafts Masters), our 50-member R&D team adopts school-enterprise cooperation and master-apprentice training models to cultivate local talents and underpin the sustainable development of the industry. Guided by these masters, the team has developed over 300 types of Zisha products that combine practicality and artistry. Well-received by the market, our products are sold far to the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area.

Supported by the sister-city partnership between Jiashi and Yixing, joint programs between ceramic colleges of the two places, exchanges between ceramic industry associations, construction of industry-university-research bases, the industrial aid platform of "Xinjiang goods going south and Guangdong goods going north", and the "three-in-one" support mechanism for the Zisha pottery industry, we are building a complete industrial chain system for Jiashi Zisha pottery in an all-round way.

It has been certified as a National High-Tech Enterprise and recognized as a Specialized, Refined, Differential and Innovative Enterprise.

Supported by high-quality products and prompt, comprehensive after-sales services, we have earned trust from customers worldwide. Our sales network covers all regions across China, with exports to Southeast Asia, Europe, South America and other regions.
Our thermally and electrically conductive silver adhesive films provide PCB thermal bonding solutions for Shennan Circuits, Shengyi Technology and other clients in the 5G communication sector. Our underfill adhesives deliver reliability solutions for mobile terminals including laptops, tablets and smartphones for Lenovo and other brands. Thermally conductive potting sealants and thermal interface materials offer sealing, waterproofing and heat transfer solutions for robotic joint motors, auto components, batteries and related products. Epoxy thermal conductive adhesives provide thermal conduction and structural bonding solutions for liquid cooling systems. Conformal coatings protect PCBA assemblies against water, dust, mold and extreme temperatures for a wide range of electronic products.

深圳市学暇教育科技有限公司是一家以人工智能教育产品研发与应用为核心方向的初创科技企业，致力于探索人工智能与教育教学的深度融合。公司以“让优质学习支持更易获得，让每一位学习者拥有适合自己的学习方式”为愿景，围绕不同学段的学习需求，打造兼具知识辅助、学习引导与互动陪伴价值的智能教育产品，推动技术真正服务于学生的理解、思考与成长。
公司核心产品为BICON必可AI教育平台，以AI老师为主要产品形态，从初中学习场景切入，并面向高中及高校教育拓展。
在产品理念上，BICON必可AI教育平台强调以学习者为中心，关注从“获得答案”到“理解知识”、再到“自主解决问题”的完整学习过程。平台以启发式交流和循序渐进的引导为设计方向，希望帮助学生梳理问题、建立知识联系、形成解题思路，并在持续的学习过程中逐步提升自主学习能力与思辨能力。
面向初中阶段，公司重点关注基础知识理解、学习兴趣培养与学习习惯养成；面向高中阶段，关注知识体系构建、复杂问题分析与学习效率提升；面向高校阶段，则探索专业知识学习、自主探究与跨学科理解等应用方向。公司希望通过持续的产品迭代，使AI老师更好地适应不同学段的学习节奏与实际需求。
公司初创团队成员均为香港中文大学（深圳）学生。作为教育的亲历者与智能技术的探索者，团队从自身学习体验和真实教育问题出发，重视学生在学习过程中遇到的困惑与障碍，努力将青年团队的创新意识、学习热情与产品实践相结合，探索更贴近学习者的教育服务方式。
公司坚持以真实需求为导向，重视产品体验、内容质量与用户反馈，并将教育场景中的可靠性、适龄性和隐私保护作为产品建设的重要考量。在发展过程中，公司希望与教师、学校及教育领域合作伙伴开展交流，共同探索AI辅助教学与学习支持的有效路径。
11701.companyProfileEn:
Shenzhen Xuexia Education Technology Co., Ltd. is an early-stage technology company focused on the development and application of AI-powered educational products. The company explores how artificial intelligence can be meaningfully integrated into teaching and learning. Guided by the vision of making quality learning support more accessible and helping every learner find an approach that suits them, it develops intelligent educational products that support knowledge acquisition, guided learning, and interactive engagement. Its goal is to ensure that technology contributes to students’ understanding, thinking, and growth.
The company’s flagship product, the BICON AI Education Platform, centers on an AI teacher experience. Starting with junior secondary education, the platform is also being developed for senior secondary and university learning contexts.
BICON follows a learner-centered product philosophy that addresses the full learning process: from finding an answer to understanding the underlying concepts and ultimately solving problems independently. With an emphasis on thought-provoking dialogue and step-by-step guidance, the platform is designed to help students clarify problems, connect concepts, and develop approaches to solving them. Through this process, it seeks to strengthen independent learning and critical thinking.
For junior secondary learners, the company focuses on foundational understanding, interest in learning, and productive study habits. For senior secondary learners, it emphasizes structured knowledge, complex problem analysis, and learning efficiency. At the university level, it explores applications in subject-specific learning, independent inquiry, and interdisciplinary understanding. Through ongoing product development, the company aims to make its AI teacher increasingly responsive to the pace and practical needs of learners at each stage.
All members of the founding team are students at The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen. Drawing on their firsthand experience as learners and their interest in intelligent technologies, the team starts with real educational challenges and the difficulties students encounter in their studies. By combining fresh perspectives, enthusiasm for learning, and hands-on product development, the team seeks to create educational services that better reflect learners’ needs.
The company prioritizes real user needs, product experience, content quality, and user feedback. Reliability, age appropriateness, and privacy are important considerations i

Finance—connecting JD Finance, Zhongyuan Bank and others for receivable/payable financing, warehouse receipt pledge, procurement credit and data-enabled credit enhancement. Logistics—working with JD Logistics, SF Express and others to plan modern cloud warehouses from ambient to cold chain. 目前，天和双力的设备与系统已遍布全球五大洲，客户行业覆盖快递速运、电商与跨境电商、商超零售、生鲜冷链、医药、汽车及零部件、食品饮料、机场铁路、港口海关、电力电子、化纤纺织、建材家居、酒类、烟草等40+行业。
公司以不来梅为基地配置欧洲本地团队，为客户提供 7×24 小时响应。TWSL Technology Europe GmbH以中国的制造基础、欧洲的技术与管理、本地的服务响应，致力于成为欧洲客户在物流自动化领域可以长期依赖的合作伙伴。
11499.companyProfileEn:
TWSL Technology Europe GmbH was established in Bremen, Germany in April 2026 as the European headquarters of Tianwo Shuangli. Drawing on the group's supply chain and manufacturing capabilities in China and integrating European technology resources and management expertise, the company is rooted in the European market and provides logistics automation equipment and system services to customers in intelligent manufacturing and smart logistics worldwide.
The company's equipment development and supply chain system are built on more than 30 years of accumulated experience within the group. Founded in 1993, Tianwo Shuangli has focused on the field of logistics automation and has established its own Design & Research Institute and manufacturing base, forming a complete chain that spans consulting and planning, R&D and designing, software management, electrical control, equipment manufacturing, system integration, installation and commissioning, customer training, and after-sales support. Its core product lines cover seven major series, including intelligent storage systems, sorting systems, conveying systems, loading and unloading systems, robot applications, special-purpose equipment, and industrial software, with more than 4,500 projects delivered worldwide. This in-house manufacturing system keeps product range, cost and lead times under control.
Today, Tianwo Shuangli's products have spread all over the five continents, with customers covering more than 40 industries, such as automobiles and parts, e-commerce and cross-border e-commerce, retail, fresh cold chain, pharmaceuticals, food and beverage, airport and railway, port and customs, electric power and electronics, chemical fiber textiles, building materials and home furnishing, alcohol, and tobacco.
The company maintains a local European team based in Bremen and provides customers with 24/7 response. With a Chinese manufacturing base, European technology and management, and local service response, TWSL Technology Europe is committed to becoming a logistics automation partner that European customers can rely on in the long term.

Jiaxing Jiachang Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, production, sales, and solution services for drone communication, navigation, and sensing electronic components. The company specializes in communication, navigation, and sensing electronic components for drone systems, primarily including antennas, satellite navigation receivers, data link antennas, millimeter-wave radars, and their integrations. Utilizing core technologies independently developed by the team, it applies ultra-light, high-strength, low-loss, and high-temperature composite materials. Through dielectric modification and multi-layer reconfigurable composites, it replaces ceramics and aluminum with plastics. While maintaining low loss, it achieves adjustable dielectric constant, meeting the application requirements for lightweight conformal miniaturization, high-temperature and high-overload performance, and a unified design integrating conduction, sensing, and aperture integration.

The company's R&D team brings together senior experts and core industry professionals in fields such as electromagnetic field radio frequency, intelligent control, AI algorithms, and receiver technology. Core members of the team have spent many years leading major special projects for the BeiDou satellite system and have chaired or participated in the development of numerous national standards for satellite navigation.

It possesses the capability to independently construct simulation models in mechanics, electromagnetism, and thermodynamics, and to perform multi-physical coupling simulations. It is equipped with a multi-probe microwave anechoic chamber and has the ability to develop RF materials, communication, navigation, and integrated sensing products. It also supports system-level RF link simulation, RF planning, and optimization for entire systems and air-ground-space-sea systems.
