The GBA National Institute for Nanotechnology Innovation (CANNANO) is a public institution registered at the provincial level. It was established on September 10, 2019, under the auspices of the Administrative Committee of the Guangzhou High-tech Industrial Development Zone.
Positioned as an international first-class base for the industrialization of nanotechnology achievements, CANNANO focuses on the mid-stage (Technology Readiness Levels 4-6) of the innovation chain while building a complete ecosystem covering the entire spectrum from basic research (TRL 1) to commercialization (TRL 9). It fosters new quality productive forces by accelerating the industrialization of scientific and technological achievements.
The CANNANO headquarters park is located within the Guangzhou Artificial Intelligence and Digital Economy Experimental Zone (Yuzhu area). It has incubated a number of high-tech enterprises, including Nano Diagnosis for Health Biotech (Guangzhou) Co., Ltd., Cannano Anew Medicine Co., Ltd., Guangna Siwei (Guangdong) Photoelectric Technology Co., Ltd. and Guangna Jiayuan (Guangzhou) Science & Technology Co., Ltd., etc.
In June 2023, the National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC) approved the establishment of the National Nanotech Innovation Center (NNICE), the sole national-level industrial platform in the nanotechnology field, which is built upon the foundation of CANNANO.
The NNICE operates as an independent corporate entity with an enterprise-based management model. It is led by CANNANO and jointly funded and established by leading listed companies and industry players such as CSPC Pharmaceutical Group, Naton Technology Group, Isoftstone Information Technology (Group) Co., Ltd., and GCL Group. Focusing on three strategic emerging industries—nanomaterials, smart devices, and nanomedicine—the center is establishing critical infrastructure including a Nanobiomedical Preclinical Trials (GLP) platform and the SMILE platform for intelligent device design and manufacturing. The NNICE is designed to support the R&D needs of enterprises in generic and high technologies.

Its distinguished alumni include renowned leaders in the yeast, ceramics, and sugar industries, as well as thousands of corporate executives, earning GDIPU the reputation as a "Cradle of Talent for the Light Industry."

GDIPU has established four national collaborative innovation centers, 28 engineering research centers at or above the municipal level, 14 provincial innovation teams, one academician workstation, one doctoral research workstation, and three joint postgraduate training bases. Since 2022, it has undertaken 303 research projects at or above the municipal or departmental level, secured 193 national invention patents, and generated RMB 166 million in research and technical service revenue. The University ranks among China's top ten vocational undergraduate universities and within the top 3% of over 1,600 vocational institutions nationwide.

"Xinjiang Congrong Biotechnology Co., Ltd.", a subsidiary of Shenzhen Zhonghuanyou Company, is now leveraging Shenzhen's support for Xinjiang as a bridge, empowering desert ecology with technology, and building a bridge between innovation and common prosperity through the cistanche industry. 11699.companyProfileEn:

Our services address market entry, product commercialisation and ongoing business needs. They include support for company formation and corporate changes, business bank account applications, local administration, tax and accounting coordination, product compliance and online marketplace matters. For complex issues involving intellectual property disputes, product regulation, platform restrictions or cross-border receivables, we clarify the business facts, develop an action plan and coordinate the relevant specialists.

We focus on practical implementation. Starting with each client’s commercial objectives, we define the project approach, responsibilities and deliverables, then follow progress throughout execution. 11664.companyProfileEn:
Founded in 1955, Fujian Institute of Microbiology is one of China's earliest specialized research institutions devoted to the R&D of antibiotics and microbial medicines, as well as applied microbiology in industry, agriculture, and the environment. It is now an independent provincial-level public-interest research institution under the Fujian Provincial Department of Science and Technology.
The Institute pioneered the domestic development of pharmaceutical products including gentamicin, cyclosporine, and rapamycin. To date, it has been granted over ten new drug certificates and production approvals, more than 100 invention patents, three National Science Conference Awards, and multiple provincial and ministerial science and technology awards. These drugs have all been successfully scaled up for industrial production.
Focusing on screening new microbial drugs and developing generic drugs, the Institute maintains a full-spectrum R&D pipeline that spans from active metabolite discovery, chemical and semi-chemical synthesis, strain development and fermentation, extraction and purification, pharmaceutical formulation, and quality research, to pilot-scale testing and NDA (New Drug Application) filing.
The Institute hosts over ten S&T innovation platforms, including the National-Local Joint Engineering Research Center for Microbial New Drug Development Technology, the National Laboratory for Screening New Drugs (Microbiology) (Fujian), and the Fujian Provincial Key Laboratory for Screening New Drugs (Microbiology). It has also established key innovation teams specializing in new drug screening, microbial medicines, medicinal chemistry, mTOR inhibitors, pharmaceutical formulations, probiotics, and environmental microbiology. These teams undertake major national and provincial research projects and provide a high-level platform for the practical training and thesis research of professional-degree graduate students.
In recent years, the Institute has expanded its research into applied areas such as microbial health foods and environmental microbiology, establishing competitive strengths in immunosuppressants, antitumor drugs, antibiotics against drug-resistant bacteria, targeted fluorescent theranostics, Monascus (red yeast rice) functional products, and ecological restoration.

11772.companyProfileEn:
Shanghai Zhiqu Yuanshu Technology Co., Ltd.

Founded in 2026, Shanghai Zhiqu Yuanshu Technology Co., Ltd. set out to resolve a challenge that has long constrained the humanoid robotics industry: the core motion and actuation system. We have built a complete, one-stop motion solution covering the entire stack — from foundational components and integrated actuator modules, through drive-and-control hardware, to robot-level motion performance matching, system software, and the engineering support that carries a platform into volume production.

Rather than developing these layers in isolation, we co-engineer them as a single full stack, spanning actuator modules, whole-robot electrical/electronic (E/E) architecture, whole-robot communications architecture, and system software. For robot OEMs building embodied-AI humanoids, quadrupeds, wheeled mobile manipulators, and collaborative robots, this enables a turnkey delivery model for the complete motion system: one point of contact, one end-to-end full-body motion match.

The result is a dramatically simpler supply-chain interface, a shorter development cycle from concept to working robot, and a substantial reduction in the total cost of cross-component integration tuning and compatibility validation.

学校构建一流文科、高水平理科、有特色工科的学科体系，拥有国家重点学科1个，省高峰学科9个、高原学科13个；博士后科研流动站20个，一级学科博士点19个，博士专业学位点4个。10个学科进入ESI全球前1%，其中6个进入ESI前5‰。
学校坚持“四个面向”，强化有组织科研，主动服务国家战略与地方发展。建有国家级野外科学观测研究站、国家级重点实验室培育基地、国家地方联合工程研究中心、教育部重点实验室等部省级以上科研平台130余个。先后获部省级及以上科研成果奖1000余项，其中独立或合作获国家三大奖18项、教育部高校科研优秀成果奖自然科学一等奖1项。近5年承担国家级课题600余项，其中国家自然科学基金重大重点项目、科技部重点研发项目等35项。学校深化产学研用合作，大力推动科技成果转化与产业化，为科技创新与产业发展提供有力支撑。

11459.companyProfileEn:
Fujian Normal University (FNU) is a century-old provincial university in Fuzhou, a famous historical and cultural city. Founded in 1907 as Fujian Superior Normal School, it went through mergers and adjustments, was reorganized into Fujian Teachers College in 1953, and adopted its current name in 1972. Jointly built by Fujian Provincial Government and the Ministry of Education, FNU is a key high-level university, a first-class construction university, and a Class A university under Fujian’s second "Double First-Class" initiative.
FNU operates two campuses (Qishan and Cangshan) covering nearly 4,000 mu. It runs 86 undergraduate programs, with over 26,000 full-time undergraduates and more than 11,000 graduate students. It has over 2,100 full-time faculty, 59.62% with senior titles and 70.51% with doctoral degrees. It hosts top national talents including overseas high-level experts, Yangtze River Scholars, and NSFC Distinguished/Excellent Young Scientists, plus high-performing teams such as national Huang Danian-style teacher teams, MOE innovation teams and national teaching teams.
FNU has built a discipline system featuring first-class liberal arts, high-level sciences and distinctive engineering. It has 1 national key discipline, 9 provincial peak disciplines, 13 plateau disciplines, 20 post-doctoral stations, 19 first-level doctoral programs, and 4 professional doctorates. Ten disciplines rank in ESI global top 1%, with 6 entering the top 5‰.
Adhering to the "Four Orientations", FNU advances organized scientific research serving national strategies and local development. It hosts over 130 provincial and ministerial research platforms, including national field observation station, key lab cultivation base, national-local engineering research center, and MOE key laboratories. It has won over 1,000 provincial and ministerial research awards, including 18 National Three Major Awards (independent/cooperative) and 1 MOE Natural Science First Prize. In the past five years, it has undertaken over 600 national projects, including 35 key NSFC and MOST R&D programs. The university deepens industry-university-research collaboration to drive tech commercialization, supporting innovation and industrial upgrading.
With over a century of educational legacy, FNU remains committed to fostering virtue through education, deepens comprehensive reform and pursues connotative development. It is striding toward a comprehensive national first-class university with distinctive features, contributing continuously to Fujian and China

> **燎原创意（深圳）科技有限公司｜品牌：燎原 AI**
>
> 燎原创意是一家做企业级 AI 的公司，总部在深圳。我们的产品是燎原 AI · 组织智能，帮企业和政府建立一套属于自己的 AI 系统。
>
> 我们的判断是：AI 正在从个人工具变成组织能力。今天很多员工已经在用 AI，公司本身却还没有自己的 AI。信息散在各个系统里，经验留在个人脑子里，个人效率提高了，组织没有因此变强。燎原创意要补上的，就是这一段。
>
> 我们自己先这样运转。燎原创意的研发、运维和客户服务，大量交给 AI 数字员工完成；公司的流程、决策和经验都记录在系统里，不靠个人记忆。交给客户的方法，都先在自己身上跑通。
>
> 我们做事坚持三条：
> - **做公司的 AI，不做个人的工具。** 系统建在公司层面，接的是全公司的信息、流程和经验；员工会走，经验留下。
> - **让 AI 适应你的业务，不让你去适应软件。** 你们公司怎么干活，系统就按这个方式来配；现有系统照常用。
> - **先解决一个最头疼的问题，再谈整体。** 公司名取自「星星之火，可以燎原」：先把一个问题做透，再延伸到整个组织。

> 目前已服务政府经济园区、事业单位，以及食品、外贸、芯片、旅游等行业的企业。
>

11784.companyProfileEn:
> **Liaoyuan Creative (Shenzhen) Technology Co., Ltd. | Brand: Liaoyuan AI**
>
> Liaoyuan Creative is an enterprise-focused AI company headquartered in Shenzhen. Our core offering, "Liaoyuan AI – Organizational Intelligence," enables enterprises and government entities to build their own proprietary AI systems.
>
> We believe that AI is evolving from a tool for individuals into a core organizational capability. While many employees today use AI, most companies lack an AI infrastructure of their own. Information remains scattered across various systems, and expertise stays locked within individual minds; as a result, while personal productivity may rise, the organization as a whole does not necessarily become stronger. Liaoyuan Creative exists to bridge this gap.
>
> We apply this philosophy to our own operations. At Liaoyuan Creative, a significant portion of our R&D, IT operations, and customer service is handled by AI "digital employees." Our internal processes, decision-making, and institutional knowledge are all captured within our system—relying on the platform rather than individual memory. Every solution we provide to our clients has first been rigorously tested and proven within our own organization.
>
> Our approach is guided by three core principles:
> - **Build AI for the organization, not just tools for individuals.** Our systems are designed at the enterprise level, integrating company-wide information, processes, and expertise—ensuring that knowledge remains with the organization even when employees move on.
> - **Adapt AI to your business, not your business to the software.** We configure our systems to align with your existing workflows, allowing you to continue using your current software tools.
> - **Solve the most pressing pain point first, then scale.** Our name, "Liaoyuan" (meaning "to set the plains ablaze"), reflects our philosophy: we master one specific challenge first, then expand that success throughout the entire organization.
>
> We currently serve government economic zones, public institutions, and enterprises across various sectors, including food and beverage, foreign trade, semiconductor chips, and tourism.
>
> Address: Room 4110, Changfu Jinmao Building, Futian District, Shenzhen | Website: https://liaoyuancreative.com/

自 2014 年起，团队围绕硫基液流电池关键材料与核心部件开展系统性科研攻关，在高选择性低成本离子交换隔膜、可溶性催化剂等方向实现关键技术突破，有效解决硫基电解液离子交叉渗透、反应动力学不足、长期循环稳定性差等行业痛点，为硫基活性材料大规模储能商业化应用筑牢技术根基。

11773.companyProfileEn:
Luquos Energy's core technical team originated from The Chinese University of Hong Kong and focuses on the R&D and commercialization of intrinsically safe, low-cost, long-life sulfur-based aqueous flow battery technology.
Since 2014, the team has conducted systematic research on key materials and core components of sulfur-based flow batteries, achieving key technical breakthroughs in high-selectivity, low-cost ion-exchange membranes and soluble catalysts. These advances effectively address industry pain points such as ionic crossover in sulfur-based electrolytes, insufficient reaction kinetics, and poor long-term cycling stability, laying a solid technical foundation for the commercial-scale application of sulfur-based active materials in large-scale energy storage.
The company has built multiple energy storage demonstration projects in Hong Kong and Shenzhen. It is currently constructing its first sulfur-based flow battery pilot production line in Shenzhen, covering the entire process from stack manufacturing and system integration to testing and validation, and will be capable of delivering energy storage systems at the tens-of-MWh scale, thereby accelerating the large-scale deployment of next-generation long-duration energy storage technology.

11778.companyProfileEn:
Huixi Technology is dedicated to building a full-stack computing platform for embodied AI, providing robotics companies with products and solutions covering chips, modules, software toolchains, and foundation models.
The company has constructed its technology system around the RPU computing engine, the RISE computing platform, and the RhinoVLA model. RPU delivers high-efficiency, ultra-low-latency foundational computing power for multimodal perception, task understanding, reasoning and decision-making, as well as action generation. RISE platform, powered by Huixi Embodied series chips, achieves 500 TOPS of computing power, efficiently supporting cutting-edge models such as VLA and world models, and has already been deployed into mass-produced products of multiple robotics companies. RhinoVLA provides pre-trained foundation models and a complete development pipeline, significantly reducing the cost of model development, adaptation, and deployment.
Huixi Technology aims to become a globally leading supplier of embodied AI computing platforms, fostering the future of AI with better compute. Currently, the cumulative annual shipment volume of the company's high-performance computing products for embodied intelligence ranks among the top in the domestic market.

By integrating specialized AI agents, clinical data systems, quality management systems, and expert teams, DIP transforms model capabilities into traceable, auditable, and deliverable clinical R&D services—advancing AI from point-solution assistance to end-to-end delivery of complete clinical trial programs. According to research by Frost & Sullivan, DIP ranks first globally by market share in the LLM+MAS-powered clinical CRO market. To date, DIP has served more than 1,500 clients, including many of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies and innovative biotech companies.

In materials science, DIP is committed to empowering industries through the new research paradigm of AI for Science (AI4S). The company extends the capabilities of its AI multi-agent platform into R&D across a broad range of sectors, including agrochemicals, new energy materials, semiconductor materials, functional foods, and dietary supplements—helping R&D evolve from discovery to creation.

DIP has achieved sustained profitability and grown into an AI pharmaceutical unicorn valued at several billion US dollars. The company now operates more than ten functional headquarters and regional centers across China, Japan, the United States, Singapore, and Australia.

11795.companyProfileEn:
Founded in 2019, Shenzhen Hygieia Biotechnology is a national high-tech enterprise specializing in healthy aging. Rooted in synthetic biology, we operate on our proprietary Zymevolver® green biosynthesis platform, covering the full value chain: target discovery, strain engineering, fermentation & purification, pilot scale-up and commercial-scale manufacturing.

Our R&D team consists of PhD and master’s researchers and senior industry specialists. We have built an evidence-backed scientific validation system and pioneered randomized, double-blind human clinical trials for Ca-AKG. Supported by robust clinical data verifying ingredient safety and efficacy, our Enerlive® Ca-AKG has won the VERY FOOD Innovation Award.

We maintain a diversified functional ingredient portfolio, supplying premium ingredients including Ca-AKG, NMN, PQQ, Urolithin A, Ergothioneine, D-Chiro-Inositol and Citicoline. Our ingredients support cellular anti-aging, energy metabolism, women’s health, cognitive health and sports nutrition. With DelMiCap™ microencapsulation technology, we significantly improve the stability and bioavailability of active ingredients.

Our production facility runs GMP-compliant workshops and holds FSSC 22000, ISO 9001, Halal and Kosher certifications. We satisfy regulatory requirements across key global markets with consistent large-scale supply.

We provide end-to-end ODM/OEM services: raw material supply, formula development, custom dosage design and finished product delivery, compatible with tablets, softgels and solid drink powders. As a co-drafter of multiple industry association standards, Hygieia adheres to green manufacturing. Centered on cellular health, we deliver high-purity, traceable bioactive ingredients to nutrition brands worldwide. Driven by synthetic biology, we empower the healthy aging industry and work with global partners to develop evidence-based nutritional solutions.

11776.companyProfile:
御水飞行（Y-H2O）自主研发并制造100%纯电动智能水翼艇，将船艇美学与低能耗航行相结合。产品面向个人用户，提供安静、平稳的水上休闲体验，也为海外游艇会、滨水景区和水上交通运营商提供传统燃油艇的纯电替代方案，适用于景区游览、短途接驳和水上通勤。

Y-3 是率先推向市场的核心产品，采用自研全碳纤维水翼、电动推进和主动稳航系统。航速达到12 节时，水翼将艇体托离水面，减少航行阻力和船底拍浪带来的颠簸。Y-3 在翼航状态下最高可节能 80%，航行稳定性最高可提升 70%。纯电推进使船艇在航行过程中实现直接零碳排放。相较于传统燃油艇，二氧化碳排放可减少 95.2%，年度使用成本可降低 94.4%。在 Y-3 的基础上，公司还布局了 Y-5 和 Y-12，为多人休闲、景区观光和水上接驳提供更大载客量的船型选择。
目前，Y-3 已完成海试并取得欧盟认证，公司已按客户订单启动生产交付。2026 年 7 月，Y-3 在摩纳哥新能源船舶挑战赛中获得 SeaLab 组季军。公司也正争取将 Y-3 引入中国水上摩托艇大赛，作为指定组别的竞赛艇型。
11776.companyProfileEn:
Y-H2O develops and manufactures fully electric smart hydrofoil boats that combine elegant design with energy-efficient operation. Its boats offer private owners a quiet, smooth ride on the water. For yacht clubs, waterfront destinations and water transport operators in international markets, they offer an all-electric alternative to conventional fuel-powered boats for sightseeing, short-distance transfers and commuting.

The Y-3 is the company’s first model to reach the market. It combines all-carbon-fibre hydrofoils developed in-house with electric propulsion and an active stability control system. At 12 knots, the hydrofoils lift the hull clear of the water, reducing drag and softening the impact of waves. While foiling, the Y-3 can deliver energy savings of up to 80% and improve stability by up to 70%. Its electric propulsion system produces no direct carbon emissions during operation. Compared with conventional fuel-powered boats, the Y-3 can reduce carbon dioxide emissions by 95.2% and annual operating costs by 94.4%. Building on the Y-3, the company’s product range also includes the higher-capacity Y-5 and Y-12 for group outings, sightseeing and passenger transfers.

The Y-3 has completed sea trials and obtained EU certification. Production and deliveries are now underway to fulfil customer orders. In July 2026, the Y-3 placed third in the SeaLab class at the Monaco Energy Boat Challenge. The company is also seeking to have the Y-3 adopted as the designated race boat for a class in China’s national powerboat competition.

喀什大学位于“一带一路”重要节点、中巴经济走廊起点、南疆城市群区域中心—喀什市，是中国最西部的大学、欧亚大陆腹地口岸边境上的大学、“一带一路”重要节点上的大学、“棋眼”中心的大学。
学校始建于1962年，前身为喀什师范专科学校。1978年升格为本科，2003年获得硕士学位授予资格，2015年更名为喀什大学，2016年被确定为全国100所转型发展试点高校之一。1994年、2009年先后两次被国务院授予“全国民族团结进步模范集体”光荣称号，2014年中国语系被国务院授予“全国民族团结进步模范集体”光荣称号，2022年被评为“自治区民族团结进步示范学校”。2024年获批博士学位授予单位。
11798.companyProfileEn:
Kashi University is located in Kashgar, an important node of the Belt and Road Initiative, the starting point of the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor, and the regional center of the southern Xinjiang urban agglomeration. It is China’s westernmost university, a university at a border gateway in the heart of Eurasia, a university at a key Belt and Road node, and a university at the center of a strategically vital “chess eye.”
Founded in 1962 as Kashgar Teachers College, the university began offering undergraduate programs in 1978, gained the right to confer master’s degrees in 2003, was renamed Kashi University in 2015, and was designated one of China’s 100 pilot universities for transformational development in 2016. In 1994 and 2009, it was twice awarded the honorary title of “National Model Collective for Ethnic Unity and Progress” by the State Council. In 2014, its Department of Chinese Language received the same honor from the State Council. In 2022, it was named a “Model School for Ethnic Unity and Progress of the Autonomous Region,” and in 2024 it was approved as a doctoral degree-granting institution.

香港昇舟國際有限公司（HKSC INTERNATIONAL LIMITED）是一家以香港为海外经营总部、聚焦中欧贸易与投资合作及创新消费科技产品国际化经营的企业。公司在德国法兰克福地区布局本地经营主体，业务辐射德国及欧洲市场，依托中国制造供应链优势与欧洲本土市场资源，开展国际贸易、品牌运营、供应链整合、产品创新及海外渠道拓展。

公司以 “Smart Living & Outdoor Technology｜智能生活与户外消费科技”为核心业务方向，重点布局两大领域：

**智慧生活（Smart Living）：** 涵盖智能家电、智能家居及创新消费电子产品，致力于通过科技创新提升现代家庭生活品质与智能化体验。

**户外智慧生活（Outdoor Smart Living）：** 涵盖户外生活电器、智能出行、户外运动及相关智能硬件，推动智能科技与户外生活场景深度融合。

公司创始人拥有多年德国及欧洲家电行业经营管理经验，在产品规划、国际品牌运营、欧洲电商及线上线下渠道建设方面具有丰富经验。目前，公司已围绕自有品牌 Camp Barista 推出便携式电动意式咖啡机系列，并持续探索创新智能硬件及多元化生活科技产品。

公司致力于连接中国创新制造与欧洲消费市场，推动优质产品、品牌及技术走向国际，同时积极探索深港产业协同与跨境商业合作机会。

Smart Living, Wherever You Go.｜智能生活，随行而至。
11779.companyProfileEn:
HKSC INTERNATIONAL LIMITED is a Hong Kong-based company serving as an international business headquarters, focusing on China–Europe trade and investment cooperation, as well as the international development of innovative consumer technology products.

With a local business presence in the Frankfurt region of Germany, the company serves the German and wider European markets. By connecting China's advanced manufacturing capabilities with European market expertise, HKSC focuses on international trade, brand development, supply chain integration, product innovation, and overseas distribution.

Under the strategic direction of “Smart Living & Outdoor Technology,” the company focuses on two core business areas:

Smart Living: Smart home appliances, connected home solutions, and innovative consumer electronics designed to enhance everyday living through technology and intelligent functionality.

**Outdoor Smart Living:** Portable lifestyle appliances, smart mobility solutions, outdoor sports technology, and intelligent hardware designed to bring modern convenience and connected experiences beyond the home.

The company's founder brings extensive management experience in the German and European home appliance industry, with expertise in product strategy, international brand management, European e-commerce, and omnichannel distribution.

Its consumer brand Camp Barista, positioned as an Outdoor Coffee Lifestyle Brand, has introduced a range of portable electric espresso machines. The company continues to explore innovative smart hardware and lifestyle technology products for international markets.

HKSC aims to connect Chinese innovation and manufacturing with European consumers and business partners while fostering cross-border trade, industrial cooperation, and long-term international business opportunities.

Smart Living, Wherever You Go.
